title: 3D Packaging Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Us

QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. We do this with our unique VIO™ technology, the only QPU architecture that breaks the hardware barriers that have held quantum computing back, unlocking the path to MegaQubit quantum processors.

With VIO, we are paving the way for the hyper-scale quantum computers that will change the world. And delivering on that vision demands people who don’t shy away from tackling the hardest challenges of our time. That’s where you come in!

As a 3D Packaging Engineer, you will collaborate closely with our engineering team to physically realize our VIO products. You will operate, adapt, and fine-tune high-precision assembly equipment to meet the precise tolerances required for optimal device performance.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Tooling Adaptation: Assist in modifying and calibrating high-precision assembly equipment (e.g., flip-chip bonders, die attach machines) to meet unique quantum 3D integration specifications.

  • Process Optimization: Help develop and refine placement and bonding processes (thermo-compression bonding, laser-assisted bonding, coldwelding) for non-standard substrates. Test adhesives, glues, and solders to determine which materials survive extreme thermal cycling and cryogenic vacuum conditions.

  • 3D Assembly Execution: Execute complex integration strategies, including multi-die stacking, interposer-based 3D architectures, and orthogonal (vertical) chip placement.

Your Profile

  • Education: BS, MS, or PhD in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Physics, Materials Science, or a related field.

  • Tooling Experience: 3–5 years of hands-on experience operating and adjusting high-accuracy semiconductor assembly platforms.

  • Precision Assembly: Demonstrated experience achieving tight placement tolerances (around 1µm) in an R&D or pilot production environment.

  • 3D Integration Knowledge: Solid foundational understanding of 3D integration (TSVs, micro-bumps, interposers) and how structural materials behave under thermal stress, high vacuum, or cryogenic conditions.

Don't tick every box? Apply anyway! Research shows women often self-select out if they don't meet every requirement. Here's our take: nobody ticks every box. This is a description of our ideal candidate, not a filter. If most resonates and you're keen to learn the gaps, apply. We hire for trajectory, not perfection.

What We Offer:

At QuantWare, you’ll be part of a high-performing team of world-class experts in an ambitious, fast-moving environment. From day one, you’ll have the trust, tools, and support to do your best work. Here’s what you can expect:

Competitive salary - A salary that reflects the impact and importance of the role (and of course 8% holiday allowance)

Pension that’s built to last - A generous and future-proof pension plan that includes partner and dependent coverage.

Flexibility built on trust - We focus on outcomes. Work flexibly, in a hybrid setup, with an open vacation policy that lets you manage your time

Personal growth - We invest in your L&D, with a budget available to each team member, dependent on their individual ambitions, development needs, and performance

A connected team - We make space to celebrate wins together, with team events, offsites, and spontaneous moments that bring us closer

Diversity & Inclusion at QuantWare

We’re an ambitious company, not only for our goals but also to become an even more diverse and inclusive team. We know great candidates don't always follow a straight path, and we value diverse experience, perspectives, and ways of thinking. We know this helps us make better decisions, drives more innovation, and strengthens our culture.

As part of our recruitment process, candidates may be required to undergo pre-employment screening.

title: Abteilungsleiter IT-Services (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Erfolgreiches IT-Dienstleistungsunternehmen

Als innovatives, kundenorientiertes und modern geführtes Dienstleistungsunternehmen auf dem Gebiet der Informationstechnologie ist unser Kunde seit vielen Jahren eine feste Größe in Nordrhein-Westfalen. Das Unternehmen beschäftigt an mehreren Standorten in NRW etwa 800 Mitarbeitende und bietet strategische und projektbezogene IT-Beratung, Integration, IT-Infrastruktur und Full-Service. Hierbei liegt der Branchenschwerpunkt stark im öffentlichen Sektor.

Im Zuge einer altersbedingten Nachfolge wird für einen Standort in Ostwestfalen eine erfahrene und überzeugende Führungspersönlichkeit gesucht.

Ihre Aufgabe:

  • Verantwortung für ein Profitcenter in Gütersloh mit aktuell acht Mitarbeitenden in wirtschaftlicher, personeller und organisatorischer Sicht

  • Sicherstellung des Portfolios von IT-Services für einen kommunalen Kundenkreis in Ostwestfalen

  • Kompetente Beratung unterschiedlicher Interessengruppen und Betreuung der Kunden in der Region

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit den weiteren Centern der Business Unit und proaktives Wirken für ein zielgerichtetes Business Development sowie Produkt- und Projektmanagement

  • Führung des Profitcenters mit Zielen und Zahlen und Sicherstellung der Erreichung der quantitativen und qualitativen Ziele über Kennzahlen

Ihr Profil:

  • Abgeschlossenes informationstechnisches oder wirtschaftswissenschaftliches Studium oder eine qualifizierte Ausbildung mit klarer Branchenausrichtung

  • Einschlägige Berufserfahrung mit Personal- und Budgetverantwortung

  • Erfahrungen im Umgang mit IT-Services und gutes Verständnis für die Themen Systemadministration sowie Client- und Netzwerkservices

  • Lösungsorientierte Herangehensweise, Freude an der Gestaltung neuer Prozesse und deren Umsetzung sowie der Optimierung der Abläufe des Tagesgeschäfts

  • Entscheidungs- und Umsetzungsstärke, unternehmerische, mutige und innovationsbereite Vorgehensweise

  • Fähigkeit, komplexe IT-Themenstellungen zu durchdringen, Perspektivwechsel zu vollziehen, schnelle Auffassungsgabe, gepaart mit Praktikabilität von Lösungsvorschlägen

  • Hohe Kommunikations- und Vernetzungsfähigkeit

  • Hierarchieübergreifend sicheres Auftreten intern wie extern

Wir bieten:

  • Eine herausgehobene Führungsaufgabe in einem innovativen IT-Dienstleistungsunternehmen

  • Gestaltungsfreiheit und Eigenverantwortung in einer breit gefächerten Schlüsselfunktion

  • Ein positives und durch Kooperation geprägtes Arbeitsklima und die Führung eines leistungsstarken Teams

Wenn Sie sich durch diese verantwortungsvolle Aufgabenstellung in einem zukunftsgerichteten Unternehmen angesprochen fühlen, sollten wir uns kennen lernen. Für eine erste Kontaktaufnahme steht Ihnen Herr Volker Hofmann unter den Rufnummern 0211/90981610 oder 0177/8213827 gerne zur Verfügung. title: Account Executive, Enterprise, Swiss Romande
descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

Role Summary:

As our Enterprise Sales Executive, you will be instrumental in shaping Mistral’s adoption with our largest customers across a variety of industries. You will be driving deals end2end: from prospective, first intro call until closing and beyond — together with our dedicated implementation specialist, tech and legal teams.

What you will do:

Lead development (strategic outbound and qualified inbound):

- Handle strategic outreach as well as warm introductions to promising enterprise customers

- Converting inbound deals where upselling / more bespoke agreements can be achieved

Value prop validation for customer:

- Provide hands-on support and guidance to clients during a potential Proof of Concept (POC) phase, ensuring a smooth and successful evaluation process

- Leverage successful POC outcomes to facilitate the conversion of POCs into long-term, revenue-generating contracts

Deal management & closing:

- Develop and execute strategic sales plans to convert leads into valued customers — you are the first point of contact for all external stakeholders and are responsible for properly managing deals and aligning all stakeholders (heavy involvement of customer engineering, product, and commercial teams, both on operational and C-level)

- Handle customer negotiation end2end, together with our legal and implementation specialist team

Executive Engagement:

- Cultivate and maintain strong relationships with C-level executives, heads of innovation/AI, and other key decision-makers within target organisations

- Comprehend their specific challenges and needs, positioning our solution as an integral part of their strategic initiatives

Technical Aptitude:

- Demonstrate a deep understanding of the technical intricacies of our product and articulate its value proposition effectively to potential clients

- Work side-by-side with our implementation team to ensure that customer’s questions, concerns and challenges are taken care of during pre-sales, deployment and post-deployment phase

- Collaborate with our technical team to address any customer inquiries or concerns

Training and enablement:

-Empower internal teams with the knowledge and resources that you collect in customer conversations to drive product roadmap and align on priorities

Who you are:

- 7-10 years experience in Sales (enterprise sales/consultative selling, ideally selling a highly complex, technical product)

- Excellent academics: Bachelor and/or Master Degree in Business, Computer Science, or a related field

- Significant work experience within AI ecosystem or related data/infrastructure field

- Experience at successful fast growing startup, ideally in deep-tech

- Strong technical skills to navigate quickly evolving products and steer technical discussions

- Fluency in French and English is mandatory; proficiency in German would be considered an advantage.

- Outstanding negotiation and communication skills

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

title: Account Executive, Influencer Marketing
descriptionHtml:
Position: Account Specialist
The Account Specialist position is a remote, work-from-home role, as are all positions at Acceleration Partners (a structure central to our culture and vision to change the work/life paradigm). Some travel may be required for client meetings, internal meetings, conferences, and other events. Please note: This position requires verbal and written fluency in German.
The Role:
As an Account Specialist, you will provide white glove service to diverse brands investing in influencer marketing campaigns. This role is particularly focused on campaign execution, including but not limited to driving influencer recruitment, managing influencer partnerships, and owning campaign deliverables, tracking, and reporting. The Account Specialist will also drive strategy by analyzing campaign performance, identifying success areas and/or challenge areas, and proactively implementing strategic measures to continuously optimize programs towards goals and objectives.
The successful candidate will have strong experience in developing and managing successful, KPI-driven influencer marketing campaigns for consumer products and/or services companies. They will have working knowledge of the overall partner marketing landscape, including affiliate, and the ability to both develop comprehensive strategy as well as capably execute. The successful candidate will be a self-starter that can confidently plug in to any challenging situation with ease and can balance competing priorities well. The Account Specialist must be flexible, willing and able to pivot quickly, and excited to operate successfully in an “intrapreneurial” situation. This person will also have a history of working well with their peers, quickly establishing relationships easily and leading through influence.
You’ll work closely with your manager and peers to maximize program effectiveness and create opportunities for growth.
Top 5 Responsibilities:
  • INFLUENCER RECRUITMENT, NEGOTIATING & ONBOARDING –Sources new partnership opportunities and creates influencer casting lists. Diligently vets opportunities to ensure brand alignment, authenticity and relevancy prior to presenting to client for approval. Conducts outreach to approved partners and skillfully garners their engagement and participation in the campaign, negotiating when necessary. Supports influencers through campaign onboarding by developing and providing resources to streamline processes.
  • INFLUENCER PARTNERSHIPS MANAGEMENT – Crafts program-wide influencer communications and vital creator resources. Guides influencers on content strategy and creation. Works with influencers to develop content timelines and ensures influencers stay on track with the schedules discussed. Collects content drafts and leads the content review process, including screening to ensure FTC guidelines are met. Closely works with influencers to adjust content strategy as needed, troubleshooting any signs of poor performance to optimize campaign towards goals and objectives.
  • AUDITING, REPORTING & ANALYSIS – Accountable for auditing program content to ensure compliance with FTC regulations and brand guidelines. Ensures content is tracked accurately and regularly shared with client, along with placement insights, partner insights, and campaign pace towards KPI goals. Performs robust analysis of influencer campaigns using both social analytics and conversion metrics to identify performance trends and areas of opportunity. Proactively provides actionable recommendations to client backed by data and continuously refines strategy to drive growth at scale. Supports team in creation of customized strategy plans, detailed campaign performance summaries and comprehensive hindsight presentations that are delivered to clients.
  • CLIENT SERVICE & COMMUNICATION- Consistently provides superior client service and escalates issues or key risks as appropriate. Works to ensure client develops trust in our team by delivering client outputs and communications in the AP way, consistently maintaining quality, accuracy, and precision. Develops and nurtures excellent relationships, supports team in promoting very high client satisfaction and retention rates, and an average 8.5 client rating.
  • PORTFOLIO MANAGEMENT- Own and manage client tasks with minimal supervision, ensuring deadlines are met and tasks are completed accurately. Manages multiple campaigns with solid organizational skills and the ability to focus on and prioritize tasks based on client objectives, flagging any potential delays and keeping the team informed. Has full grasp of each client’s scope of work, delivering what is due under terms; maintains ability to identify new opportunities to drive client success while conjunctively identifying possible goal misalignments, getting to the root of an issue, and working with their team to bring solutions to resolve.

What Success Looks Like:
BY 3 MONTHS:
  • The Account Specialist is contributing across a portfolio of influencer programs, collaborating with their team closely to ensure strong alignment with the campaign strategy in place.
  • You are working with key client contacts to ensure brand alignment with recruitment efforts and content creation.
  • You have become familiar with AP’s tools and solutions and are equipped to conduct casting for prospective influencers, execute content timelines with influencers, audit content, and ensure performance is tracked and measured.
By 6 MONTHS:
  • You are owning execution of the day-to-day operations of multiple influencer programs with little guidance from your team, including reporting, processing applications, recruiting and casting creators, and crafting partner communications.
  • Challenging client or team situations are being managed with guidance from managers and directors collaborating closely to bring a solutions-oriented approach to these situations proactively.
  • You are regularly analyzing client data and strategically leveraging insights to optimize campaigns.
  • Client accounts are being handled effectively and strategically, without dropping any balls, and clients are aware of and pleased with this outcome. Clients are being serviced profitably with AP targets, client KPI’s being met, and an average 8.5 client rating is being upheld across campaigns.
  • You will regularly present new campaign ideas to managers and demonstrate a clear understanding of program performance
By 1 YEAR:
  • You will troubleshoot and resolve account and creator issues independently, providing valuable insights and actionable recommendations to clients and internal teams.
  • You will be an integral part of each program, developing new ideas and improving processes to create efficiencies.
  • You will take on new account responsibilities with support from your manager and serve as a thought leader within the team, contributing to relationship-building and firm development.
Qualities of the Ideal Candidate
  • Has a strong internal motivation to get the job done and done well
  • Only provides superior results and unsurpassed customer service
  • Exhilarated by managing change and comfortable with ambiguity and moving targets
  • Passionate about the digital marketing industry and how influencer relates to the greater digital landscape
  • Ensures that influencer strategies and tactics have measurable results
  • Has incredible attention to detail and is capable of multi-tasking and coordinating several projects at once
  • Translates data and insights into actionable next steps for clients
  • Strong with data analysis, is easily able to pinpoint issues and opportunities within a data set
  • Prioritizes competing objectives and manages time with skill
  • Displays accountability, always meeting deadlines and keeping commitments
  • Thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys bringing order to chaos
  • Likes to share and collaborate with peers in a remote environment
  • Possesses superior written and verbal communication skills
  • Possesses mature and measured judgment, and the ability to solve problems on their own
  • Works independently with minimal supervision
  • Has confidence, poise, and eloquence in client meetings and difficult situations
  • Hears and incorporates feedback from other team members, clients and partners
Qualifications & Skills:
  • Fluency in German
  • 2+ years working for an influencer marketing agency and experience executing influencer campaigns and managing both client and influencer relationships
  • Solid understanding of omni-channel and digital marketing, with a track record of successfully running influencer campaigns for consumer products and/or services companies
  • Excellent at communicating, presenting and approval from clients on new campaign strategies and initiatives
  • Working knowledge of attribution in digital marketing
  • Strong understanding of how influencer and affiliate marketing can work together
  • Tools (CreatorIQ, Grin, Izea, etc.) experience preferred, not required
  • Knowledge of Affiliate Networks or SaaS platforms (Impact, ShareASale, Commission Junction, etc.) experience preferred, not required
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience
  • Ability to travel up to 15%
  • Advanced Excel capabilities and comfortable with formatting, formulas, customizing reports, etc.
WHY ACCELERATION PARTNERS?
Acceleration Partners is the world’s largest and first-to-market Partnership Marketing Agency creating and nurturing partnerships that drive exceptional measurable outcomes for their clients. Managing clients in 40+ countries, their global team of 300+ focuses on data-driven strategies that help connect brands to the right consumers through performance partnerships, traditional affiliate, influencer, performance PR, content, and B2B partnership marketing.

AP PERKS & BENEFITS - WHAT WE OFFER 
  • 100% remote work for everyone 
  • Group medical, dental, and vision coverage insurance (with opt-out benefits) 
  • 401K with matching 
  • Open Paid Time Off 
  • Summer & Holiday company-wide shut-down weeks in July and December 
  • Volunteer and Birthday Time Off 
  • Focus Fridays 
  • Paid Parental Leave Benefits 
  • Wellness, Technology & Education Allowances 
  • Paid sabbatical leaves, donation matching, and more!! 
  • Target Salary is €37–44K depending on location and experience.

Benefits may vary based on employment status or country location. 

Acceleration Partners is committed to a diverse workforce and we are an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate applicants regardless of an individual’s age, race, color, gender, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, or veteran status.

By 1 YEAR:

  • You will be an integral part of each program, developing new ideas and improving processes to create efficiencies.
  • You will take on new account responsibilities with support from your manager and serve as a thought leader within the team, contributing to relationship-building and firm development.
Qualities of the Ideal Candidate
  • Has a strong internal motivation to get the job done and done well
  • Only provides superior results and unsurpassed customer service
  • Exhilarated by managing change and comfortable with ambiguity and moving targets
  • Passionate about the digital marketing industry and how influencer relates to the greater digital landscape
  • Ensures that influencer strategies and tactics have measurable results
  • Has incredible attention to detail and is capable of multi-tasking and coordinating several projects at once
  • Translates data and insights into actionable next steps for clients
  • Strong with data analysis, is easily able to pinpoint issues and opportunities within a data set
  • Prioritizes competing objectives and manages time with skill
  • Displays accountability, always meeting deadlines and keeping commitments
  • Thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys bringing order to chaos
  • Likes to share and collaborate with peers in a remote environment
  • Possesses superior written and verbal communication skills
  • Possesses mature and measured judgment, and the ability to solve problems on their own
  • Works independently with minimal supervision
  • Has confidence, poise, and eloquence in client meetings and difficult situations
  • Hears and incorporates feedback from other team members, clients and partners
Qualifications & Skills:

descriptionHtml:
Mission

Integral wurde im Oktober 2024 gegründet und ist bereits eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Startups in Deutschland. Wir entwickeln die führende KI-native Plattform für Buchhaltung, Lohnabrechnung und Steuern für europäische KMU – und wir suchen die klügsten Köpfe, die uns dabei helfen, dieses Ziel zu erreichen.

Die Maschine läuft. Inbound Leads fließen rein, das Produkt verkauft sich selbst und die Leads sind bereit, bei uns zu unterschreiben. Was wir jetzt brauchen, ist jemand, der die Schlüssel nimmt, Vollgas gibt und es mit jeder Runde besser macht. Als Account Executive verantwortest du die gesamte Conversion: jeden Anruf, jeden Abschluss, jede Prozessverbesserung, die die nächsten hundert Deals schneller und schärfer macht. Wir bewegen uns schnell; mit dem richtigen Kandidaten ist der gesamte Prozess in unter zwei Wochen abgeschlossen.

  1. Erstes Gespräch mit unserem Talent Team

  2. Tiefgehendes Interview mit unserem Growth Team

Wir schätzen Vielfalt und stellen Menschen aufgrund ihrer Fähigkeit ein, eine Aufgabe zu erfüllen. descriptionHtml:
About us

At Trainline, our purpose is to empower greener travel choices, connecting people and places. Trainline enables millions of travellers to find and book the best value tickets across carriers, fares, and journey options through our highly rated mobile app, website, and B2B partner channels. 

Great journeys start with Trainline 🚄 

We’re Europe’s leading independent rail platform, helping millions of travellers find and book the best-value rail and coach journeys across our app, website and partner channels.

Our job is to make the green travel choice the best choice. By building a better train travel experience, we help more people choose rail - creating a positive impact for customers, our business and the planet.

We’re a team of more than 1,000 Trainliners from over 50 nationalities, working across London, Paris, Barcelona, Milan, Edinburgh and Madrid. Now is a brilliant time to join us and help shape the future of travel.

Introducing Global Distribution at Trainline Partner Solutions (TPS) 👋

We’re looking for an ambitious and commercially minded Account Executive to join our Trainline Partner Solutions team, managing key relationships with Travel Management Companies in the UK and Europe.

This is a client-facing, strategic role that blends relationship management, project management, commercial growth, and product advocacy. You’ll be responsible for nurturing partnerships with major B2B clients, ensuring they achieve success with our technology and that Trainline continues to grow as their trusted digital rail partner.

 

What you will do as an Account Executive at Trainline...🚅

• Provide day-to-day support to an assigned portfolio of Trainline Partner Solutions customers.

• Build and manage successful customer relationships, becoming a trusted advisor for our partners.

• Identify growth opportunities and execute them with the help of the team.

• Get involved in ad-hoc projects and business support as needed.

• Support on development and managing a customer communication plan.

• Negotiation and renewal of existing customer contracts.

 

We'd love to hear from you if you have...🔍

• 1-2 years’ experience in Account Management, Customer Success, or Partnership Management, ideally within rail, business travel technology, or the travel space.

• Fluency in English. Additional languages such as French, Spanish, German and/or Italian is advantageous.

• Ability to build and maintain strong client relationships with enterprise or strategic partners.

• Proven experience in managing multiple client workstreams and priorities

• Strong communication skills – written and verbal.

• Confidence with your ability to find your way in ambiguous situations.

• Passion for the rail industry, business travel, and sustainable mobility.

• Experience using Salesforce in an account management/sales environment.

More information:

Enjoy fantastic perks like private healthcare & dental insurance, a generous work from abroad policy, 2-for-1 share purchase plans, an EV Scheme to further reduce carbon emissions, extra festive time off, and excellent family-friendly benefits. 

We prioritise career growth with clear career paths, transparent pay bands, personal learning budgets, and regular learning days. Jump on board and supercharge your career from day one! 

We're operating a hybrid model and ask that Trainliners work from the office a minimum of 60% of their time over a 12-week period. We also have a 28-day Work from Abroad policy.

Our values represent the things that matter most to us and what we live and breathe everyday, in everything we do:

  • ✔️ Own It - We focus on every customer, partner and journey

  • ♻️ Do Good - We make a positive impact

That's why we're committed to creating inclusive places to work, where everyone belongs and differences are valued and celebrated.

title: Account Executive, Portworx - Strategic Accounts - Telco (EMEA)
descriptionHtml:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

THE ROLE

Pure Storage is seeking a Strategic Accounts Account Executive to accelerate growth of the Portworx platform across Strategic Telco accounts in EMEA. You will own a small number of named Telco customers and prospects, build and execute multi year account plans, and drive platform adoption with a focus on business outcomes such as resilience, risk reduction, faster application delivery, and operational efficiency.

You will work closely with cross functional teams across Pure and Portworx, including Systems Engineering, Customer Experience, Marketing, Partner teams, Product, and field leadership. This is a high impact individual contributor role with a strong emphasis on strategic planning, disciplined execution, and customer intimacy.

What You’ll Do

  • Own and grow a portfolio of named Strategic Telco accounts, delivering against annual and multi year revenue targets.
  • Build and execute account plans that map buying centres, application priorities, Kubernetes roadmaps, and transformation programmes.
  • Develop executive relationships across CIO, CTO, CISO, Head of Infrastructure, Platform Engineering, SRE, and Application leaders.
  • Lead complex sales cycles from discovery through close, including security, risk, procurement, architecture review, and legal processes common in Telco.
  • Position Portworx around measurable outcomes: application resilience, ransomware recovery, data protection, regulatory compliance, cloud portability, and modernisation at scale.
  • Orchestrate account teams and partner ecosystems, including GSIs, cloud providers, and regional partners, to drive pipeline creation and deal execution.
  • Run a rigorous, value based sales process tailored to cloud native software, with accurate forecasting and strong hygiene in Salesforce and forecasting tools.
  • Partner with Customer Experience to expand adoption post sale, identify expansion triggers, and build customer advocacy within the Telco community.
  • Stay ahead of competitive dynamics in Kubernetes data services, backup and recovery, and container storage, using insights to sharpen strategy and messaging.
  • Represent Portworx in customer meetings and relevant industry events, with a field first mindset.

What You’ll Bring

  • Proven enterprise software sales experience, with a track record of closing and expanding high value, multi stakeholder deals in large organisations.
  • Demonstrable experience selling into Telco, with an understanding of procurement, governance, risk, and security requirements.
  • Strong grasp of cloud native concepts and the Kubernetes ecosystem, plus the ability to credibly engage architects and platform teams.
  • Experience selling to both technical and executive stakeholders, translating technical capabilities into business value and risk outcomes.
  • Disciplined pipeline generation, qualification, deal management, and forecasting, with strong operational habits in SFDC.
  • Comfort working in a matrixed environment, influencing cross functional teams without direct authority.
  • Strong communication and programme management skills, with clear account planning and stakeholder alignment.
  • A customer first mindset and a bias for action, with resilience and curiosity.

WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM US:

  • Innovation: We celebrate those who think critically, like a challenge, and aspire to be trailblazers.
  • Growth: We give you the space and support to grow along with us and to contribute to something meaningful. We have been named Fortune's Best Workplaces in Technology™, Fortune's Best Workplaces in the Bay Area™, and certified as a Great Place to Work®!
  • Team: We build each other up and set aside ego for the greater good.

And because we understand the value of bringing your full and best self to work, we offer a variety of perks to manage a healthy balance, including flexible time off, wellness resources, and company-sponsored team events. Check out http://benefits.everpuredata.com/ for more information.

ACCOMMODATIONS AND ACCESSIBILITY:

Candidates with disabilities may request accommodations for all aspects of our hiring process. For more on this, contact us at

OUR COMMITMENT TO A STRONG AND INCLUSIVE TEAM:

We’re forging a future where everyone finds their rightful place and where every voice matters. Where uniqueness isn’t just accepted but embraced. That’s why we are committed to fostering the growth and development of every person, cultivating a sense of community through our Employee Resource Groups and advocating for inclusive leadership.

title: Account Executive - SaaS
descriptionHtml:
Job Title: Account Executive Type: Full-time Experience: 3+ years What about us? Launched in 2023, INFINIT is a fast-growing fintech scale-up operating in multiple countries across Europe and Americas. At INFINIT we are on a mission to reshape the future of SMEs with AI at the forefront. Our all-in-one operating system has banking at its core, and empowers small business owners and their teams to seamlessly manage and optimize every aspect of their business with AI agents. By focussing on specific industries, INFINIT delivers tailored, high-value solutions, while building innovative AI products to further unlock significant growth opportunities for our customers. INFINIT operates globally, with ambitions to further expand its footprint to redefine the fintech landscape for SMEs worldwide. Join us on the INFINIT journey as we revolutionise the SME economy and drive meaningful impact through innovation 🚀 The Role

As an Account Executive at INFINIT, you will own new-business revenue from first contact to signed contract, working entirely from our office. You will source your own leads, run cold outreach by phone and email, deliver product demos, and close deals remotely, with no field visits.

This is a full sales cycle role. You will do the prospecting, the qualification, the demo, the negotiation and the close yourself, and show SME owners how INFINIT's AI-driven operating system transforms the way they run their business. We are looking for a self-starter with a hunter mentality, who is energised by a high-activity, phone-based sales environment and has a record of hitting and beating targets.


What do we want to achieve together?

  • You will own the full sales cycle, from prospecting and qualification through demo, negotiation and close, with a clear monthly and quarterly revenue target.

  • You will generate your own pipeline through cold calling, email and various outreach methods, and by researching and sourcing new leads in our target SME segments.

  • You will deliver tailored product demos by video call, uncovering each prospect's needs and showing how INFINIT's platform solves them.

  • You will build trusted relationships with business owners and decision-makers over the phone and online, and handle objections with confidence.

  • You will keep the CRM accurate and up to date, and forecast your pipeline reliably.

  • You will work closely with Product and Customer Success to hand over new customers smoothly and feed back what you hear in the market.

  • You will help refine our outbound playbook, messaging and value proposition based on what works.


    • What do you need to be successful in this role?

  • 3+ years of B2B sales experience in a full-cycle or inside sales role, with a proven record of meeting or exceeding quota.

  • Demonstrated experience prospecting your own leads through cold calling and outbound outreach, and closing deals without field visits.

  • Confidence delivering live product demos and running sales conversations by phone and video.

title: Account Manager - DACH
descriptionHtml:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

About the role

This is a builder's role, where you'll own both the technical depth and commercial outcomes for some of ElevenLabs' most exciting customers across the DACH region (Germany, Austria, Switzerland), sitting at the intersection of product, engineering, and revenue.

You'll get ahead of the problem. You'll own the number too: renewals, expansion and cross-sell. Success here means driving real revenue retention and growth for your book of business.

 

What this looks like day to day

You'll run onboarding, enablement, and growth across ElevenLabs' full platform, core speech models, creative tools, and Agents. You'll advise customers on production deployment, not just theory, digging into usage and performance data to catch friction early and keep adoption moving.

title: Account Manager (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Werde Account Manager (m/w/d) mit Fokus Digital Media bei Carwow in München.

Du verkaufst unsere digitalen Mediaprodukte YouTube, Meta und Data an Automobilhersteller, Partner und Mediaagenturen und begleitest die Kampagnen von der Buchung bis zur Aussteuerung.

Du bist dir nicht ganz sicher, ob die Position zu dir passt? Bewirb dich und lass es uns gemeinsam herausfinden.



Unsere Mission

Carwow ist Europas führende Plattform für den Autowechsel. Wir verändern, wie Menschen Autos kaufen, verkaufen und leasen. Mit Technologie, Medien und Automotive Expertise haben wir uns von einer reinen Bewertungsplattform zu einem der größten Online-Marktplätze entwickelt.

Unsere Reichweite geht weit über die eigene Plattform hinaus: 10 Mio. YouTube Abonnenten und mehr als 350 Mio. Online Leser pro Jahr in der Gruppe. Genau diese Reichweite und unsere Daten machen wir jetzt für Werbekunden auch außerhalb von Carwow nutzbar.

Dein Impact @ Carwow

Du baust die Säule Digital Media, Audiences und Data im deutschen OEM & Media Team aus. Unsere Brand Partnerships Manager:innen verkaufen Retail Media auf der Plattform. Du sorgst dafür, dass Carwow auch in den Mediaplänen der Agenturen fest gesetzt ist.

Dafür hast du drei Produkte im Gepäck. Du schnürst daraus Pakete, die zu den Zielen der Partner passen und verbindest sie mit unserem Retail Media Angebot zu einer durchgängigen Media Story bis zum Kauf. So wächst ein noch junger Umsatzstrom zu einem festen Standbein, und du prägst ihn von Anfang an mit.

YouTube: Bewegtbildkampagnen im Carwow Umfeld und mit Carwow Zielgruppen, von Awareness bis Klick

Meta: Kampagnen auf Facebook und Instagram, ausgesteuert auf Menschen, die gerade nachweislich ein Auto suchen

Data: Datenberatung auf Basis der Carwow Daten, verbunden mit unserem Verständnis des deutschen Automarkts

Und neue Produkte: Weitere Formate und Ideen, die wir gerade entwickeln. Du bringst ein, was Kunden und Agenturen brauchen, und führst neue Produkte in den Markt ein


Deine Aufgaben als Account Manager mit Fokus Digital Media

  • Du verantwortest den Umsatz mit YouTube, Meta und Data im deutschen Markt und baust ihn gezielt aus (genau hier brauchst du eine "Hunter Mentalität" im Vertrieb)

  • Du bist erste Ansprechperson für die Mediaagenturen der Automobilhersteller, von den großen Networks bis zu den spezialisierten Häusern, und kennst dort Planung, Einkauf und Strategie

  • Du gewinnst gemeinsam mit unseren Brand Partnerships Manager:innen die Marketing und Mediaverantwortlichen der OEMs für unsere Digitalprodukte

  • Du beantwortest Briefings mit Mediaplänen und Angebote, die sich an den KPIs der Kunden messen lassen, und überzeugst mit starken Pitches

  • Du bringst gewonnene Kampagnen sauber in die Buchung: Angebot, Auftrag, Übergabe an Media Operations und Abstimmung von Assets, Laufzeiten und Tracking

  • Du steuerst laufende Kampagnen gemeinsam mit Media Operations aus, optimierst auf die vereinbarten KPIs, ordnest Reportings für Kunden ein und machst aus guten Ergebnissen Folgebuchungen und Jahresvereinbarungen

  • Du entwickelst mit Produkt, Analytics und Media Operations unsere Angebote weiter und bringst zurück, was Agenturen wirklich brauchen

    ... und du pflegst deine Pipeline und deinen Forecast so, dass wir uns darauf gemeinsam verlassen können

Dein Profil


Hinweis: Niemand erfüllt alle Anforderungen zu 100 %. Wenn du dich stark mit der Rolle identifiziert und Lust auf richtig guten Mediavertrieb hast, freuen wir uns trotzdem auf deine Bewerbung. Denn wir wollen gemeinsam mit dir wachsen.

  • Du bringst mehrere Jahre Erfahrung im digitalen Mediavertrieb mit, zum Beispiel bei einem Vermarkter, Publisher, einer Plattform oder auf Agenturseite

  • Du kennst die deutsche Agenturlandschaft und hast idealerweise ein belastbares Netzwerk in den Agenturen

  • Du hast digitale Kampagnen selbst aufgesetzt und ausgesteuert, idealerweise in DV360 (YouTube) und im Meta Ads Manager, und sprichst über CPM, Reichweite und Conversion so sicher wie über Markenziele

  • Du arbeitest gern mit Daten und kannst aus Zahlen eine Geschichte machen, die ein Kunde versteht und kauft

  • Du präsentierst komplexe Sachverhalte zielgruppengerecht und überzeugend, vor der Planer:in genauso wie vor der Marketingleitung

  • Du arbeitest strukturiert und zuverlässig, auch wenn mehrere Angebote und Buchungen gleichzeitig laufen

  • Du sprichst Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau sowie verhandlungssicheres Englisch

    Benzin im Blut ist kein Muss, Neugier auf die Automobilbranche schon.



Unser Interview Prozess

  • Talent Screen (telefonisch) mit unserem Recruiting Team - ca. 30 Minuten

  • Video Interview (online) mit dem Fachbereich - ca. 30 Minuten

  • Case Study (vor Ort) mit dem Fachbereich - ca. 60 Minuten

  • Final Values & Team Fit (vor Ort oder online) nach Möglichkeit im Anschluss an deine Case Study - ca. 30 Minuten


Und was springt für dich dabei raus?

Bei uns findest du ein innovatives, vielfältiges und lockeres Arbeitsumfeld im Herzen Münchens. Dazu kommen:

  • Ein wettbewerbsfähiges Gehaltspaket mit variablem Anteil

  • 28 Urlaubstage, die mit der Betriebszugehörigkeit auf bis zu 35 Tage steigen, plus Sonderurlaub für Umzüge, Hochzeiten und mehr

  • Eine Bezuschussung der betrieblichen Altersvorsorge

  • Eine vergünstigte Mitgliedschaft im Urban Sports Club

  • ... sowie eine ehrliche Work Life Balance

Vielfalt und Inklusion sind fest in unserer Unternehmenskultur verankert. Wir freuen uns über jede Bewerbung und treffen unsere Entscheidungen fair, transparent und ausschließlich auf Basis von Fähigkeiten, Erfahrung und Potenzial.

descriptionHtml:
Jouw impact bij Movares

Verdiep je in werktuigbouwkundige vraagstukken rond beweegbare bruggen en werk mee aan innovatieve oplossingen.

Dit ga je doen bij Movares

  • kies een technisch, werktuigbouwkundig afstudeeronderwerp uit ons aanbod dat aansluit bij jouw interesses en talent;

  • werk nauw samen met Werktuigbouwkundige specialisten

Tijdens deze afstudeerstage werk je aan een actueel vraagstuk binnen de wereld van beweegbare bruggen. Je kiest een onderwerp dat past bij jouw interesses, zoals de aandrijving van bruggen, verbindingen in constructies of het hergebruik van onderdelen. Het afstudeeronderwerp bespreken wij samen tijdens een kennismakingsgesprek. Je combineert onderzoek met praktijkgerichte adviezen en levert een bijdrage aan een veilige, duurzame en betrouwbare infrastructuur.

Dit ben jij bij Movares

  • je volgt een hbo- of wo(master)-opleiding Werktuigbouwkunde;

  • je toont initiatief, pakt kansen op en neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor je onderzoek;

  • je werkt analytisch, legt verbanden en vertaalt inzichten naar heldere adviezen;

  • je zoekt actief de samenwerking op en deelt kennis met collega's.

Een stage bij Movares is een kickstart van je carrière, en dat heeft verschillende redenen. Zo kun je erop rekenen dat de begeleiding door jouw stagebegeleider, het team waarin je komt te werken én campusrecruiter Noortje op-en-top voor elkaar is. Daarnaast kom je terecht in een groep mede-afstudeerders, allemaal gelijkgestemden. Elk jaar verwelkomt Movares namelijk tussen de 30 en 40 stagiaires. Hen ontmoet je tijdens de maandelijkse bijeenkomsten van Movares Backstage, waar de verbinding met anderen voorop staat. Soms gaan jullie samen lunchen of bezoeken jullie een project. Andere maanden staat er een inhoudelijke sessie op de planning en leer je bijvoorbeeld beter presenteren of adviseren.

En ook als lid van onze jongerenvereniging staan er regelmatig leuke activiteiten in je agenda. Daarnaast kun je elke tweede dinsdag van de maand aanschuiven bij het Café van de Toekomst: een inspiratiesessie waarbij je samen met je collega’s wordt bijgepraat over onderwerpen en projecten die in onze organisatie spelen. En dat is nog niet alles: je kunt gebruikmaken van onze eigen Academy met ruim 3.000 verschillende leerlijnen, trainingen en e-learningmodules.

Dit krijg je bij Movares

Bij Movares werk je mee aan een uitdagende opdracht met volop kansen om jezelf te ontwikkelen. Er hangt een leuke en gezellige sfeer. Je krijgt een kijkje in de keuken van een toonaangevend advies- en ingenieursbureau, volop ruimte voor eigen initiatief en goede begeleiding. De duur en startdatum zijn in overleg nader te bepalen. Verder krijg je:

  • een aantrekkelijke vergoeding van €550 op basis van een fulltime dienstverband;

  • ruimte voor het vinden van jouw ideale werk-privé-balans;

  • leuke collega’s en een afstudeerplek in hartje Utrecht.

En er is méér. Want afstuderen bij Movares betekent ook:

  • bijdragen aan een schone wereld, omdat je stageloopt bij het eerste bedrijf in Nederland met een Zero Waste-certificaat;

  • lid worden van Young Movares, de jongerenvereniging waar je leert van én met andere jonge collega’s.

Jouw team bij Movares

Voor jou als Afstudeerstagiair(e) Werktuigbouwkunde is er plek op onze afdeling Civiele Constructies in team Werktuigbouw.

Je komt terecht in een hecht team van betrokken specialisten die werken aan beweegbare bruggen en andere complexe kunstwerken. Binnen het team combineren we diepgaande technische kennis met nieuwsgierigheid en innovatiekracht. We werken nauw samen met collega's uit de disciplines Staalbouw, Beton en Bruginstallaties. Daardoor kijk je ook verder dan je eigen vakgebied en leer je hoe integrale oplossingen tot stand komen. De sfeer is open en toegankelijk: collega's helpen elkaar graag, delen kennis actief en geven je de ruimte om ideeën uit te werken. Samen werken we aan een veilige, duurzame en betrouwbare infrastructuur voor Nederland.

title: AI Deployment Strategist, Science - EMEA
descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

As an AI Deployment Strategist with Science Focus, you will drive the adoption and deployment of Mistral's AI solutions for science-heavy projects, working closely with customers from strategic vision to production implementation in domains like computer vision, robotics, and embodied AI.

This role sits at the intersection of deep technical expertise, business strategy, and hands-on deployment, ensuring our customers achieve transformative outcomes in specialized AI applications.

You will partner with senior executives to design AI roadmaps for science-driven use cases, collaborate with the Applied AI and Research teams to deliver solutions in production, and ensure seamless transitions from presales to postsales. Your work will directly contribute to expanding Mistral's capabilities in cutting-edge AI domains.

This role is ideal for those who thrive in a fast-paced environment, enjoy solving complex technical challenges in specialized domains, and are passionate about turning AI science into real-world impact.

What You Will Do

Strategic Discovery & Vision Setting

  • Lead executive-level workshops to identify science-specific business challenges and opportunities where Mistral's AI can drive step-change improvements in vision, robotics, embodied AI, and other specialized domains.

  • Co-create AI adoption roadmaps with customers, articulating the "art of the possible" in science applications and a clear path to value.

  • Collaborate with Account Executives to develop business cases for technically complex, science-driven solutions, quantify ROI, and align with customer objectives.

AI Solution Design & Deployment (Science Focus)

  • Architect end-to-end AI solutions for specialized domains, integrating Mistral's models and platform into science-specific workflows and technical infrastructure.

  • Partner with the Applied AI and Research teams to design, prototype, and deploy science-focused AI solutions in production, ensuring scalability and impact.

  • Own the execution of science-heavy pilot projects and proofs-of-value, demonstrating the potential of our technology in specialized domains and paving the way for full-scale deployment.

Value Realization & Customer Success

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to customers on science-driven AI strategies, ensuring they maximize the value of their investment in Mistral's specialized capabilities.

  • Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) tied to technical and business outcomes in science domains, and communicate progress to executive sponsors.

  • Proactively identify expansion opportunities within accounts for science applications, building on initial successes to drive long-term partnerships.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Act as the bridge between customers and Mistral's Research and Applied AI teams, synthesizing feedback to influence science-focused product and research roadmaps.

  • Develop reusable assets, best practices, and playbooks for science domain deployments to scale go-to-market efforts.

  • Travel (~30-60%) to foster deep client relationships and support on-site deployment of specialized solutions.

What We're Looking For

  • 2+ years in a client-facing technical role (e.g., data science consulting, research engineering, or technical sales) with strong background in AI science domains (computer vision, robotics, embodied AI, etc.)

  • You hold a degree in a scientific field (e.g., Computer Science, Robotics, Physics, Mathematics) - PhD is a plus

  • Deep technical knowledge of AI/ML/Data Science with specialization in science domains, and the credibility to advise highly technical audiences

  • Hands-on experience building and deploying science-focused AI applications (Python, C++, or similar) to demonstrate value in specialized domains

  • Strong business acumen and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into business value

  • Executive presence and communication skills to influence senior stakeholders (VP, C-level) on technically advanced solutions

  • Hands-on experience building and deploying AI applications (Python) in science domains

  • Resilient, results-driven, and comfortable leading through influence in a highly technical, collaborative environment

  • Experience with research-to-production transitions and working with research teams is a plus

Why This Role Matters You will play a pivotal role in shaping how enterprises adopt and deploy AI, ensuring Mistral’s solutions deliver measurable impact. By partnering with the Applied AI team, you’ll help turn strategic visions into production-ready solutions, making Mistral an indispensable partner for our customers.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

As a member of our AI model team, you will drive innovation in model serving and inference architectures for advanced AI systems. Your work will focus on optimizing model deployment and inference strategies to deliver highly responsive, efficient, and scalable performance across real-world applications. You will work on a wide spectrum of systems, ranging from resource-efficient models designed for limited hardware environments to complex, multi-modal architectures that integrate data such as text, images, and audio.

We expect you to have deep expertise in designing and optimizing model serving pipelines and inference frameworks as well as a strong background in advanced model architectures. You will adopt a hands-on, research-driven approach to develop, test, and implement novel serving strategies and inference algorithms. Your responsibilities include engineering robust inference pipelines, establishing comprehensive performance metrics, and identifying and resolving bottlenecks in production environments. The ultimate goal is to enable high-throughput, low-latency, low-memory footprint, and scalable AI performance that delivers tangible value in dynamic, real-world scenarios.

Responsibilities

  • Design and deploy state-of-the-art model serving architectures that deliver high throughput and low latency while optimizing memory usage. Ensure these pipelines run efficiently across diverse environments, including resource-constrained devices and edge platforms. Establish clear performance targets such as reduced latency, improved token response, and minimized memory footprint.

  • Build, run, and monitor controlled inference tests in both simulated and live production environments. Track key performance indicators such as response latency, throughput, memory consumption, and error rates, with special attention to metrics specific to resource-constrained devices. Document iterative results and compare outcomes against established benchmarks to validate performance across platforms.

  • Identify and prepare high-quality test datasets and simulation scenarios tailored to real-world deployment challenges, specifically those encountered on low-resource devices. Set measurable criteria to ensure that these resources effectively evaluate model performance, latency, and memory utilization under various operational conditions.

  • Analyze computational efficiency and diagnose bottlenecks in the serving pipeline by monitoring both processing and memory metrics. Address issues such as suboptimal batch processing, network delays, and high memory usage to optimize the serving infrastructure for scalability and reliability on resource-constrained systems.

  • Work closely with cross-functional teams to integrate optimized serving and inference frameworks into production pipelines designed for edge and on-device applications. Define clear success metrics such as improved real-world performance, low error rates, robust scalability, optimal memory usage and ensure continuous monitoring and iterative refinements for sustained improvements.


  • A degree in Computer Science or related field. Ideally PhD in NLP, Machine Learning, or a related field, complemented by a solid track record in AI R&D (with good publications in A* conferences).

  • Must have knowledge of Metal Shading Language (MSL). You should be comfortable writing custom compute shaders from scratch.

  • Proven experience in low-level kernel optimizations and inference optimization on mobile devices is essential. Your contributions should have led to measurable improvements in inference latency, throughput, and memory footprint for domain-specific applications, particularly on resource-constrained devices and edge platforms.

  • A deep understanding of modern model serving architectures and inference optimization techniques is required. This includes state-of-the-art methods for achieving low-latency, high-throughput performance, and efficient memory management in diverse, resource-constrained deployment scenarios.

  • Must have strong expertise in writing GPU kernels for mobile devices (i.e., smartphones) as well as a deep understanding of model serving frameworks and engines. Practical experience in developing and deploying end-to-end inference pipelines, from optimizing models for efficient serving to integrating these solutions on resource-constrained devices is required.

  • Demonstrated ability to apply empirical research to overcome challenges in model serving, such as latency optimization, computational bottlenecks, and memory constraints. You should be proficient in designing robust evaluation frameworks and iterating on optimization strategies to continuously push the boundaries of inference performance and system efficiency.

  • Distributed Inference Systems: Designing and optimizing high-performance inference engines using techniques like Tensor Parallelism, Pipeline Parallelism, and Expert Parallelism to handle massive models on GPU clusters.

  • Deep understanding of the math and structure behind Diffusion Models and Vision Transformers

  • Understanding of Pruning, Quantization, Flash attention, KV Cache, Speculative Decoding (Eagle) etc.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @tether.to or @tether.io

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

title: AI Software Engineer (F/H/NB)
descriptionHtml:
SFEIR est un cabinet d'expertise technologique spécialisé dans la conception, l'architecture et l'industrialisation de solutions numériques sur-mesure. Nous accompagnons les organisations dans leurs transformations les plus complexes en combinant la rigueur du Software Craftsmanship avec la maîtrise des technologies d'avenir. Convaincus que la souveraineté numérique est un enjeu stratégique majeur, nous concevons des architectures sécurisées, performantes et indépendantes, portées par des partenariats solides avec des acteurs clés comme SENS et Scaleway. Acteur de référence sur l'intelligence artificielle, nous faisons évoluer les standards d'ingénierie modernes. À travers notre plateforme GenAI RAISE et notre statut de partenaire Anthropic Preferred (au sein du Claude Partner Network), nous plaçons le Context Engineering et l'IA générative au cœur de nos pratiques.

Nos chiffres clés :

  • 950 consultants passionnés par la tech et augmentés par l’IA.

  • 8 agences en France, au Luxembourg et en Belgique.

  • Partenaire Anthropic Select au sein du Claude Partner Network.

  • 15 ans de partenariat avec Google Cloud, AWS, Microsoft, Databricks, Confluent...

  • +5000 personnes formées par an via le SFEIR Institute.

Rejoindre SFEIR, c'est intégrer un collectif où la culture technique prévaut. Nous offrons des trajectoires de carrière dédiées aux experts (Individual Contributor / IC), te permettant de progresser en haute maîtrise technique sans devoir basculer vers du management organisationnel. Nous intégrons l'IA à nos propres pratiques d'ingénierie (utilisation quotidienne de RAISE et Claude Code) pour automatiser les tâches à faible valeur ajoutée et concentrer nos efforts sur la conception d'architectures résilientes.

▪️ À propos du poste

Tu conçois et déploies des agents IA et systèmes agentiques complets exécutant des processus métier de bout en bout : support client avancé, recherche multi-sources, opérations IT, ainsi que des cas d'usage avancés liés à l'industrie du futur et à la continuité digitale (ex. traçabilité des exigences, maintenance prédictive, continuité de l'ingénierie et jumeaux numériques). Tu sais aussi bien développer des agents sur-mesure en code que configurer des agents via des plateformes low-code/no-code avec des plateformes type Gemini Enterprise.

Ton terrain d'action combine maîtrise technique du cycle de vie logiciel (SDLC) et compréhension fonctionnelle fine des enjeux métiers. Tu orchestres l'autonomie des agents, la planification, le choix des outils et la mémoire, tout en garantissant la fiabilité, la gouvernance et le respect des garde-fous.

Les missions :

  • Analyser et appréhender les besoins et processus métiers avec une vision fonctionnelle claire pour définir les cas d'usage d'automatisation et la répartition des tâches (autonomie agentique vs validation humaine).

  • Concevoir et développer des systèmes agentiques complets (mono ou multi-agents), en choisissant l'approche adaptée : développement sur-mesure ou programmation/configuration d'agents low-code/no-code (Gemini Enterprise, Vertex AI Agent Builder, AWS).

  • Construire les outils des agents : function calling, intégration d’API et de systèmes d’information, création et consommation de serveurs MCP, workflows asynchrones et longue durée.

  • Maîtriser la fiabilité : gestion des erreurs et des reprises, boucles de contrôle, limites de budget et de pas, comportement face à l’imprévu.

  • Évaluer les agents : jeux de scénarios, analyse des trajectoires, taux de réussite des tâches, LLM-as-judge, tests de non-régression à chaque changement de prompt, d’outil ou de modèle.

  • Observer en production : traces détaillées, coûts par tâche, détection des dérives et des boucles, tableaux de bord.

  • Sécuriser l’autonomie : permissions minimales sur les outils, protection contre la prompt injection, isolation des actions sensibles, validation humaine, traçabilité, conformité (RGPD, AI Act).

  • S'intégrer dans le cycle de vie logiciel (SDLC) complet et déployer sur le cloud (Google Cloud / Vertex AI) avec intégration CI/CD et gestion des coûts.

  • Partager : documenter les patterns, former les équipes clientes, contribuer aux publications et événements SFEIR.

▪️ Le profil idéal

  • 5 ans d’expérience en développement logiciel (hors stage et alternance) avec une vision transverse du SDLC et une première expérience solide sur des projets LLM / IA
  • Pratique démontrée de la création d'agents IA : développement custom (frameworks/code) ou création via des environnements low-code/no-code (Gemini Enterprise, AWS,...)
  • Connaissance de MCP et des protocoles d’interopérabilité entre agents (A2A)
  • Compréhension fine des modes d’échec des agents : dérive, boucles, mauvais choix d’outil, perte de contexte
  • Solide maîtrise des API, de l’asynchrone et des architectures événementielles
  • Rigueur d’ingénierie : tests, observabilité, code relu
  • Aisance relationnelle et bon niveau fonctionnel pour échanger avec les équipes métiers, comprendre leurs enjeux et leur expliquer les possibilités et limites des agents IA

Un plus

  • Expérience d’évaluation d’agents et d’observabilité (OpenTelemetry, Langfuse…)
  • Connaissance de la méthodologie BMAD
  • Google Cloud (Vertex AI, Cloud Run, Gemini),
  • Sensibilité sécurité : modèles de menaces sur les agents, gestion des identités et des permissions
  • Notions de RAG, vues comme un outil de l’agent
  • Contributions open source, side projects agentiques, talks

▪️ L'ancrage Toulousain

L'agence SFEIR Toulouse regroupe une équipe à taille humaine de plus de 10 expert·e·s de haut niveau. Tu y bénéficies de la proximité et de l'agilité d'une structure locale, tout en adossant tes projets à la solidité financière et technique d'un grand groupe. Tu participes activement à la vie de la scène tech locale (DevFest Toulouse, SFEIR Talks, afterworks) et tu peux intégrer le programme AI Champions pour piloter la R&D et l'intégration des LLMs au niveau régional.

▪️ Tes conditions de travail

  • Organisation : 2 à 3 jours de télétravail par semaine.
  • Équipement : Laptop haut de gamme au choix (MacBook Pro ou Dell Precision dernière génération).
  • Package : Rémunération fixe attractive, prime de vacances, accord d'intéressement, forfait mobilités durables, mutuelle et titres-restaurant.

▪️ Le processus de recrutement

  1. Échange RH : Alignement sur ton parcours, tes attentes et les opportunités SFEIR.
  2. Session Technique ("PlayOffs") : Évaluation pratique en pair-programming (Algo et GenAI) avec deux Sfeirians.
  3. Échange Métier & Projection : Discussion approfondie sur les cas d'usage, les missions cibles et le contexte client à Toulouse.
  4. Entretien Final : Échange stratégique avec le Directeur d'Agence.

Prêt·e à passer au niveau supérieur sans renoncer à tes valeurs ? Postule et viens rencontrer le collectif !

  • Ideen praktisch erproben: Du setzt Prototypen um, probierst sie am Rudergerät aus und entwickelst gute Ansätze mit dem Team weiter.

  • Qualität von Anfang an: Du schreibst nachvollziehbaren Code, beteiligst dich an Reviews und Tests und behebst Fehler nachhaltig.

  • KI sinnvoll einsetzen: Du nutzt KI-gestützte Entwicklungswerkzeuge für Ideen, Code, Tests und Fehleranalyse. Du verstehst und prüfst die Ergebnisse, bevor sie ins Produkt gelangen.

Deine Rolle als Scrum Master

Du verbindest deine technische Arbeit mit der Verantwortung dafür, dass unsere Projekte gemeinsam vorankommen. Als Scrum Master koordinierst du die Zusammenarbeit im Softwareteam und mit externen Entwicklungsagenturen. Du arbeitest eng mit CTO Christopher Klabunde zusammen; disziplinarische Personalführung gehört nicht zur Rolle.

  • Du bringst interne Entwicklung und externe Partner in eine gemeinsame Planung und sorgst für klare Zuständigkeiten, nächste Schritte und nachvollziehbare Abnahmekriterien.

  • Du bereitest agile Abstimmungen vor und moderierst sie, zum Beispiel Sprint Planning, kurze tägliche Abstimmungen, Reviews und Retrospektiven – passend zu unseren Projekten.

  • Du behältst Abhängigkeiten, Termine und offene Entscheidungen im Blick, sprichst Hindernisse früh an und hilfst dem Team, sie zu lösen.

  • Du sorgst dafür, dass Ergebnisse zusammengeführt, gemeinsam getestet und für einen verlässlichen Release vorbereitet werden.

Wenn du bereits Scrum-Master- oder Projektkoordinationserfahrung hast, kannst du sie direkt einbringen. Wenn du neu in der Rolle bist, wachsen wir mit dir hinein: Chris und das Team unterstützen dich dabei. Eine Scrum-Master-Zertifizierung ist ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung.

Das bringst du mit

  • Programmiergrundlagen und Lust auf native Android-Entwicklung mit Kotlin oder Java. Praktische Android-Erfahrung ist willkommen; wenn du dich neu in Android einarbeitest, interessieren uns dein bisheriger Lernweg und deine Motivation.

  • Du kannst erklären, wie du technische Aufgaben angehst. Eigene Apps, Lernprojekte, Hochschulprojekte, Praktika und Werkstudententätigkeiten zählen genauso wie berufliche Erfahrung.

  • Ein gutes Verständnis von Programmiergrundlagen und Interesse daran, verständliche, wartbare und getestete Software zu entwickeln.

  • Offenheit für KI-unterstützte App-Entwicklung. Wenn du solche Werkzeuge bereits ausprobiert hast, interessiert uns, was gut funktioniert hat und wie du die Ergebnisse geprüft hast.

  • Eigeninitiative, Freude an Zusammenarbeit und Lust, dich in ein bestehendes Produkt einzuarbeiten und schrittweise Verantwortung zu übernehmen.

  • Gutes Englisch in Wort und Schrift ist für den technischen Austausch im Team erforderlich. Deutschkenntnisse sind ein großer Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung.

  • Bereitschaft, regelmäßig in Königs Wusterhausen vor Ort zu arbeiten, um Funktionen am Gerät zu entwickeln und mit dem Team abzustimmen.

Ein Studium der Informatik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung, eine passende Ausbildung oder vergleichbare Kenntnisse sind eine gute Grundlage.

Mit Erfahrung oder am Anfang: Wir wollen dich kennenlernen

Du hast schon mehrere Jahre Erfahrung in diesem Bereich? Super – bring deine Ideen und deinen Blick von außen ein. Du stehst noch am Anfang oder hast bisher keine Berufserfahrung in diesem Bereich? Auch das ist in Ordnung. Wenn du für unser Produkt brennst, technische Grundlagen mitbringst und dich schnell in neue Themen einarbeitest, möchten wir dich kennenlernen.

In beiden Fällen ist es unsere Aufgabe, dich gut ins Team zu integrieren und dir Wissen, Werkzeuge und Unterstützung für einen erfolgreichen Start bereitzustellen. Gemeinsam mit Chris und dem Team lernst du unser Produkt und unsere Abläufe kennen. Aufgaben und Verantwortung stimmen wir auf deinen Erfahrungsstand ab und entwickeln sie mit dir weiter.

Zusätzliche Pluspunkte

  • Erfahrung mit Firebase als Backend für Apps, zum Beispiel bei Benutzeranmeldung, Datenspeicherung oder serverseitiger Logik.

  • Erfahrung in der iOS-Entwicklung, idealerweise mit Swift oder SwiftUI.

  • Kenntnisse in Git, automatisierten Tests, CI/CD oder der Anbindung von APIs und Geräten.

Darauf kannst du dich freuen

  • Ein eigenes Produkt, das du direkt ausprobieren kannst, und sichtbaren Einfluss auf das Training unserer Kunden.

  • Ein kleines Softwareteam, direkte Zusammenarbeit mit CTO Christopher Klabunde und kurze Wege zwischen Idee, Entwicklung und Test.

  • Raum für eigene Ideen und fachliche Entwicklung – mit Aufgaben, die zu deinem Erfahrungsstand passen und mit dir wachsen.

  • Unbefristete Vollzeitstelle mit 40 Stunden pro Woche und 28 Urlaubstagen im Jahr.

  • 50.000 bis 65.000 € brutto pro Jahr, abhängig von deinen relevanten Fähigkeiten und Erfahrungen.

  • Arbeitsplatz Zur Heide 10 in Königs Wusterhausen bei Berlin. Ein bis zwei Tage Homeoffice pro Woche sind nach Absprache möglich.

Dein Arbeitsplatz bei Berlin

Unser Standort ist Zur Heide 10 in Königs Wusterhausen. Der Bahnhof Königs Wusterhausen ist mit der S-Bahn S46 und Regionalzügen direkt an Berlin angebunden. Die Strecke vom Bahnhof zu uns lässt sich mit dem Fahrrad zurücklegen. Vor Ort entwickelst und testest du direkt am Produkt; ein bis zwei Tage Homeoffice pro Woche sind nach Absprache möglich.

Einfach bewerben

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf auf Deutsch oder Englisch. Ein klassisches Anschreiben brauchst du nicht. Ein GitHub-Link oder eine App ist willkommen, aber keine Voraussetzung.

Zum Einstieg lernen wir uns in einem kurzen Onlinegespräch kennen. Danach schauen wir gemeinsam auf deine bisherigen Erfahrungen, deinen Lernweg und die Aufgaben bei AUGLETICS.

English-speaking applicants are welcome. English is required; German is a strong plus. You will develop Android software for our connected rowing machines and app, working closely with our CTO and a small team. Early-career developers with practical projects are welcome. Based in Königs Wusterhausen near Berlin, with one to two home-office days per week by agreement.
