title: Applied AI Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Engelhart was founded in 2013 by BTG Pactual Group as a commodities trading company. Our business model is “asset light” and highly diversified – giving us the ability to adapt effectively and nimbly to changing market conditions. We have assembled successful multidisciplinary teams, leveraging advanced fundamental analysis with deep quantitative and weather research capabilities.  Our activities are underpinned by strong risk management practices and by powerful technology and operational excellence. We have exceptional teams with diverse global backgrounds and decades of experience, and are driven by a highly collaborative culture, across products and competencies.

In 2024, Engelhart acquired Trailstone, a global energy trading and technology company. The acquisition provides us with new expertise, analytics and proprietary technology which is being used to provide risk management and optimisation services to help maximise the value of our clients’ renewable power. The acquisition also expanded Engelhart’s capabilities into physical natural gas across North America, a critical fuel to support the energy transition.

Our talented and experienced individuals work together according to its four company values: Performance, Agility, Collaboration, Entrepreneurship.

About the Role

As a member of the Tech Data, AI & UX team allocated to European & Asian Power Trading in Berlin, you will build the services, infrastructure, and AI & data platforms that power the business, enabling teams to improve their data-driven decisions and connect innovative products.

As part of this Joint Venture, the Applied AI Engineer will help to evolve ECTP’s AI & Agentic platforms – a strategic, firm-wide initiative led by the Tech Data, AI & UX team. The role provides hands-on exposure to the cutting edge of enterprise AI, working alongside experienced data engineer, architects and quant developers in a live, production-grade environment.

You will work closely with trading desk and Technology teams to build core agentic infrastructure, integrate tooling via AWS Lambda and MCP servers, develop agent skills, and configure knowledge bases across user, chat, agent, and application contexts. You will explore and evaluate open-source and proprietary connectors within the rapidly evolving LLM and Generative AI ecosystem, and help roll out individual productivity tools such as Microsoft Copilot and Claude Code. All solutions will be hosted securely within Engelhart’s internal network, with models deployed in a dedicated VPC and governed access to firm data, with a strong preference for AWS-native and Bedrock-based architectures.

This will be a full-time role, owning the following responsibilities:

  • Collaborate with the trading desk to supercharge their research capabilities and data-driven insights by extending Engelhart's core AI and agentic platform to address new trading desk requirements.
  • Assist in the set-up and configuration of core agentic AI infrastructure, including orchestration layers, agent runtimes, and supporting services, deployed securely within Engelhart’s AWS VPC.
  • Build and maintain agent tooling integrations via AWS Lambda functions and MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers, enabling agents to interact with firm data, APIs, and internal systems.
  • Develop agent skills and configure knowledge bases, including document stores, vector databases (e.g. Postgres with pgvector, AWS Bedrock Knowledge Bases), and retrieval pipelines for user, chat, agent, and application contexts.
  • Research, evaluate, and help integrate open-source and proprietary accelerators, connectors, and frameworks (e.g. LangChain, LlamaIndex, n8n, etc) into the platform, assessing fitness for purpose in a regulated, IP-sensitive environment.
  • Support the deployment and end-user adoption of individual AI productivity tools, including Microsoft Copilot and Claude Code, ensuring secure configuration and appropriate access controls within Engelhart’s internal network.
  • Contribute to technical documentation, architecture diagrams, and internal knowledge sharing on AI tooling, design decisions, and implementation patterns to support team learning and continuity.
  • Collaborate with engineers, data scientists, and business stakeholders to iteratively test and improve agentic workflows, gathering feedback and translating it into technical improvements.

About You

This person will be a technically minded and genuinely curious person who is excited about the transformative potential of AI and wants to go beyond surface-level tooling – you want to understand how things work and help build them. You are comfortable navigating ambiguity, energised by fast-moving technology landscapes, and take pride in writing clean, well-structured code. You thrive in collaborative environments and are motivated by the opportunity to contribute to something that has real, visible impact within a live business setting.

The following education, experiences and skills are essential for application:

  • Background in Computer Science, Software Engineering, AI, Data Science, or related technical undergraduate degree.
  • A genuine passion for AI, Large Language Models, and Generative AI. Not just as a user, but with curiosity about how they work and how to build with them.
  • Proficient in Python, with hands-on experience writing scripts, working with APIs, or building small applications – whether through coursework, personal projects, or hackathons.
  • Familiarity with cloud concepts or services (preference for AWS), containerisation (Docker), or REST APIs – even if only at an introductory or project level.
  • A proactive, self-directed learning style – able to research unfamiliar technologies, synthesise documentation, and form a view on trade-offs with limited guidance.
  • Good communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical colleagues, and to work effectively in a small, fast-moving team.
  • A collaborative, team-oriented mindset, with the confidence to contribute ideas, ask questions, and engage actively with engineers, data scientists, and business users.
  • An organised approach to work, with attention to detail, a strong sense of ownership, and the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Comfortable working with ambiguity and rapid change, with the resilience to iterate quickly, adapt to new findings, and thrive in a technology landscape that evolves week to week.

In addition, the following criteria is not required, but highly desirable for this role:

  • Foundational knowledge of energy trading markets, including core concepts like balancing mechanism operations, Power Purchase Agreements (PPAs), and Virtual Power Plants (VPPs).
  • Prior exposure to LLM frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar; experience with vector databases (e.g. pgvector, Pinecone, Chroma); or familiarity with AWS Bedrock, SageMaker, or equivalent managed AI services.
  • Experience with version control (Git) and basic understanding of CI/CD pipelines or infrastructure-as-code (e.g. AWS CloudFormation, CDK).
  • Understanding of prompt engineering techniques, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), or multi-agent system design patterns.
  • Participation in AI/ML hackathons, open-source contributions, personal projects involving LLMs or automation, or active engagement with the AI development community (e.g. Hugging Face, GitHub, LangChain forums).
  • Portuguese as a second language.

What we offer

  • Competitive compensation and participation in Engelhart’s discretionary bonus plan.
  • 28 days of annual holiday entitlement plus Berlin public holidays.
  • €3,000 per year contribution to a private pension scheme on your behalf.
  • €20 monthly subsidy towards BVG tickets.
  • €25 monthly subsidy towards ClassPass membership.
  • A subsidy for German language courses to help you immerse yourself in the local culture.
  • A sociable working environment with an open, international culture.

We believe in inclusivity and are therefore dedicated to ensuring all employees – across gender identity, race, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, life experience, background and more – feel welcome and included in the company. We promote diversity because we believe it is essential to our ability to think holistically.

title: Applied AI Engineer
descriptionHtml:
TLDR: We’re looking for top 1%, high agency, AI-forward engineers to be part of our early team at Resonance. We have recently raised one of the largest ever European seed rounds, with investment from Anthropic and Hg Capital, to deploy AI into the economy and rebuild businesses for the AI era. You’ll work at the frontier and solve real problems in an environment that champions ownership, autonomy and innovation at pace.

Who we are

Resonance is an applied AI company. We have recently raised one of the largest ever European seed rounds, with investment from Anthropic and Hg Capital. Our mission is to close the AI diffusion gap and rebuild businesses for the AI era. We're looking to hire Europe’s elite AI talent.

Why now

We believe the economic diffusion of AI is the major challenge of the next decade. Foundation models are advancing far faster than organisations can absorb them; the bottleneck is embedding AI deeply into the core processes of a company to drive an inflection in pace and create organisational advantage. Europe is falling behind on AI, and we exist to help its businesses build real, defensible advantage from it rather than simply adopting it.

The role

As an Applied AI Engineer, you’ll build the production AI systems behind Resonance’s client engagements, driving a dramatic acceleration in productivity or a step change in growth for our key clients. You will work at the AI frontier alongside Senior AI Engineers, owning features, integrations and evals end to end. You’ll build and ship agentic systems, from agents and MCP servers into client systems to retrieval and the product around them, working across the stack from data pipelines and the AI layer to the client’s core systems and the interfaces people use. You’ll build evals and observability from day one, take features from first prototype to production, and deploy and extend what we build inside client environments, shipping at pace with the latest AI coding tools. You’ll grow with the firm by contributing to Resonance’s own AI products and shared platform, turning what you learn on each build into reusable components, and taking on more ownership as you grow.

What we’re looking for: You have extreme agency and a bias for action, thrive on ambiguity, and are AI-obsessed, getting hands-on with new models and tools the day they hit the market. You typically have up to four years building software at a startup, a scale-up, a fast-moving product team or your own company. You write production Python or TypeScript, have shipped software with an LLM at its core, at work or on your own projects, and have iterated on prompts, agent loops and evals. You’re at home with messy real-world data, APIs and SQL, you ship fast without cutting corners, and you enjoy solving problems with technical and non-technical people. You have consistently been among the top performers in high-performing environments, at university or at work. Forward deployed experience, AI side projects or a company you founded are a plus.

What we offer: Competitive total compensation plus equity. Most engineers get one shot at a startup. Here you build many products, not one: our own AI products and platform, and several production AI systems a year across industries. You’ll learn fast alongside people who have embedded AI into 50+ businesses, with scope that grows as fast as your impact. Europe is falling behind on AI, and every build moves another European business to the right side of the productivity chasm. As one of our early joiners, you’ll shape how we build, operate and grow.

Logistics: London, 3+ days a week in the office or at client sites, mostly in the UK and Europe. English is our working language. We can sponsor visas for eligible candidates, and start dates are flexible.

Apply

Send your CV, your GitHub profile and a short note on the AI system you're proudest of shipping and the impact it delivered.

We hire people from every background and judge them on what they've built. If you don't tick every box, apply anyway.

Resonance is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex or sexual orientation. If you need adjustments at any stage, tell us and we'll make them.

title: Applied Science - Time Series
descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

About The Job

Mistral AI is seeking Applied Scientists and Research Engineers focused on time series. You will design, train, and deploy state-of-the-art time-series foundation models, and apply them to the most demanding forecasting problems in industry, from power grids and plants to trading desks.

Timestral, our family of time-series foundation models, ranked first on amongst all benchmarks at release (tech report). The role has two sides: building the next generations of Timestral with our Science team, and taking them into production with our industrial and financial clients, adapted to their data. Working cross-functionally with both external and internal science, engineering, and product teams you will deliver high-impact AI solutions. We are made of researchers, engineers, product builders, ex-founders who love tackling the most complex real world problems in the industry.

What you will do

  • Run pre-training, post-training and deploy state of the art time-series foundation models on clusters with thousands of GPUs.

  • Generate and curate large-scale time-series datasets, real and synthetic, and build evaluators and benchmarks for forecasting and other time-series tasks.

  • Push the frontier of Timestral: architectures, training recipes, scaling, and new capabilities such as anomaly detection, classification and embeddings.

  • Fine-tune and adapt Timestral on client data, in the cloud or on-premise, and benchmark it against the client's existing models.

  • Develop the necessary tools and frameworks to facilitate data generation, model training, evaluation and deployment.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to tackle complex use cases, including agents that combine Timestral with Mistral LLMs.

  • Manage research projects and communications with client research teams.

About you

  • Fluent in English with excellent communication skills, at ease explaining complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Expert with PyTorch or JAX.

  • Solid knowledge of modern deep learning and large language models: architectures, pre-training, post-training and evaluation.

  • Experience pre-training or fine-tuning time-series foundation models or large transformer models at scale.

  • Strong background in time-series modelling: probabilistic forecasting, multivariate series and covariates, and classical baselines (statistical models, gradient boosting).

  • Not afraid of contributing to a big codebase; finds their way around independently with little guidance.

  • Writes clean, readable, high-performance, fault-tolerant Python code.

  • Doesn't need roadmaps: moves independently and is comfortable with uncertainty.

  • Low-ego, collaborative and eager to learn.

  • Track record of success through personal projects, professional projects or academia.

Nice to have

  • Ex-founder or builder

  • PhD / Master in a relevant field (Machine Learning, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Physics). Exceptional candidates from other backgrounds welcome.

  • Research on time-series foundation models: pre-training, scaling, synthetic data or evaluation.

  • Hands-on experience training or fine-tuning LLMs, building agents and tool use, or models that combine text and time series.

  • Industry experience in energy, industrial operations, telecom or finance, or experience deploying models for industrial clients.

  • Experience working on large code bases or large machine learning models at scale.

  • Contributions to a large open-source or industry codebase.

  • Publications in top academic journals or conferences.

  • Enjoys improving existing code: typing, tests, CI pipelines.

descriptionHtml:
Advise. Invest. Build. Meet ALAIKA — a new kind of Financial Services firm — globally scaling, headquartered in Munich. The work is hard. The bar is high.Partner in 7-9 years possible, for the ones who can keep up and actually build a business themselves on our platform.

  • Mindset. "Not possible" is part of your vocabulary → We hire people who always find a way. 

Still there? Then ALAIKA might be for you. 

At ALAIKA, our vision is to build the future of Financial Services with three brands under one roof — Advisory (Strategy Consulting), Capital (Private Equity), Building (Company Builder). Right now, we are in the midst of building our trojan horse ALAIKA Advisory. 

The ambition: building the leading Financial-Services-specific entrepreneurial holding — Fortune 500 access, PE discipline, Silicon Valley technology-depth and thinking. Three networks that compound and multiply.

Founded in October 2022 by Johanna von Geyr (build-up and led Financial Services Practice for a NASDAQ-listed strategy consultancy) and Harald Braunstein (serial entrepreneur with exits incl. IPO), we bring together deep functional domain expertise and networks in global Financial Services, with a proven track record in building, scaling, and investing in leading software product companies.  

Curious what ALAIKA is all about? Explore our website and introduction deck.  

Join the movement — apply now. 

The role and what you will work on 

  • Advise. Take on the most pressing strategic and technology challenges of the world’s leading financial services companies — across Strategy, Data & AI, and Cyber. In the room with decision-makers from day one. 
  • Own. Own your deliverables end-to-end. You are not support staff for the partnership.

  • Sell. Drive business development from day one — no waiting for seniority, no permission needed. At ALAIKA, building the business is not a privilege reserved for managers and partners. It is an expectation.

“Show me an athlete who did well academically. An athlete because they know what it takes to win and they have had to experience loss.” 

— Kenneth C. Griffin, Founder of Citadel 

You will work alongside intrinsically driven people chasing an uncapped career — people who do "what it takes". You fear "being one more number stuck in middle management". 

Your goal is to make it to the top: at ALAIKA itself, at a leading investment or financial services firm, or in a company you build yourself — ALAIKA can help with that too. 

  • Book-smart. Strong academic foundation. Think in structures, not gut feel. 
  • Street-smart. Read the room fast. Prioritise ruthlessly. Grasp commercial reality. 
  • People-smart. Communicate with precision — clear, direct, persuasive. Build trust across functions and seniority. 
  • Athlete performance mindset. High aspirations. Grit. Learn faster than the environment changes. 
  • Entrepreneurial guts. Self-confident achiever. Act first, apologise later — speed is everything. Take full ownership of work normally reserved for far more senior profiles. 

What you bring 

  • Background. Top 10–20% of your class at a top-tier university. Analytical field — CS, Math, Physics, Finance, or equivalent rigour. 
  • Experience. 6-12 months in a high-pressure, results-driven environment — top strategy consultancy, PE/VC-backed company, fast-growing tech, or demanding corporate financial services role. Hands-on Data & AI experience is a plus.

title: Associate Director / Director, Data Strategy & Measurement
descriptionHtml:
Associate Director / Director, Data Strategy & Measurement

Location: Remote — this is a remote, work-from-home role, as are all positions at Acceleration Partners. Some travel is required for client meetings, internal meetings, conferences, and industry events.

The Role

The Associate Director / Director, Data Strategy & Measurement is responsible for defining and leading Acceleration Partners' data, analytics and measurement capability. This role sits at the intersection of client strategy, data science, measurement, AI-enabled insights and commercial growth. The Director will work directly with enterprise clients to understand their marketing and business data ecosystem, develop measurement strategies, and help clients make better decisions through data. Internally, the role will partner with Client Services, Strategy, Sales and AI Automation teams to build AP's data capability, improve decision-making, develop new services and products, and raise data literacy across the organization. As a senior leader, the Director will also develop AP's market position as a leading authority on affiliate, influencer and partnership measurement.

Top Responsibilities:

Client Measurement & Data Strategy

• Serve as AP's senior advisor on measurement, analytics and reporting.

• Understand client data ecosystems including affiliate networks, influencer platforms, Google Analytics, CRM systems, customer databases, MMM outputs and business intelligence tools.

• Design measurement frameworks that connect partnership marketing activity to broader business outcomes, spanning attribution, incrementality, customer acquisition and lifetime value.

• Advise clients on how affiliate and influencer activity should be measured alongside paid media, brand marketing and broader customer acquisition strategies.

• Own AP's point of view on measurement, partnering with MMM providers, analytics platforms and measurement vendors to keep AP at the forefront of measurement innovation.

Strategic Consulting & Problem Solving

• Lead analytical workstreams for enterprise clients, including programme audits and strategic reviews.

• Support growth strategies, forecasting, partner valuation models and opportunity assessments.

• Translate complex datasets into actionable commercial recommendations.

• Partner with senior client stakeholders across Marketing, Analytics, Finance and Data Science teams.

Data Products & Capability Development • Define and own AP's data and analytics roadmap.

• Partner with Strategy and AI teams to identify opportunities for automation and AI-enabled insights.

• Lead development of scalable reporting frameworks, dashboards, benchmarking products and measurement tools. • Drive innovation across APVision and future analytical capabilities.

Data Enablement & Industry Thought Leadership

• Increase data literacy across Account Management, Strategy and Sales teams through training programmes, workshops and playbooks.

• Coach teams to ask better questions, interpret data effectively and communicate insights to clients.

• Represent AP externally as a thought leader on measurement and analytics, speaking at conferences, webinars and client forums.

• Produce thought leadership on attribution, incrementality, MMM, AI and partnership measurement, and build relationships with key industry vendors and platforms.

What Success Looks Like:

By 6 Months

The Director has built strong relationships with key enterprise client stakeholders and is actively advising on measurement strategy and programme audits. They have an established working relationship with their Data Strategist and a clear view of AP's data and analytics roadmap. Early training and enablement sessions have begun to raise data literacy across Account Management and Strategy teams.

By 1 Year

The Director is recognized internally and externally as AP's leading voice on measurement and analytics. Clients are adopting AP's measurement recommendations, and client satisfaction and retention have improved. The Director has contributed to new business wins, launched at least one new analytical product or framework, and represented AP at industry events. Data literacy and standardized analytical frameworks are visible across the organization, and the Data Strategist is developing well under their mentorship.

Qualities of the Ideal Candidate:

• Strategic thinker, comfortable operating with ambiguity

• Strong communicator and storyteller, able to simplify complex concepts for non-technical audiences

• Commercially minded

• Collaborative and influential across teams and seniority levels

• Naturally curious and innovative

• Confident representing AP as an external thought leader

Minimum Qualifications & Skills:

• 8–12+ years of experience in analytics, measurement, marketing science, consulting or data strategy

• Experience working with enterprise clients and advising senior stakeholders and executive teams

• Strong understanding of affiliate, influencer, digital marketing or performance marketing

• Experience leading teams and developing talent

• Strong understanding of Marketing Mix Modelling (MMM), attribution methodologies and incrementality testing

• Proficiency with Google Analytics, Customer Data Platforms (CDPs) and Business Intelligence/dashboarding tools (Tableau, Power BI, Looker or similar)

• Familiarity with data warehousing concepts and AI-enabled analytics

• SQL and data querying experience preferred

WHY ACCELERATION PARTNERS?

Acceleration Partners is the world’s largest and first-to-market Partnership Marketing Agency creating and nurturing partnerships that drive exceptional measurable outcomes for their clients. Managing clients in 40+ countries, their global team of 300+ focuses on data-driven strategies that help connect brands to the right consumers through performance partnerships, traditional affiliate, influencer, performance PR, content, and B2B partnership marketing.

AP PERKS & BENEFITS – WHAT WE OFFER

  • Summer & Holiday Wellness Breaks in July and December

  • Wellness, Technology & Education Allowances

Benefits may vary based on employment status or country location.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

From our work informing strategic government decisions, to optimising our NHS, through to reducing bureaucratic backlogs - we know that AI offers opportunities to drive improvements at every level of Government and we are proud to lead on some of the most impactful work happening in the sector.

Because of the nature of the work we do with our Government clients, you may need to be eligible for UK Security Clearance (SC) and willing to work on site with these clients from time to time.

As an Associate at Faculty, you will join a collaborative team scoping, building, and delivering impactful AI projects across education and public services. You will support work streams alongside assessment bodies, educational platforms, and government partners to ensure bespoke AI solutions are safe, evidence-backed, and practical.

We will look to you to nurture trusted client relationships, translate operational needs into clear delivery plans, and partner with technical teams to deploy tools that genuinely improve learning outcomes. This is an exciting opportunity to build your career at the forefront of safe, purposeful AI innovation.

  • Working side-by-side with education leaders, publishers, and assessment partners to understand user needs and core learning challenges.

  • Translating operational requirements and pedagogical goals into clear, actionable user stories for data science and engineering squads.

  • Partnering with AI safety and evaluation specialists to test workflows and ensure solutions uphold rigorous standards of fairness, validity, and evidence.

  • Collaborating closely with multidisciplinary project teams to keep delivery on track and maintain exceptional delivery quality.

  • Contributing to problem-led proposals, client workshops, and internal thought leadership on the positive impact of technology in learning.

Who we're looking for:

  • You bring strong analytical thinking and curiosity, with a talent for synthesising complex information and communicating ideas with clarity.

  • You demonstrate client-facing experience and take pride in building empathetic, collaborative partnerships that help projects succeed.

  • You understand Agile ways of working and appreciate how iterative delivery helps multidisciplinary squads achieve meaningful results.

  • You show a thoughtful awareness of why validity, fairness, and safety are critical when applying AI to education and public services.

  • You thrive in entrepreneurial settings, bringing initiative, adaptability, and enthusiasm for finding creative solutions in fast-moving environments.

Our interview process

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. title: Automation & Industrialization Director
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

Harmattan AI is moving from rapid product development and early serial production into high-volume industrial scale-up. Products, production volumes and manufacturing sites are evolving simultaneously.

The next phase requires a Senior Automation & Industrialisation Director who can translate engineering designs and volume requirements into robust, scalable and where justified increasingly automated production systems, while providing strong technical leadership to a diversely skilled team.

The objective is to strengthen both Harmattan AI's industrialisation capability and the technical maturity of the team, enabling the organisation to scale from today's manual and semi-automated processes toward significantly higher volumes and international manufacturing.

 

Responsibilities

The role will own the Automation & Industrialisation roadmap, including:

  • Industrialisation of new products from prototype through stable serial production.

  • DFM/DFA and Design for Automation with Engineering.

  • Production process and line architecture.

  • Workstations, tooling, fixtures, test equipment and semi-automated production systems.

  • Automation concepts, specifications, supplier selection, commissioning and ramp-up.

  • PFMEA, process validation and production-readiness activities.

  • Cycle-time, capacity, line balancing, yield and labour-content optimisation.

  • Identification of the correct automation level based on volume, maturity, quality, flexibility and ROI.

  • Standardisation and replication of production systems across Harmattan AI manufacturing sites.

  • Development of the manufacturing technology roadmap toward significantly higher production volumes.

 

Candidate Requirements

  • 15-20+ years of relevant industrial experience (ideally in aerospace, defence, advanced electronics, or mechatronics) and has personally taken complex electromechanical products from prototype into high-volume or rapidly scaling serial production

  • Ideally, combined experience from a highly developed industrial organisation with experience in a startup/scale-up, defence-tech, UAV, robotics or similarly fast-moving hardware environment.

  • Hands-on experience with semi-automated and automated assembly systems, PLC-controlled equipment (Siemens preferred), and industrial tooling.

  • Solid understanding of DFM/DFA, PFMEA, and lean manufacturing principles.

  • Adaptability & Mobility: Thrives under pressure in a fast-paced, dynamic environment; embraces a “no-task-is-too-small” mentality. Willingness to travel and work flexible schedules (evenings/weekends as needed).

  • Communication & Influence: Excellent written and verbal communication, capable of leading diverse principals – from junior members to senior executives.

  • Commitment: 100% dedication to Harmattan AI’s mission, vision, and ambitious growth plans, ready to go the extra mile to ensure operational excellence.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

title: Avionics System Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Help Build Europe's Hypersonic Capability At Hypersonica, we’re redefining what’s possible in European defence technology. We exist to deliver speed, resilience, and technological independence at a pace that sets a new standard. We are a small, elite team working on problems that matter, and solving them fast. By joining Hypersonica, you’re not stepping into a predefined role. You’re joining a talent dense environment where every individual shapes the direction of the company. Our philosophy is to hire a small number of exceptional people with broad, deep technical capability, strong judgement, and the ability to operate autonomously. We hire for talent, not rigid boxes. This role represents a business need, but the way it evolves will be shaped by the individual. If you’ve achieved what others said was impossible, or you bring a unique combination of skills that doesn’t fit a traditional mould, we want to hear from you. The work you do here directly contributes to Europe’s technological independence.

What you'll do

  • Design, build, and test avionics subsystems (power distribution, data buses, sensor interfaces, flight computer integration) to meet requirements set by the avionics architecture lead.
  • Support development and upkeep of avionics requirements, interface control documents (ICDs), and verification & validation (V&V) test plans.
  • Execute avionics AIT (assembly, integration & test) activities: write and run test procedures, capture data, and support anomaly investigation and root-cause analysis.
  • Support supplier and vendor coordination for avionics components (flight computers, sensors, actuators, harnessing) — including incoming inspection, qualification testing, and non-conformance tracking.
  • Contribute to flight readiness reviews and perform post-test/post-flight data analysis and reporting.
  • Maintain avionics design and test documentation in line with applicable export control classifications and configuration management practices.
  • Collaborate day-to-day with GNC, propulsion, and structures engineers to resolve interface and integration issues.

Who You Are 
  • Degree in Electrical/Electronic/Aerospace Engineering, or equivalent demonstrable experience.
  • Hands-on experience with avionics system design or integration on complex vehicles (aerospace, defence, automotive, or comparable high-reliability domain)
  • Working knowledge of avionics architectures: power distribution, data buses (e.g. CAN, MIL-STD-1553, Ethernet), sensor integration, flight computers.
  • Experience with electronics lab test equipment, test procedure execution, and data capture/analysis.
  • Comfortable working in a cross-functional, fast-paced hardware development environment.
  • Strong written communication for technical documentation (ICDs, test reports, non-conformance records)

    • What we offer 

    • A mission-driven environment with the opportunity to work on one of Europe's most consequential defence challenges, with direct impact on sovereign capability and security.

    • Daily collaboration with top experts across engineering, operations, and defence, with real opportunity to learn from the best, contribute, and grow.

    • High ownership and autonomy; no time tracking, no micromanagement, just clear objectives and accountability for outcomes.

    • A fast-paced environment where good ideas are implemented quickly, and feedback from test and flight drives real decisions.

    • A culture that values clarity, integrity, and excellence, and supports people who take initiative and push boundaries responsibly.

    • Competitive compensation and real share options aligned to responsibility and impact, not tenure or hierarchy.


    Security and Eligibility Requirement 

    Due to the nature of the work, applicants must be an EU/NATO/German citizen and eligible for Security Clearance.

    At Hypersonica, every hire raises the bar. We are deliberately small, intensely capable, and deeply mission-driven. If this role feels like a strong fit, or if you believe you bring something exceptional that goes beyond the description, we encourage you to apply. Hypersonica is an equal-opportunity employer and assesses candidates solely on merit, capability, and potential. You can apply directly to this role or reach out to Nathan Sweeney, Head of Talent. We review every application and aim to respond to all candidates within two weeks, whether the answer is yes or no.

title: Business Developer Defense - 100%

As an ETH Zürich spin-off, we are a fast-growing pioneer in underwater robotics, rooted in Switzerland. Backed by strong funding and entering an exciting phase of international growth, we are looking for a driven and entrepreneurial person to help scale Tethys Robotics.

Tasks

We are looking for a well-connected professional with deep roots in the defence ecosystem, someone who combines relationship capital with project management discipline and genuine enthusiasm for cutting-edge technology.

Your Contribution

You will open doors in the defense sector: Your professional network in this industry will finally generate qualified leads for our business.

If you have the network, the drive, and the ability to navigate complex procurement environments, we would love to hear from you.

  • Co-develop go-to-market and partner strategies together with the biz team and management (e.g. resellers, agencies, distributors).

Requirements

  • Existing connections between key buyers and decision-makers at defence primes and procuring organizations such as NATO member states, or comparable entities
  • >5 years of proven customer-facing experience in consulting, project management, in B2B sales or similar roles, with technologically sophisticated products; a deep defence sector network and genuine market knowledge are essential – this is not a pure sales role
  • Background in project management or technical consulting is strongly preferred; the role demands sector fluency and the ability to navigate complex procurement processes, not just sales skills

‍

title: Business Development & Sales Intern (w/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Über Valova

Wir bauen die KI-Betriebsplattform für Europas Krankenhäuser, damit sich jede Ärztin und jeder Arzt auf die Patienten konzentrieren kann.

Hinter jedem Fall steht eine Kette administrativer Aufgaben: Dokumentation, Kodierung, Abrechnung, Prüfungen, Planung. Sie läuft über getrennte Systeme und unzählige manuelle Übergaben.

Wir starten dort, wo der Effekt ab Tag eins messbar ist: vom Fall bis zum Geldeingang. Valova kodiert jeden Fall, verteidigt ihn in der Prüfung und sorgt dafür, dass das Geld ankommt. Von dort übernehmen wir jeden Workflow eines Krankenhauses, bis ein agentisches System die Routine erledigt und Menschen über Ausnahmen entscheiden.

Ein Team aus Ärzt:innen, Engineers, Strategieberater:innen und Start-up Profis. Vor Ort in München und Berlin. Wir freuen uns auf Dich!

Warum diese Rolle zählt

Als Praktikant:in im Business Development & Sales sorgst Du dafür, dass unser Vertriebsteam seine Zeit mit den richtigen Kliniken verbringt. Du findest und qualifizierst die Accounts, eröffnest die ersten Gespräche und buchst die Demos, die dann unsere Regional Sales Manager:innen wahrnehmen. Gleichzeitig baust Du den Motor dahinter mit auf: saubere Daten in unserem CRM Tool, Outreach-Sequenzen, die laufen, Dashboards, die zeigen, wo wir stehen, und KI-Automatisierungen, die unserem Team jede Woche Stunden sparen.

Was Du bewirkst, siehst Du direkt anhand der gebuchten Termine, einer aufgebauten Pipeline und Prozessen, die weiterlaufen, lange nachdem Du sie aufgesetzt hast.

Du sitzt nicht in der zweiten Reihe und schaust zu. Du baust den Vertriebsmotor mit auf, der Valova in Kliniken in ganz Deutschland bringt.

Deine Rolle im Team

Du berichtest an unseren VP Sales und arbeitest täglich mit unseren Regional Sales Manager:innen im Norden und Süden zusammen. Für viele Kliniken bist Du der erste Kontakt: Du recherchierst Accounts, gehst Inbound Leads nach, sprichst Entscheider:innen per Telefon, LinkedIn und E-Mail an und übergibst qualifizierte Termine an die Regional Sales Manager:innen, die sie bis zur Unterschrift bringen. Neben dem Outreach unterstützt du RevOps & Enablement, einen Bereich, den aktuell unser VP Sales selbst führt und gestaltest so von innen mit, wie unser Vertrieb arbeitet. Eng zusammen arbeitest Du außerdem mit unserem Marketing bei Kampagnen und Events sowie mit unseren Kodierexpert:innen und dem medizinischen Team, um zu verstehen, worauf es Kliniken wirklich ankommt.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Türen zu Kliniken öffnen: Du identifizierst vielversprechende Kliniken, von privaten Klinikgruppen über kommunale und ländliche Häuser bis zu Unikliniken, recherchierst die richtigen Entscheider:innen in Geschäftsführung, Finanzen, Medizincontrolling und Kodierung und gehst Inbound Leads schnell nach.

  • Gespräche starten, die zählen: Du sprichst Kliniken per Telefon, LinkedIn und E-Mail an, mit Sequenzen, die auf den jeweiligen Kliniktyp und seine Herausforderungen zugeschnitten sind.

  • Qualifizieren und Demos buchen: Du findest heraus, ob echter Bedarf besteht, wer entscheidet und wann und buchst Demos für unsere Regional Sales Manager:innen mit sauberer Übergabe.

  • Unsere Pipeline up-to-date halten: Du hältst unser CRM sauber, baust Dashboards und bereitest Pipeline- und Forecast-Reportings für unseren VP Sales vor.

  • Mit KI automatisieren: Du baust KI-gestützte Workflows und Automatisierungen für Recherche, Datenanreicherung und Outreach, damit unser Team weniger Zeit mit Routine und mehr Zeit mit Kliniken verbringt.

  • Unseren Vertrieb mitgestalten: Du schreibst SOPs, schärfst Sequenzen und Playbook, unterstützt den Deal Desk bei Angeboten und Business Cases und recherchierst den Klinikmarkt und unseren Wettbewerb.

Was Du mitbringst

  • Studium: Du studierst BWL, VWL, Gesundheitsmanagement, Gesundheitsökonomie, Medizin oder ein anderes relevantes Feld und suchst ein Vollzeitpraktikum über mindestens sechs Monate.

  • Erste Praxiserfahrung: Du hast bereits durch ein Praktikum oder eine Werkstudententätigkeit in Vertrieb, Business Development, Beratung oder einem Start-up praktische Erfahrung gesammelt.

  • Keine Scheu vorm Telefon: Du gehst gern auf Menschen zu, auch auf erfahrene Entscheider:innen, und bleibst nach einem „Nein“ freundlich und hartnäckig.

  • Strukturiert und datenaffin: Du bist sicher in Excel und hältst Daten gern sauber. CRM-Erfahrung, idealerweise mit Pipedrive, ist ein Plus.

  • KI-nativ: Du nutzt KI-Tools täglich und hast Lust, Automatisierungen zu bauen. Erfahrung mit Tools wie n8n, Make oder Zapier ist ein Plus.

  • Neugier aufs Gesundheitswesen: Du willst verstehen, wie Krankenhäuser funktionieren. Erste Kenntnisse in DRG-Systematik oder ICD/OPS-Kodierung sind ein Plus, kein Muss.

  • Sprachen: Du sprichst Deutsch verhandlungssicher oder als Muttersprache und Englisch fließend.

  • Arbeitsort: Du arbeitest vor Ort in unserem Büro in Berlin oder München

Dir fehlen ein oder zwei Punkte, aber Du bist überzeugt, die richtige Person für diese Rolle zu sein? Dann bewirb Dich trotzdem. Wir freuen uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen.

Was wir Dir bieten

  • Ownership ab Tag eins: Du verantwortest Deine eigene Pipeline und treibst den Erfolg von Valova in Deine Vertriebsregion maßgeblich voran.

  • Direkter Draht zur Vertriebsleitung. Du arbeitest täglich eng mit Stephan zusammen, unserem VP Sales und erfahrenen Scale-up-Executive. Keine Hierarchieebenen, kein wochenlanges Warten auf Freigaben.

  • Lernen im Start-up-Tempo. Du erlebst hier in einem Jahr mehr als anderswo in drei.

  • Ein Team, mitten in der Stadt. Wir arbeiten gemeinsam vor Ort im WeWork am Odeonsplatz in München und im WeWork in Berlin-Mitte. Dich erwarten voll ausgestattete Büros mit Kaffee, Meetingräumen und Phone Booths, eine zentrale Lage und gute Lunch-Spots direkt um die Ecke.

  • Ein Team mit großen Zielen. Ärztinnen und Ärzte, Entwickler:innen und Kolleg:innen aus Vertrieb und Operations, die sich ehrgeizige Ziele setzen und alles daransetzen, sie gemeinsam zu übertreffen.

  • Team-Events, die München und Berlin zusammenbringen, denn die Menschen, mit denen Du baust, sollten auch die sein, mit denen Du feierst.

Woran wir Erfolg messen

  • Nach 1 Monat kennst Du unser Produkt, unsere Zielkliniken und Pipedrive in- und auswendig, und Deine ersten Outreach-Sequenzen laufen.

  • Nach 3 Monaten buchst Du regelmäßig qualifizierte Demos für unsere Regional Sales Manager:innen, unsere Pipedrive-Daten sind sauber und Deine ersten Dashboards und Automatisierungen sind live.

  • Zum Ende deines Praktikums hast Du eine messbare Pipeline aufgebaut, die SOPs und Sequenzen, die Du geschrieben hast, sind Teil unseres Playbooks und Deine Automatisierungen sparen dem Team jede Woche Zeit.

  • Die ganze Zeit über hat das, was Du in Gesprächen hörst, unsere Botschaften mitgeprägt und uns geholfen, den Markt besser zu verstehen.

So läuft Dein Bewerbungsprozess

Lade einfach deinen Lebenslauf samt Gehaltsvorstellung mit deiner Bewerbung hoch. Für die nächsten Schritte melden wir uns zeitnah bei dir:

  1. Kennenlernen (30 Min.): Wir lernen uns kennen, sprechen über deinen Werdegang und beantworten deine ersten Fragen.

  2. Gespräch mit unserem VP Sales (30 Min.): Wir sprechen über Deine bisherigen Erfahrungen und Deine Ideen für Valova und Deine Vorstellungen für das Praktikum.

  3. Case: Du führst mit uns ein kurzes Discovery-Gespräch oder einen Pitch anhand eines realistischen Klinikszenarios. Hier zeigst Du uns, wie du verkaufst.

  4. Referenzen: Wir sprechen mit zwei oder drei Personen, mit denen Du zusammengearbeitet hast, zum Beispiel ehemaligen Vorgesetzten, Kolleg:innen oder Kund:innen.

  5. Angebot: Wenn es für beide Seiten passt, hörst Du schnell von uns.

Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung, unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Religion, Behinderung, Alter oder sexueller Identität.

title: Career Coach (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
Jobbeschreibung

Als Career Coach begleitest Du unsere Lernenden auf dem entscheidendsten Abschnitt ihres Weges: dem Sprung in den neuen Job. Unsere Kurse vermitteln unseren Teilnehmenden echte, marktfähige Kompetenzen. Du sorgst dafür, dass diese auch von der Außenwelt gesehen werden, indem Du ihnen hilfst, ihre neuen Fähigkeiten sichtbar zu machen, selbstbewusst zu kommunizieren und in überzeugende Bewerbungen zu verwandeln.

Dabei bist Du nicht allein: Der Coaching-Prozess ist strukturiert, die Qualität abgesichert, und Du arbeitest eng mit dem Career Coaching Lead zusammen. Dein Fokus: Teilnehmende begleiten, dass sie ihren Berufseinstieg mit Klarheit und Zuversicht angehen.

  • Dokumentation und Reporting von Vermittlungsquoten, Coaching-Aktivitäten und Feedback an den Career Coaching Lead

Das bringst Du mit

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium oder vergleichbare Qualifikation in Pädagogik, Psychologie oder Coaching

  • Einfühlungsvermögen, Empathie und aktives Zuhören

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (mind. C1)


Das bieten wir Dir

 

Arbeitskultur
Dich erwartet eine lösungsorientierte und datengetriebene Arbeitsweise, eine offene Feedbackkultur sowie ein starker Teamspirit. Zwei vom gesamten StackFuel-Team gewählte Trustees unterstützen Dich bei Fragen und Anliegen als neutrale, vertrauliche Anlaufstelle.

Übernehme ab dem ersten Tag Verantwortung, bringe Deine eigenen Ideen aktiv ein, gestalte Prozesse nachhaltig und präge unsere Abläufe maßgeblich mit.

Workation
Bis zu 10 Tage pro Jahr kannst Du von überall aus der EU, dem EWR und der Türkei arbeiten.

Raum für Austausch
Regelmäßiger Austausch im Team, saisonale Feiern und eine immer gut gefüllte Küche sorgen für ein lebendiges Miteinander.

Weiterentwicklung

title: CDI - CHEF DE PRODUIT JERSEY JUNIOR (H/F)
descriptionHtml:
LA MAISON JACQUEMUS

Jacquemus a été fondé par Simon Porte Jacquemus en 2009 à Paris, en France.

Dédiée à la mémoire de la mère du créateur, la marque puise son inspiration dans une passion pour la culture. Les collections femme et homme font référence à l’art de vivre à la française et aux gestes universels de beauté, intégrant des influences allant de la photographie d'art aux arts décoratifs, en passant par le cinéma, la peinture et la sculpture.

Au fil des années, Jacquemus a mis en scène ses défilés dans des lieux uniques et inattendus, notamment une piscine parisienne, le Musée Picasso, un champ de lavande en Provence, un champ de blé aux abords de Paris, un marais salant en Camargue et une plage à Hawaï. Plus récemment, la marque a investi des lieux tels que le canal du Château de Versailles (Le Chouchou), la Fondation Maeght (Les Sculptures), la Casa Malaparte (La Casa) et l’appartement parisien d’Auguste Perret (La Croisière).

Basé dans le 8 ᵉ arrondissement de Paris, Jacquemus est une maison de mode indépendante comptant plus de 300 employés. Réputée pour sa forte présence numérique et son expansion internationale, la marque a développé des expériences de vente innovantes à travers le monde avant d’ouvrir son premier flagship permanent au 58 Avenue Montaigne à Paris en 2022. Depuis, des boutiques ont été ouvertes à New York (SoHo) et Londres (New Bond Street) et Dubai.

VOTRE RÔLE 

Le/La Chef de Produit Junior développe les catégories Jersey Homme et Femme dans le respect des inputs stylistiques ainsi que des objectifs de prix, de qualité et de délais. Il/Elle reporte à la Chef de Produit Jersey Senior.

VOS MISSIONS

  • Création et mise à jour des fiches articles dans PLM (nomenclatures, commentaires, mesures, commande de prototypes)
  • Mise à jour des documents de suivi de collection : boards, PLM, fichiers Excel
  • Prise de notes pendant les essayages et rédaction des commentaires
  • Lancement et suivi des prototypes/SMS avec les fabricants extérieurs : suivi de la faisabilité technique et industrielle des produits en garantissant les volontés du design et le grade de qualité
  • Réception des prototypes/SMS : vérification de la conformité des finitions, de la construction et des mesures
  • Gestion et coordination du flux des prototypes et SMS
  • Archivage des prototypes et des essais

VOTRE PROFIL 

  • 1 à 3 ans d’expérience en développement produit dont une expérience sur le jersey
  • Anglais courant
  • Pack office et PLM - idéalement première expérience sur l’outil
  • Agilité, réactivité et sens relationnel
  • Rigueur et sens des priorités

Le poste est basé dans le 8ème arrondissement de Paris.

title: CDI - Sales / Account Executive (Paris/ IDF)
descriptionHtml:
En rejoignant l’équipe Sales de Matera, tu auras l’opportunité d’échanger chaque jour avec des interlocuteurs très différents ! Il existe 600.000 copropriétés en France et chacune d’elle constitue une communauté à part entière, dont il nous faut comprendre le fonctionnement afin de les convaincre de nous rejoindre !

Nos prospects peuvent aussi bien être une petite copropriété de 3 lots en zone rurale, déjà autonome, qu’un grand ensemble immobilier de 300 logements en centre-ville, géré par un professionnel en face duquel nous présenterons une offre concurrente.

Pour signer un contrat avec une copropriété, il faut obtenir la majorité des votes des copropriétaires lors de l'Assemblée Générale annuelle (cycle de vente est long et complexe - 3 mois en moyenne).

Les missions au quotidien :

title: CENTRALE LYON - Post-Doctoral Position Ferroelectric-Based Ternary Computing: From Circuit Design to System-Level Integration Scientific Context
department: INL - Institut des Nanotechnologies de Lyon
descriptionHtml:
Energy efficiency remains one of the foremost challenges in modern computing, spanning from edge IoT devices to high-performance data centers. Conventional CMOS-based architectures are approaching fundamental physical limits, while the "memory wall" — data transfers between processor and memory accounting for 70 to 90% of total system energy — continues to worsen with the ever-growing demands of data-intensive workloads such as deep neural networks and signal processing pipelines.

In-Memory Computing (IMC) has emerged as a disruptive paradigm to overcome these bottlenecks by embedding arithmetic operations directly within memory arrays, drastically reducing data movement. In this landscape, ferroelectric field-effect transistors (FeFETs) stand out as particularly compelling devices: fully compatible with standard CMOS fabrication processes, non-volatile, reconfigurable, and capable of storing intermediate polarization states — a property that naturally enables ternary logic within a single device.

The Post-Doctoral position will cover at least one of the following tasks:

  • Design Standard Cell Technology Library based on FeFET devices developed at INL in order to be used with synthesis flow.

  • Design and optimize ternary arithmetic units (multiply-accumulate units, adders, comparators) based on the FeFET ternary gate library developed within the project, targeting area, power, and timing closure under realistic process constraints.

  • Develop and refine system-level models of FeFET-based ternary IMC units, abstracting circuit-level characterization results into architecture simulators, enabling design space exploration across the full heterogeneous system.

  • Investigate hardware/software co-design strategies for mapping real-world applications — particularly convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and signal processing kernels — onto the ternary IMC fabric, exploiting approximate computing techniques to trade precision for energy efficiency.

  • Assess and benchmark the energy, performance, and accuracy trade-offs of ternary IMC against binary CMOS and binary NVM-based IMC reference implementations, using both synthetic benchmarks and real application workloads.

  • Contribute to the definition of a design methodology for ternary ferroelectric circuits, including EDA tool flows, cell library characterization guidelines, and design rules, with the aim of enabling broader community adoption.


Required Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate holds a PhD in microelectronics, computer architecture, or a closely related field, and demonstrates at least one of the following hard skills:

  • Circuit and architecture design: Strong expertise in digital circuit design flows and computer architecture, with hands-on experience using industrial EDA tools (Cadence Virtuoso/Spectre, Synopsys). Experience with standard-cell library characterization is a plus.

  • Emerging memory technologies: Solid knowledge of non-volatile memory devices, preferably including ferroelectric materials (FeFET, FeCap) or resistive memories (RRAM, PCM). Familiarity with compact modeling is an asset.

  • System-level design and simulation: Experience with architecture-level simulation frameworks and hardware/software co-design methodologies. Knowledge of RISC-V ecosystems is a plus.

  • Application domains: Familiarity with deep neural network inference workloads and/or digital signal processing pipelines, particularly in the context of approximate or energy-constrained computing.

  • Programming: Proficiency in HDL (Verilog, VHDL, Verilog-A) and scripting languages (Python, Shell) for design automation and simulation.

Soft skills: Scientific leadership, ability to coordinate with PhD students and international partners, strong publication record consistent with career stage, and excellent written and oral communication in English.

Language: Fluent scientific English is mandatory. French is not required but is welcome.

title: Chief Information Security Officer
descriptionHtml:
Make security the reason people trust Ockto

Own security at the platform people use to share their most personal data

Every day, people use Ockto to share their identity, income, assets and bank data: when they apply for a mortgage, rent a home or take out a lease. Banks and other large organisations choose Ockto partly because of the level of assurance we offer around that data. At Ockto, security is not a support function. It is part of the product and organisational culture.

As our CISO, you make sure it stays that way as we grow. Part of that growth is adopting an AI driven operating model with strong guardrails. You own Ockto's security programme, from risk and controls to incidents, suppliers and audits. You set the standard, check that it is met, and make security measurable in a way that the whole organisation (and specifically our engineers and spec leads), clients, auditors and regulators all recognise. You do this with a real mandate and short lines to the people who decide.

What you'll do

You own the information security programme of a supervised financial company and make it work in daily practice, not just on paper. As CISO, you:

  • Own Ockto's ISMS and security policy framework, and keep our ISO 27001 certification (held since 2017) and our SOC 2 assurance current and credible.

  • Translate the risk appetite set by management into a security strategy, an annual plan and clear standards that teams can build to.

  • Keep Ockto ahead of what's coming. You track developments such as eIDAS2 and the EU Digital Identity Wallet, NIS2, the Cyber Resilience Act and the AI Act, assess what they mean for Ockto and our clients, and translate them into our security strategy and standards in time.

  • Verify and challenge. Our engineering teams operate the technical controls; you check that they work and that findings get fixed. You approve risk acceptance for serious vulnerabilities and commission penetration tests. All control owners are challenged and prepared to show evidence and reproduce controls.

  • Lead the response to security and privacy incidents, approve notifications to regulators, and make sure root causes lead to structural fixes.

  • Manage security risk in our supply chain, from onboarding new suppliers to the annual review of critical ones, in line with DORA.

  • Make sure our continuity and recovery arrangements are tested and hold up, together with Engineering.

  • Make security measurable. We judge it by how quickly and how structurally we resolve what we find, not by counting incidents.

  • Represent Ockto's security towards clients, auditors and supervisors: from a bank's due diligence questionnaire to our external audits and contact with DNB and AFM.

  • Build a security-aware culture with an awareness programme people actually remember.

Who you work with

You report to our Product & Trust Director, who sets Ockto's trust framework and risk appetite. Within that framework, the security strategy and its execution are yours. On security matters you also have a direct line to our CEO, and you are involved early in the product and architecture decisions that shape our risk. Our Information Security Officer is part of your team and runs day-to-day control monitoring with you.

You also work closely with our Engineering Director and the value stream teams that build and run the Ockto platform. They operate the technical controls as the first line; you set the requirements, verify and challenge as the second.

Outside Ockto, you work with the security, risk and procurement teams of our clients and with our external auditors. For audits you are the first line of planning, execution and communication with the auditor(s). Together with the Product & Trust Director, you are Ockto's security contact for DNB and AFM.


What you bring

You combine depth in security with the judgement to apply it pragmatically in a scale-up. We're looking for someone who:

• Has 8+ years of experience in information security, including at least 3 years leading a security function as CISO, Head of Security or similar.

• Has run an ISMS end to end and taken an organisation through ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type II audits.

• Knows regulated financial services and works comfortably with DORA, PSD2, GDPR and supervision by DNB or AFM.

• Has solid grounding in cloud security, preferably AWS, and enough technical understanding to challenge engineers and judge designs.

• Thinks in risk: turns threats into priorities, and weighs security against cost and delivery speed.

• Communicates clearly at every level, from the management team and auditors to developers and a client's security officer.

• Is independent and principled: comfortable saying no, and good at finding the route to yes.

• Speaks and writes English fluently; Dutch is a strong advantage.

Will be a plus:

• CISSP, CISM, CCSP or ISO 27001 Lead Auditor or Lead Implementer certification.

• Experience with privacy governance and DPIAs.

• Experience leading incident response, including notification to regulators.

• Experience with third-party risk management and assurance reporting such as ISAE 3402 or ISAE 3000.

• Familiarity with digital identity, eIDAS2 and EU digital identity wallets.

• Experience governing the safe use of AI tooling in a data-sensitive environment.

What you get

You get a role with real influence on how far clients, supervisors and consumers can trust Ockto.

• Ownership of security at a company where assurance is one of the reasons clients choose us.

• A real mandate: a direct line to the CEO on security matters, a voice early in product and architecture decisions, and the final word on accepting serious security risk.

• Influence on what we build next, as Ockto grows into new markets and propositions.

• Short lines and room to shape the security function the way it should work.

• Experienced colleagues across product, engineering and compliance.

Ockto also offers:

• A good salary: between €5500,- and €6800,- per month, depending on experience

• Room and budget for personal and professional development

• A MacBook Pro and smartphone of choice

• Phone and travel allowance

• Great home and remote working facilities

• Lunch fee

• Plenty of activities, including our annual ski trip, a 1.5-day team offsite, drinks and team outings

You'll join a team that values diversity and collaboration, in a friendly, ambitious and innovative atmosphere.

About Ockto

Ockto is the leading platform for future-proof wallet services. For more than ten years we have been taking the friction out of sharing, verifying and enriching personal data, so that organisations and people can trust each other faster, based on the right information. From our office in Naarden, a team of specialists builds data-driven customer journeys that are right the first time.

Ockto. Built for trust.

Ready to join?

Do you see yourself as our new CISO? Then apply directly. After you apply, we'll contact you within five working days to discuss the role and answer your questions.

Want to know more first? Contact us at company culture, core values and recruitment process, or our other vacancies? Take a look at ockto.recruitee.com.

Your data is safe

At Ockto, we only use your CV and motivation letter during the application process to assess your application. If we don't proceed, we keep your application data for four weeks.

Ton équipe : L’équipe technique de Theodo Cloud est constituée de deux pôles : - le pôle Build, dédié à nos projets de création, migration et optimisation d’infrastructures - le pôle Run, dédié à l’infogérance des infrastructures de nos clients Au build, tu travailles main dans la main avec un ou une Lead DevOps et un ou une Agile Project Manager pour garantir l’impact de tes actions chez nos clients. Au run, tu rejoins une équipe d’une quinzaine de personnes avec laquelle tu gères un portefeuille de clients. L’équipe run dispose également d’un volet build, dédié à l’amélioration continue des plateformes de nos clients. Nous déterminerons ensemble à l’issue de l’entretien RH le pôle sur lequel nous pouvons te positionner. Tes futures missions : En tant que Cloud Engineer, tu travailles sur des infrastructures cloud en suivant les bonnes pratiques techniques et les standards définis par l’équipe. Au run les missions consistent à : - Réagir aux incidents en production et mener des investigations techniques approfondies - Réaliser les post-mortem et assurer une communication claire et structurée avec les clients - Répondre aux interrogations des clients et formuler des recommandations actionnables pour améliorer la qualité, la fiabilité, la sécurité et la performance de leur infrastructure - Concevoir et découper techniquement des fonctionnalités adaptées aux contraintes projet (qualité, coût, délais) Au build tu apprendras à comprendre et répondre aux besoins d’un client sur sa stratégie d’infrastructure : - montage d’infrastructure from scratch - migrations Cloud et Kubernetes - mise en place de pipelines de CI/CD - mise en place d’outils de monitoring et d’alerting - apport des bonnes pratiques DevOps chez nos clients - participation active aux rituels agiles (Scrum) de l’équipe projet La réalisation d’astreintes est également possible, elle se fait sur la base du volontariat. Ce poste de Cloud Engineer est fait pour les personnes curieuses qui veulent monter en compétences rapidement, au contact d’un large panel d’infrastructures et d’outils (AWS, GCP, Azure, Scaleway, Outscale, OVH, …) et de bugs complexes en production. Theodo Cloud est encore une jeune entreprise où il y a de la place pour construire des choses. En parallèle de ton projet, tu auras du temps dédié pour t’investir sur des sujets qui te tiennent à cœur : la formation des équipes business, la diversité, ou le recrutement technique… Tes perspectives d’évolution : La première étape d’évolution chez Theodo Cloud est de devenir Lead, et de devenir ainsi garant de la stratégie technique et de la montée en compétences de ton équipe. Nous proposons ensuite deux tracks d’évolution possibles : - une track Management, qui t’emmènera vers un rôle d’Engineering Manager - une track Expertise, qui te permettra d’accéder à un rôle de Staff Engineer Une méthodologie basée sur l’apprentissage continu : Chez Theodo, nous avons construit notre approche tech autour d’une conviction forte : on développe d’abord les personnes, avant de développer les produits. Notre Lean Tech® System met l’accent sur l’apprentissage continu : tu évolueras dans un environnement qui investit sur le long terme, où l’objectif est de te permettre de progresser chaque jour, tout en construisant des produits utiles et performants pour nos clients. Profil recherché : - Tu disposes d’une solide formation en école d’ingénieur, avec une première expérience en infrastructures Cloud (Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, AWS, GCP...) - Tu fais preuve de rigueur, d’une bonne gestion du stress, et sais intervenir efficacement sur des environnements de production - Tu as l’envie de progresser rapidement et de travailler en équipe Tu ne coches pas 100% des critères mais tu penses tout de même correspondre à notre recherche ? Ne t’auto-censure pas et envoie-nous ta candidature, on se fera un plaisir de l’étudier ! Pour information : - Le poste est proposé en CDI, basé depuis nos locaux à Paris. - Le salaire proposé dépend du niveau d’expérience de chacun : nous en parlons toujours dès le premier appel téléphonique. Déroulement des entretiens : Nous répondons à toutes les candidatures dans un délai de 2 jours. Si ton parcours retient notre attention, voici le process qu’on te propose : - un appel téléphonique de 30 minutes avec un membre de l’équipe recrutement, pour comprendre tes critères de recherche - un entretien d’une heure avec le recruteur ou la recruteuse avec qui tu as échangé à la première étape, pour parler plus en détail de la culture Theodo - un entretien de technique théorique de 45 minutes - un entretien technique de debug de 45 minutes - un échange de 30 minutes avec un membre de l’équipe dirigeante Notre process dure 1 semaine en moyenne. Tu seras accompagné(e) par un membre de l’équipe recrutement, qui sera là pour te coacher tout au long du process.Pourquoi rejoindre Theodo Cloud ? L'environnement : 💼 Rejoindre un groupe de 750 personnes avec de nombreuses possibilités d’évolutions cross-entités 🤝 Chaque Theodoer est accompagné par un coach interne. Son objectif : t’épauler dans ton quotidien et parler objectifs de carrière via des séances de coaching hebdomadaires. 🎯 Participation à des projets associatifs grâce à la Fondation Theodo (Ada Tech School, Code Phoenix, Article 1…) 🎉 Soirées mensuelles, keynotes et week-end d’entreprise annuel Le package : 📈 Actionnariat salarié pour être associé à la réussite du groupe 💸 Prime d’intéressement indexée sur la croissance de Theodo 🖥 Budget équipement (ordinateur, smartphone, écouteurs…) 🧒 Des avantages fournis par notre CSE (sport avec Gymlib,...) 🏖 5 semaines + 8 à 12 RTT/an 🩺 Mutuelle (SideCare) prise en charge à 50% 🍽 Carte ticket-restaurants Swile Prêt à nous rejoindre ?

title: Cloud Security Engineer
descriptionHtml:
A little about us

incident.io is the AI software reliability platform trusted by engineering teams at Netflix, Etsy, and 2,000+ companies who can't afford downtime.

The stakes are real, the talent is insane, and somehow it's a genuinely lovely place to work. We all pull our weight, go the extra mile, and put in the bit of magic most companies don't have time for, all while having fun and never taking ourselves too seriously.

We've raised $100+ million from Index Ventures, Insight Partners, and Point Nine, and we're growing fast. There's never been a better time to join.

The role in one line

Being a Cloud Security Engineer at incident means being the person who keeps the one thing customers rely on when their systems are on fire both up and safe, turning “is this secure?” into “yes, and here’s the proof.”

What that looks like day to day

As a Cloud Security Engineer at incident, you own the security of the cloud infrastructure that runs our platform: how it’s built, hardened, monitored and defended. It’s a genuinely varied role. One day you’re tightening IAM across our Google Cloud projects, the next you’re building a Terraform guardrail so engineers get a safe path instead of a ticket, the next you’re leading an investigation into something odd in the audit logs.

You’ll own cloud posture and hardening across GCP and GKE, identity and access, security as code in our Terraform and CI/CD pipelines, detection and response, isolation of customer data in our multi-tenant platform, and the cloud-side controls around our AI features.

We formed our security team this year and there are three of us. We’re hiring a Cloud Security Engineer to give the team real depth in cloud, which means little process, no approval chains, and your fingerprints on everything. We say yes wherever we genuinely can, and you’ll have the authority to block a release when it matters.

We run on Google Cloud and AWS, with Kubernetes, Terraform, Go, Postgres and TypeScript/React. We lean on Claude and other LLMs to move faster.

Who you are

  • You’ve got deep, hands-on cloud security experience, ideally on Google Cloud. Strong AWS or Azure depth that transfers is fine.

  • You design least-privilege IAM properly, and you’ve secured Kubernetes or container platforms in production.

  • You write code to fix problems, not just report them. Terraform is second nature.

  • You’ve built cloud detection or investigated cloud incidents, and you enjoy following the thread until you find the answer.

  • You can give hard feedback to an engineer and have them thank you for it.

  • You’re comfortable with high autonomy. Nobody’s going to hand you a detailed spec, you’re trusted to figure out what needs doing and just do it.

  • Bonus: Go or Postgres security, policy-as-code, supply chain security, or securing AI/LLM-powered products.

Supporting you

We work hard and we think life outside work matters just as much. Our benefits pack is built to support both.

  • Private medical insurance. Seriously good cover - we want you and the people you love to be looked after.

  • Competitive annual leave. Showing up at your best requires switching off, and we make sure you have time to do that.

  • First Friday of every month off. Yes, seriously.

  • Enhanced pension. We put real money in, because future-you deserves better than an afterthought.

  • Meaningful equity. We're rapidly scaling, and everyone who helps shape the outcome should share in it.

  • Unlimited AI spend. For everyone, not just engineers. We're all-in on AI across the company, and we expect you to be too.

  • Generous parental leave. The early days with a new baby matter more than anything we're doing here, and we want you to be present for them.

  • Two budgets that have your back. £1000 to invest in your setup, £500 a year to invest in yourself.

Compensation: £110K – £200K • Offers Equity

title: CMM Programmer
descriptionHtml:
About Isembard

Isembard is building a network of high-performance factories for critical industries. We combine advanced machine tools, robotics and our own software, MasonOS, to make precision components for aerospace, defence, energy and frontier technology companies, with factories across the UK, US, Germany and France. Our mission is to forge industrial acceleration.

The role

Inspection is the last point where a mistake is cheap to fix, and at our London factory it decides how quickly finished parts reach customers.

As a CMM Programmer you will programme, set and run coordinate measuring machines to verify high-precision components for aerospace, defence, energy and robotics customers. You will work alongside machinists, CAM programmers and quality engineers so that what leaves the factory conforms.

What you'll do

  • Write, simulate and optimise CMM programmes for complex geometry and tight tolerances.

  • Choose probing, fixturing and datum strategies, and build inspection fixtures where needed.

  • Carry out first article inspection (AS9102 / EN 9102), in-process checks and final inspection.

  • Find non-conformances before they reach a customer, and feed corrective actions back into production with machining and CAM.

  • Look after calibration and maintenance of CMMs, gauges and hand tools.

What we're looking for

  • Several years of hands-on CMM programming in precision manufacturing, aerospace or a machine shop.

  • Strong PC-DMIS, Zeiss Calypso, Renishaw Modus or comparable software skills.

  • Practical knowledge of GD&T (ASME Y14.5) and ISO GPS, and confidence with complex drawings and 3D CAD.

  • Proven ability to inspect tolerances of ±0.01 mm and below.

  • Experience with aerospace inspection documentation, including FAI.

Nice to have

  • SPC, capability analysis or measurement system analysis.

  • AS9100 / EN 9100 experience.

  • In-process probing on 5-axis machines.

  • High-mix, low-to-medium volume production.

Why Isembard

  • Work at the centre of the factory's quality, on advanced machines and metrology equipment.

  • Help set inspection standards other sites reuse.

  • Competitive salary and equity.

Location: On-site at our Southwark factory in London.
