title: Head of Strategy & Operations
descriptionHtml:
About remove

remove is a non-profit organisation with a mission to enable innovators globally to realize the "net" in net zero. remove has established premier global startup accelerator programs focused solely on Carbon Dioxide Removal (CDR) across Europe, India, Sub-Saharan Africa and Latin America. To date, we have supported over 200 startups and cultivated a global CDR community. We also develop CDR ecosystems and engage in strategic projects to close systemic gaps in carbon removal globally. We are a small, remote team that works like a startup: high standards, an agile approach and a lot of ownership per person. Our work is funded by leading climate foundations and philanthropic partners such as The Grantham Foundation for the Protection of the Environment and Postcode Loterij Fonds.

About the role

We are looking for a senior professional to lead strategy and operations at remove, managing our talent and running the engine that keeps us moving. You will work very closely with our two co-founders, manage our program managers, and be the person who makes sure the right things get done, well and on time, as we grow our impact in new ways and into new regions at a pivotal stage of our organization.

What you will own

Strategy

  • Lead strategic thinking, be a sounding board to the co-founders, and the person who "writes the strategy down" and plans for its execution.

  • Prepare and run strategy days, offsites and team meetups.

  • Own key strategic documents and shape important external documents.

Planning and Operations

  • Develop and own our roadmap and workplans. Keep everyone accountable to shared goals and spot early and proactively when plans need to change.

  • Own our operating rhythm: recurring meetings, brainstorms, 1:1s, team updates, retros and milestone planning.

  • Develop and improve the processes and documentation the team relies on, including program SOPs and team policies.

People and team

  • Line-manage our program managers: debottleneck daily operations, set priorities, manage workload, coach the team, manage development plans, etc.

  • Lead hiring and onboarding for new team members and external support, and plan team capacity as we grow. We are not expecting to grow team members in large numbers; we intend to remain a lean and mighty team.

  • Look after team health and ways of working in a fully remote, multicultural team.

Fundraising operations

  • Run the process behind the co-founders’ fundraising efforts.

  • Maintain and develop core materials such as our decks, concept notes and one-pagers, and draft or coordinate grant applications.

  • Own impact reporting content and contribute to funder reports.

Strategic projects & programs

  • Scope & lead strategic initiatives from idea to delivery, alongside recurring work.

  • Oversee our programs and systems as we expand.

  • Oversee our entity’s brand and communications.

Who you are

You must have

  • 12+ years of experience, including roles where you ran strategy, operations and/or a PMO for a leadership team. You have done this job before with a laser focus on high standards and timely execution. You don’t let things fall through the cracks.

  • Experience supporting fundraising or business development, e.g. pipelines, proposals and reporting.

  • A track record of managing people well, ideally in small remote teams.

  • Comfort with ambiguity. You can build structure where there is none and adjust it as things change.

  • Resourcefulness and agency. You see what needs doing and do it without waiting to be asked, including the unglamorous parts. You have an entrepreneurial spirit and drive in conceptualising and executing initiatives, with strong organisational and documentation skills.

  • Excellent communication, writing and synthesis. You can turn a messy conversation into a clear plan, deck or proposal.

  • Excellent interpersonal skills, with the ability to inspire and persuade diverse groups, in a cross-cultural remote setting.

  • Ability to work autonomously in a remote workspace, meeting deadlines and managing several work streams simultaneously.

  • Adaptability, curiosity and eagerness to keep learning in a dynamic environment.

  • Ability to speak and write in English fluently.

  • Willingness to travel locally or occasionally regionally/globally, if necessary.

It is a plus if you have

  • A university degree (MSc. preferred) in a relevant field (e.g. environmental science, engineering, sustainability, business administration)

  • Experience in and a strong passion for climate action, carbon removal or the wider sustainability field.

  • Experience with accelerators, startups or entrepreneurship programs.

  • Experience with foundations or philanthropic funding.

  • Experience working in or with partners in the Global South.

  • A coaching or facilitation background.

Practicalities

  • This role reports to the two co-founders.

  • Location: remote, in Europe. Preference will be given to those based in Northwestern Europe due to proximity to the co-founders. Occasional travel for team meetups and selected events.

  • Contract: full time, with start date April 1, 2027. Depending on your location, you may be employed through an employer-of-record provider. You must be able to work in your country of residence. We will not sponsor visas or work permits.

  • Salary: competitive for non-profit salary bands for small teams in your location.

What we offer

  • A flexible and remote-first workplace.

  • An impact-driven role as part of a mission-driven team and organisation working with entrepreneurs globally.

  • A unique opportunity to experience and shape strategy for a future billion-dollar industry in its early days.

  • Exposure to a great network and community of CDR innovators and experts.

  • A learning budget to develop yourself.

  • Flexible holidays and biannual team off-sites.

How to apply

Submit your CV and a short cover letter (no more than one page) detailing your relevant experience and why you believe you would be the ideal candidate for the role. We will review applications on a rolling basis and aim to start interviews as soon as possible, latest by mid November 2026.

Our process:

  • First step after screening: Role-related interview with Rawan Gebran (Senior Director @ remove) - ~45 min

  • Next: Interview panel with both co-founders, Hans Westerhof & Marian Krueger - ~45 min

  • Then: 1:1 interviews with each of the founders individually - ~45 min each

  • Finally: Shortlisted candidates will be asked for 3 references willing to speak about their experience with you, professionally and in that time could meet the rest of the team.

If you’ve built and run the strategic and operating backbone for a small and agile team before and want to do it for the organization helping CDR startups globally get off the ground, we want to hear from you! We're an equal opportunity employer and welcome candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

title: Health and Safety Engineer
descriptionHtml:

You will work closely with operations, engineering, construction, manufacturing, test, and external contractors to ensure that safety is built into the way we work.

Fluent German and experience working with German authorities would be a substantial advantage

About us

We’re a Germany-based rocketry startup currently in stealth mode, scaling up rapidly to meet the demand for high-performance, reliable, and scalable solid propulsion technologies for space and defense applications.

We are already launching suborbital and ballistic rockets on a regular basis, have just crossed €10m in revenue for our first operating year and are applying our knowledge toward the development of an orbital rocket.

We are working hard to build something truly spectacular.

To thrive here you will need to be comfortable working at pace, with the autonomy to make decisions and execute on them quickly. If you’re excited by hard technical challenges and want a role where you will make a real difference each day to the future of the company, we may be the place for you.

At our company, job titles and career progression are earned, not determined by years of experience alone. They reflect the responsibility you take on and the dedication you bring to each project. If you’re ready to rise to the challenge, we’d love to hear from you.

Key responsibilities

  • Conduct risk assessments, hazard reviews, workplace inspections, and safety assessments across company operations.

  • Support safe working practices across construction, manufacturing, testing, hazardous-materials handling, and launch activities.

  • Liaise with German authorities, regulators, inspectors, and external safety bodies on approvals, inspections, and compliance matters.

What we are looking for

  • Proven experience in health and safety engineering, HSE, operational safety, or a similar role in a technical or industrial environment.

  • A degree or equivalent professional experience in safety engineering, engineering, occupational safety, environmental health and safety, or a related discipline.

  • Strong understanding of workplace risk assessment, hazard controls, incident investigation, and safety documentation.

  • Experience working with contractors, technical teams, construction activities, manufacturing, testing, or other high-risk operations.

  • Fluent German and proven experience working directly with German authorities and regulatory bodies.

  • A practical, structured, and confident approach, with the ability to challenge unsafe decisions and influence teams at all levels.

Desirable experience

  • Aerospace, space, defence, rocketry, propulsion, chemical processing, construction, or high-energy testing.

  • German permitting, inspection, environmental, occupational-safety, construction, or hazardous-materials processes.

  • Emergency response, contractor safety, operational-readiness reviews, audits, or safety training.

  • Formal health and safety, process-safety, environmental, or occupational-safety qualifications.

Benefits and important information:

  • We offer top-decile compensation packages, bonuses and meaningful equity, to attract exceptional aerospace talent.

Please note, we are a fast paced, hyper-scaling startup. You will need to be comfortable working extended hours with high levels of autonomy, ownership, and flexibility, with contracts structured around a 48-hour working week.

We are committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, has equal access to opportunity, and can thrive. We welcome different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences—and believe our differences make us stronger.

descriptionHtml:
L’histoire du groupe Theodo et son succès
Theodo accompagne depuis 2009 les entreprises innovantes dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de produits digitaux ingénieux - tels que la plateforme TF1+, l'application LCL Pro ou l'application France Identité Numérique - en tirant parti du meilleur de la technologie et de l’approche Lean.

Theodo connait une croissance exceptionnelle depuis 15 ans : nos équipes rassemblent plus de 750 Theodoers, principalement des Software Engineers, passionnés de technologie et d’amélioration continue. En 2025, le groupe Theodo génère 100M€ de CA. Chez Theodo HealthTech, l'entité experte en santé, nous accompagnons tous les acteurs de la santé dans le développement des dispositifs médicaux digitaux sur-mesure. Grâce à notre expérience du Lean et de la tech, combinées à notre connaissance de la santé, nous concevons et développons des dispositifs médicaux numériques qui s'intègrent dans le parcours de soins des patients (thérapies digitales - DTx, essais cliniques virtualisés, parcours de soins digitalisés). Notre but est de réaliser des produits qui changent la vie de leurs utilisateurs, qu'ils soient soignants ou patients.
Ton équipe : Tu rejoindras une communauté tech de plus de 120 Theodoers : software engineers, tech leads, engineering managers et architectes, avec lesquels tu pourras échanger, apprendre et progresser au quotidien. Chez Theodo, les techs travaillent en équipes projet, constituées en fonction des besoins de chaque client. Tu feras partie d’une équipe de Theodoers à taille humaine (4 à 5 personnes), réunissant Software Engineers, Tech Lead et Product Manager. Ensemble, vous collaborerez étroitement avec le client, avec des échanges réguliers pour partager vos avancées, approfondir la compréhension de son problème et faire évoluer le produit au plus près des besoins de ses utilisateurs. Tes futures missions : En tant que Software Engineer Fullstack chez Theodo, ta mission sera de concevoir et développer des produits digitaux utiles, performants et durables pour répondre aux problématiques de nos clients et de leurs utilisateurs. Tout au long de tes projets, tu seras accompagné pour monter en compétences et apprendre à écrire du code de qualité, à comprendre les enjeux produit et à intervenir sur l’ensemble du cycle de vie d’une application, de la conception au déploiement. Ce que tu vas apprendre en tant que Software Engineer chez Theodo :
  • Comprendre le problème de ton client et y répondre avec un produit performant, maintenable et orienté valeur, en intervenant sur tout le cycle de production, de la conception au déploiement.
  • Produire du code de qualité dans les délais, en intégrant tests, refactoring et standards techniques de l’équipe, quelle que soit la technologie utilisée.
  • Mener des investigations techniques, débugger efficacement et corriger les défauts de manière pérenne, dans tout type d’environnement.
  • Analyser en profondeur des problèmes dans le code pour développer son esprit de résolution de problèmes
  • Travailler avec un LLM pour accélérer les développements
Les problématiques et les technos sont très différentes d’un projet à l’autre, voici quelques exemples :
  • Hub Santé : lancé par l’Agence du Numérique en Santé en 2024, vise à connecter en temps réel les 83 SAMU, SMUR, SDIS et autres acteurs de l’urgence, dans un écosystème historiquement fragmenté. Accompagnée par une équipe de 3 experts Theodo, l’ANS a déployé une plateforme nationale d’interopérabilité permettant une coordination critique plus fluide et sécurisée. Résultats : +10 SAMU connectés dès la phase pilote, interopérabilité effective sur plusieurs périmètres et conformité HDS maintenue.
  • Vidal : référence centenaire de l’information médicale, a développé avec Theodo un assistant médical basé sur l’IA générative pour fournir aux professionnels de santé des réponses fiables en un temps record et sécuriser la prescription. En 8 semaines, une équipe de 4 experts Theodo a conçu un POC de chatbot RAG connecté à la base Vidal, capable de réduire le temps de recherche tout en garantissant traçabilité et fiabilité des sources. Objectif : renforcer la confiance des praticiens et faire entrer Vidal dans l’ère du service médical “fonctionnel”.
Parmi les technos les plus représentées sur nos projets, tu pourras être amené à travailler avec : Java (Spring Boot), Angular, Node (Nest), React (Next), Python… Tes perspectives d'évolution : Notre ambition est de former les leaders de la tech de demain. Grâce au coaching et formations que l’on propose, tu pourras :

Une méthodologie basée sur l’apprentissage continu : Chez Theodo, nous avons construit notre approche tech autour d’une conviction forte : on développe d’abord les personnes, avant de développer les produits. Notre Lean Tech® System met l’accent sur l’apprentissage continu : tu évolueras dans un environnement qui investit sur le long terme, où l’objectif est de te permettre de progresser chaque jour, tout en construisant des produits utiles et performants pour nos clients. Profil recherché : Nous recherchons avant tout des potentiels plus que des compétences déjà acquises. Si tu n’es pas encore un·e développeur·se chevronné·e, ce n’est pas un frein : ne te retiens pas pour postuler.

  • Tu es promoteur de l’IA, notamment sur les sujets de GenAI, et tu cherches à progresser en continu grâce à la veille technique

Pourquoi rejoindre Theodo HealthTech ? Son objectif : t’épauler dans ton quotidien et parler objectifs de carrière via des séances de coaching hebdomadaires. 🎯 Participation à des projets associatifs grâce à la Fondation Theodo (Ada Tech School, Code Phoenix, Article 1…) 🎉 Soirées mensuelles, keynotes et week-end d’entreprise annuel Le package : 📈 Actionnariat salarié pour être associé à la réussite du groupe 💸 Prime d’intéressement indexée sur la croissance de Theodo 🖥 Budget équipement (ordinateur, smartphone, écouteurs…) 🧒 Des avantages fournis par notre CSE (sport avec Gymlib,...) 🏖 5 semaines + 8 à 12 RTT/an 🩺 Mutuelle (SideCare) prise en charge à 50% 🍽 Carte ticket-restaurants Swile 🧒 Aides et places en crèche réservées Prêt à nous rejoindre ?

You must leverage your global expertise and continuous improvement mindset, in order to build the foundational infrastructure required for our international People Operations function to scale. You will leverage data, critical thinking, and problem solving skills to influence business leaders and deliver solutions which drive higher performance, retention and motivation across teams at all levels of the organization.

title: HR Manager
descriptionHtml:
About 3E:

3E is a mission-driven company dedicated to creating a safer and more sustainable world. We offer award-winning regulatory intelligence and AI solutions to help organizations protect people and products. With over 35 years of experience and a global presence, we empower our customers with innovative compliance solutions. 

You will get to work at a company that combines startup agility with the stability of an industry leader. Partner with enterprise customers and global experts to advance environmental safety and solve complex data science challenges.

Join us and make an impact!

About the Role

3E is growing, and with the recent acquisition of the Yordas Group, we have an exciting opportunity to shape how our UK teams come together and work as part of a broader global organization. We’re looking for an experienced HR Manager who can play a key role in integration today while helping build the strong, scalable HR practices that will support our teams well beyond the transition.

As a trusted, hands-on partner to employees and leaders, you’ll help people navigate change while ensuring day-to-day HR operations run effectively. Looking beyond the integration, you’ll work closely with colleagues across our global HR organization to strengthen people practices, improve processes and systems, and contribute to regional and global initiatives as the role evolves.

This role requires a regular presence in our Lancaster office, with a minimum of three days onsite each week. Being close to the teams you support will help you build strong relationships, understand the local organization and culture, and provide responsive, effective HR support.

If you enjoy building relationships, improving how things work, and helping people navigate change, this is an opportunity to make a meaningful contribution during an important transition and help shape the future of HR operations at 3E.

What You’ll Do

  • Serve as a trusted HR advisor to UK employees, managers, and leaders on employee relations, performance management, absence, grievances, disciplinary matters, and workplace investigations.

  • Help employees and managers navigate organizational changes, including integration activities, new HR processes, benefits changes, communications, and culture initiatives.

  • Manage complex employee relations matters with appropriate judgment, documentation, and alignment with UK employment law and company policies.

  • Oversee key HR operations across the employee lifecycle, including onboarding, offboarding, employee changes, leave administration, benefits, and employee records.

  • Serve as a UK subject matter resource for payroll-related legislation and statutory requirements, partnering with Finance, the regional HR team, and external payroll providers.

  • Manage regional HR and benefits vendors, resolving issues and helping ensure employees receive responsive, high-quality support.

  • Maintain and improve HR policies, procedures, employee resources, and documentation in line with employment legislation and business needs.

  • Monitor changes in employment legislation and help ensure HR practices remain compliant.

  • Maintain accurate HRIS data and employee records and support HR reporting and analysis.

  • Partner with Legal, Finance, Talent Acquisition, local leadership, and regional HR colleagues on employment, compliance, recruitment, payroll, and people initiatives.

  • Identify opportunities to simplify and improve HR processes, systems, and workflows.

  • Create and maintain SOPs and share knowledge across the HR team to strengthen consistency and business continuity.

  • Contribute to regional and global HR projects as the organization continues to grow and evolve.

What Makes You a Great Fit

Required

  • 10+ years of progressive HR experience, including at least 2–3 years of HR Manager-level experience supporting regional or multi-country HR operations.

  • Strong knowledge of UK employment law and HR practices, with the ability to translate requirements into practical guidance for employees and managers.

  • Significant hands-on employee relations experience, including managing complex or sensitive employee matters.

  • Experience independently managing complex HR processes with strong attention to accuracy and compliance.

  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, including experience advising and supporting managers.

  • Comfortable working in a global, matrixed environment and collaborating with colleagues across functions and geographies.

  • Able to navigate ambiguity, changing priorities, and organizational change while exercising sound judgment.

  • A continuous-improvement mindset with experience identifying and implementing improvements to HR processes.

  • Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage competing priorities.

  • High integrity and discretion when handling sensitive and confidential information.

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.

  • Experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT or Copilot to improve the efficiency or quality of your work.

  • Fluency in written and spoken English.

  • Ability to work from our Lancaster office a minimum of three days per week.

Preferred

  • CIPD or equivalent qualification.

  • Additional language skills, such as Turkish, German, or French.

  • Experience supporting HR operations in a high-growth, matrixed organization.

  • Experience contributing to or leading HR projects and initiatives in a dynamic, global environment.

title: Infrastructure Program Manager
descriptionHtml:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO

  • Build the machine that builds the machine. Join TechOps at the forefront of advanced manufacturing, we’re building the production system that will enable commercial fusion. The Production lines, tooling, and processes are being developed from the ground up; you'll create the ways of working, not inherit them.

  • Work at the frontier of manufacturing technology. Bring your creativity to evaluate, qualify, and deploy processes with no industry playbook, every component you build and every process you shape goes directly into the core of the stellarator magnet technology.

  • Do work that matters, and see it grow. The hardware you build is the product and your career grows with it, from prototyping and process development through quality and industrialization, alongside exceptional colleagues from around the world.

  • Make an impact you can point to. In a small, fast-moving team, your calls on equipment, quality, and process directly shape how a world-class deep-tech company produces superconducting magnets with results visible on the shop floor, not buried in a slidedeck.

YOUR IMPACT

You are the bridge between detailed infrastructure planning and the single integrated master schedule that governs Alpha's delivery. Without dedicated infrastructure schedule ownership, dependencies like infrastructure readiness for the magnet factory (drainage, cryo supply, extraction systems) quietly fall behind because nobody owns translating detailed site-level planning into the program-level view leadership actually uses to make decisions. You make sure that never happens by accident.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Own and actively manage all infrastructure and siting project schedules across Alpha and Stellaris - buildings, utilities, permitting milestones, and site readiness

  • Translate infrastructure -specific schedule detail into validated, structured inputs for the Master Scheduler's integrated master schedule, ensuring infrastructure milestones, dependencies, and readiness dates are correctly reflected

  • Identify infrastructure -specific critical path items and interdependencies - for example, infrastructure readiness depending on equipment or magnet-line arrival dates - and flag risks early

  • Partner closely with the Master Scheduler, Risk & Change Manager, and Individual Project Managers (Alpha Construction Project Manager, Site Development Program Manager's team) to keep infrastructure schedules and the integrated timeline in sync

  • Maintain infrastructure milestone governance discipline across all programs, ensuring consistent coding and leveling conventions

  • Support gate-readiness by preparing infrastructure-specific schedule status inputs ahead of release gate decisions

WHO YOU ARE

  • Experienced in managing infrastructure or site development schedules on complex capital programs, ideally spanning multiple sites or projects in parallel

  • Comfortable working with a federated schedule structure - translating detailed infrastructure planning into a broader integrated programme view

  • Strong cross-functional communicator, able to align site project managers and technical teams with the Master Scheduler's baseline

  • Fluent in English; German is a strong advantage given the permitting and contractor landscape]

  • Comfortable operating with high autonomy in a fast-scaling, still-being-built environment

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

  • Technical Screening (60 min)

  • Technical Panel (2x60 min)

At Proxima Fusion, our mission is bold: making limitless clean energy a reality. To get there, we need a high-performing, diverse team that brings different perspectives, challenges assumptions, and builds together with purpose. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. We don’t look at how you identify, what you look like, who you choose to worship or what ethnicity you are. We care about what you can bring to the table.

descriptionHtml:
Ingénieur de Recherche à l’Unité d’Economie Appliquée de l’ENSTA (F/H) :

Contexte :

ENSTA, établissement d’enseignement supérieur et de recherche sous tutelle du ministère des Armées, développe des activités de formation, recherche et innovation dans les domaines de la défense et de la sécurité, des transports, de l'énergie, des activités maritimes, du numérique et de la santé.

L’école, présente sur deux campus, à Paris-Saclay et à Brest, est membre de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris. Classée dans le Top 10 des meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France, elle a pour mission :

  • la formation d’élèves ingénieurs civils et militaires, de cadres et docteurs pour les secteurs public et privé,

  • la recherche et l’innovation de haut niveau en relation étroite avec l’industrie des grands secteurs de souveraineté au sein de 6 unités de formation et de recherche (UFR).

Début 2026, l’Unité d’Economie Appliquée de l’ENSTA (UEA, i3-CRG, CNRS) s’engage dans un projet de quatre ans financé par l’Agence Innovation Défense (AID). Ce projet s’appelle RésiCheVal (Résilience des chaînes de valeur). L’UEA s’intéresse à développer les outils permettant d’évaluer la capacité des filières associées à l’industrie de défense à résister dans un environnement géopolitique incertain où l’innovation technologique permanente est souvent une condition essentielle de la supériorité des forces armées.

Activités principales

L’ingénieur de recherche sera rattaché(e) à l’Unité d’Economie Appliquée (UEA). Il est attendu des candidat(e)s d’être en mesure :

  • De contribuer à la production d’états de l’art sur les formalismes de théorie des graphes en matière d’étude des chaînes de valeur dans le domaine des biens d’armement.

  • D’accompagner la production d’outils d’aide à la décision fondés sur ces formalismes.

Avantages :

  • Transports (participation forfaitaire de l’employeur à hauteur de 75 %)

  • Forfait mobilité durable (jusqu’à 300€/an)

  • Possibilité de télétravail (après accord du manager et dépôt d’une demande)

  • Subvention employeur au restaurant administratif et/ou à la cafétéria de l’établissement

  • Comité d’action sociale, avec notamment des événements et animations proposés au personnel, salle de sport sur adhésion,

  • Mutuelle (participation à hauteur de 50% de l’établissement)

Aménagement du poste de travail et recrutement inclusif :

Tous nos postes sont ouverts aux candidats en situation de handicap.

ENSTA s’engage à un recrutement favorisant l’égalité, la diversité et l’inclusion. Toutes les candidatures sans aucune distinction (âge, handicap, sexe, nationalité, religion, orientation sexuelle…) ont leur place dans notre processus de recrutement.

ENSTA est membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris (IP Paris). Dans le cadre d’IP Paris, l’école participe aux activités des centres interdisciplinaires notamment du centre interdisciplinaire d'études pour la Défense et la Sécurité (CIEDS, soutenu par le ministère des armées et l’agence de l’innovation de défense (AID)). Elle est à l’origine de la création du Centre interdisciplinaire Mers & Océans, inauguré en janvier 2025. Des chercheurs de l’école travaillent également en collaboration dans le cadre d'études portées par les centres Hi-Paris, lauréat en 2024 IA Cluster, E4C ou E4H notamment.

ENSTA résulte de la fusion le 1er janvier 2025 d’ENSTA Paris et d’ENSTA Bretagne. Son siège est situé à Palaiseau (91), sur le campus de Paris-Saclay et elle a un autre campus à Brest. Elle met en place une nouvelle formation d’ingénieur unifiée sur les deux campus (Paris-Saclay et Brest) à la rentrée académique 2026/2027.

Afin de préserver le bien-être au travail, l'école mène une politique active en matière de conditions de travail, reposant notamment sur un juste équilibre entre vie personnelle et vie professionnelle.

title: Interim QA Specialist
descriptionHtml:
About us

Rentman is a B2B SaaS scale-up building a smart, powerful operations management platform to support event and media production teams. Our users plan everything from small shoots to massive festivals in 70+ countries, and they all rely on Rentman to keep their gear, people, and timing perfectly in sync. We’re based in Utrecht (NL) with a second office in Toronto (CA), and our 100+ team members work in a culture that’s open, flat, and inclusive, where curiosity drives us, ownership matters, and everyone has the freedom to challenge ideas and make an impact. Check out our public roadmap to see what’s coming next!

Mission of this role

As an interim Senior QA Specialist at Rentman, you make sure every release reaches customers without regressions. You own the test strategy across our 3 product teams and finish moving regression testing from a manual release-day cycle to an automated, shift-left E2E suite. Without this role, quality depends on manual testing on release day, bugs show up in staging or production, and the move to automated testing stalls. This is an interim position: the duration is still to be confirmed, and the role ends once the assignment is complete.

What you'll do

  • Join refinement with the product teams and write Gherkin (Given/When/Then) acceptance specs that developers turn into tests

  • Test new features on staging, going beyond the acceptance criteria to find edge cases, and file clear, reproducible bug reports in Jira

  • Write and review Playwright tests (TypeScript) in the frontend repo, and review developer-written tests in pull requests

  • Monitor the daily automated regression run in GitHub Actions, triage failures the same day, and fix flaky tests at the root cause

  • Run release-day regression and the OWASP ZAP security scan for each release, and give a clear go / no-go call

  • Migrate the remaining legacy tests and decide what is worth automating and what stays manual

  • Organise cross-team QA days and coach developers so they own their tests

     

What we are looking for

  • 5+ years in QA on web applications

  • At least 2 years writing and maintaining UI test automation in code (Playwright, Cypress or Selenium, ideally TypeScript/JavaScript), not only record-and-play tools

  • Strong manual and exploratory testing, with bug reports developers can act on without follow-up questions

  • You have defined a test strategy (what to automate, what to test manually, coverage), not only executed test cases

  • Experience running automated tests in CI (GitHub Actions or similar)

  • You get developers to adopt new habits through pairing, good examples and clear specs, not by policing

     

Nice to haves

  • Experience with complex B2B SaaS

  • Playwright specifically, and Gherkin / BDD

  • Experience leading a shift-left change or coaching developers to own their tests

  • API testing (REST, Postman or similar)

  • Basic security testing (e.g. OWASP ZAP)

  • Mobile app testing (iOS / Android)

What you’ll get

  • Competitive salary based on experience, plus 8% holiday allowance

  • A results-based bonus based on company performance (up to a full 13th month's salary)

  • 25 vacation days to recharge

  • Earn an extra day of PTO for each year at Rentman, from your second anniversary up to five years.

  • A 4-week paid sabbatical after 5 years to go on an adventure

  • Flexible WFH policy & work from anywhere for 4 weeks a year

  • Pension plan through BrightPensioen

  • An annual training budget to grow your skills

  • Access to OpenUp for mental well-being and personal growth

  • Your choice of a shiny new Windows, Linux, or Mac

  • Stay active with the team: join the Rentman football team, squash and padel, plus a discounted Urban Sports membership

  • An OV Business card if you live more than 10km from the office

  • An ambitious, inclusive, and diverse international team

  • A flexible, energizing workplace with free lunches, office perks (PS5, ping pong, D&D), legendary karaoke nights, and regular team activities

  • An amazing office in the heart of Utrecht, in the historic Drift 17

Our process

Here's a breakdown of our recruitment process to give you a clear idea:

  • Introduction Call with the recruiter about the job & Rentman, online (30 mins)

  • Past Experience & Culture Interview with the team, online or on-site (60 mins)

  • Final Skills Interview, on-site (60 mins)

title: iOS Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Looking for a new adventure? You’ve come to the right place.

We're an Amsterdam-based team of 90+ (and counting) with 25+ nationalities amongst us! A varied bunch of “Citizens of The World” with a wide range of skills and hundreds of thousands of kilometers under our travel belts. And we have something important in common (other than our very well-worn passports): We want to change the way people travel.

And that's exactly what we're doing, with the travel app to plan, track, and relive trips in a smart and beautiful way.

Polarsteps has over 20 million users already, but, for us, this is just the beginning. We have big plans for the future, and so we need even more talented and enthusiastic people to help us on our journey.

Want to know more about us? Here you go.

Your expedition: iOS development at Polarsteps

We’re a small team, doing big things.

If you haven't seen our app yet, go ahead and check it out, you'll see that we care (a lot) about providing a seamless, top-quality user experience for every one of our travellers. And it is this that has got us ratings of 4.8* and 4.7* on the app stores (where we’ve been featured multiple times). But it doesn’t stop there, not only did Google create this awesome video about us but we’ve been mentioned in two of Apple’s WWDC keynote speeches. And we're one of the top 26 apps for 2026 according to Apple!

We’ve got an impressive past but we’re even more excited for the future, and the impact you can make from day one is huge, with everything you ship affecting millions of users.

Even with that in mind, we believe in truly giving our team members the freedom they need to craft to perfection while encouraging a practical mindset to avoid under or over-engineering mishaps.

We are seeing an enthusiastic and accelerated growth of the travel industry, and with that comes both opportunities and growing pains (especially in the complex, multi-layered travel domain). So, if on top of the challenges inherent to feature development, you enjoy thinking about the performance and scalability aspects of a platform, you're in for a lot of fun with us.

Your itinerary

What your journey at Polarsteps will look like day-to-day.

You will:

  • Working closely with Jimmy (our Lead iOS Engineer), and the iOS team on all things related to our app.

  • Be responsible for implementing new features, improving existing features and maintaining the day-to-day operations of our iOS App.

  • We're product-first; meaning you won't just work within the iOS team, you'll be embedded in a dedicated Product Pillar team, each owning a distinct part of the user journey. Day-to-day you'll work closely with PMs, designers, and engineers across disciplines. It's a genuinely cross-functional setup: PMs, designers, and engineers working together from problem to solution, because the best product decisions happen when technical perspective is in the room early.

  • Proactively improving the maintainability, resiliency and extensibility of our app, addressing technical debt when needed or even better, preventing it when it makes sense.

The equipment in your backpack

What we’re hoping you’ll bring with you.

  • At least 3-5 years of hands-on experience with iOS development

  • Experience working in an agile team environment.

  • A pragmatic approach to problem-solving, and an absence of fear when it comes to tackling big challenges in UI, architecture, or refactoring that 5-year-old piece of legacy code.

  • A strong iOS development background, we work with Swift, but we still have some legacy Objective-C code, so we would love it if you are also familiar with that.

  • Extensive experience with large apps published in the App Store.

  • In-depth knowledge of UIKit, SwiftUI and experience building complex user interfaces.

  • Experience with writing and debugging multithreading code. We use GCD, Combine, and the latest Swift Concurrency.

  • Realm knowledge.

  • Experience with Swift Package Manager is a bonus.

  • Experience using Xcode instruments to optimize app performance and memory consumption.

  • Experience with setting up and maintaining CI/CD pipelines. We use Fastlane and Github actions.

  • Experience leveraging AI tools (e.g., Claude Code, ChatGPT Codex) to improve development speed, code quality, and debugging efficiency.

  • You are already based in the Netherlands

1st class extras

Some cool things to make the journey extra sweet.

  • Salary range: Between EUR 69.000 - 82.000 (medior level) gross per year incl. 8% holiday allowance (based on 40 hours/week). Where you land in the range depends on your experience and skills, assessed during the interview process.

  • Equity: You'll be able to participate in our Polarsteps SAR Plan.

  • A yearly free flight or train ride to a random location! Give our Teleporter a spin here.

  • A shiny new MacBook to work your magic on.

  • Hybrid working, our way. Work from home and the office, we ask everyone to be in the office 2 days a week. It’s how we stay flexible, focused, and meaningfully connected in person.

  • An extensive home office set-up — everything from noise-canceling headphones to a standing desk.

  • 30 days of vacation (for adventures or sitting on the couch, it's up to you)

  • Two paid Culture Days for days that are important to you but not recognized by the official Dutch calendar.-

  • The option to switch up your zoom background by working from another country for up to 8 weeks a year.

  • A personal development budget for that curious mind of yours!

  • A pension plan to help you save for those around-the-world retirement trips.

  • Delicious daily team lunches.

  • Awesome monthly parties, as well as team trips away.

  • A lively office in downtown Amsterdam, with travel costs reimbursed.

  • Free Polarsteps Travel Books to contain all your far-flung adventures.

At Polarsteps, we believe the best products are built by people as diverse as the travelers using our apps! That's why we specifically encourage people underrepresented in the tech industry to apply for a role with us. Because we believe that diversity, be it age, race, sexual orientation, physical ability, ethnicity, or gender identity, makes both the world and the workplace better.

Think this is the path for you? Find out more about how we hire.

The scope below is what the team owns, not a checklist for one person. You'll be staffed on one or two of these areas at a time, according to your strengths and interests, and it will evolve through time based on company needs and personal appetite.

Scope

  • Make employee lifecycle events reliable, fast and auditable end-to-end

  • Own access reviews and least-privilege models; produce and maintain the evidence our auditors rely on

  • Own SaaS procurement and license management: vendor relationships, renewals, and cost optimization across our stack

🔒 Endpoint & SaaS security

  • Own the Mac fleet in Kandji: enrollment at scale, role-based blueprints, fleet compliance

  • The IT layer behind Alan's clinics: practitioner tooling, equipment, access

  • Role and permission automation for healthcare professionals, and their support and escalation process

🌍 Internationalisation

  • Make international expansion something IT accelerates, not something it slows down: a repeatable process where every new market (Canada, KSA, Armenia...) launches on our standard stack from day one

  • Bring acquired entities onto that same platform

Milestones

First 3 months

  • Acquire technical knowledge on Alan's platform: Alan Home, Google Workspace/SSO, Kandji, Cloudflare WARP

  • Take one project end-to-end and ship a first increment

  • Join the IT oncall team as technical escalation

First 6 months

  • Own a workstream end-to-end

  • Deliver one automation or hardening initiative end-to-end

  • Take up documentation and automation on your scope and reduce significantly the bus factor on it

  • Mentor IT teammates on your core expertise

First year

  • Deliver measurable IT toil reduction on your scope

  • Set the technical standards on your domain: how we build, document and review it

  • Build strong cross-functional partnerships (Engineering, Security, Workplace, Clinic, People, Audit)

  • Contribute to hiring and onboarding new teammates

3 years

  • Lead major projects end-to-end across several communities

  • Be the reference the team relies on across at least two domains

  • Mentor the IT team and beyond, and scale IT without a linear increase in manual work

As the community grows, there is room to take on more responsibility: leading a crew, owning cross-community projects, mentoring, hiring.

What we're looking for

Must-have - Technical/hard skills:

  • 3+ years in IT engineering, platform, systems or corporate engineering, with real ownership of production-facing systems

  • Depth in at least one area (platform & automation, identity, endpoint & security) and demonstrated range beyond it.

  • You write code: not as a full-time software engineer, but Python, APIs and pull requests in a shared repo should feel normal

  • Structured problem-solving: diagnoses methodically, asks the right clarifying questions, thinks about failure modes and rollback

  • Comfort with regulated environments: health data, ACPR, ISO 27001, HDS

  • Automation & AI appetite: uses AI tools smartly to accelerate their own delivery, with an instinct for what should be automated or delegated to AI rather than repeated

Must-have - Behavioral / soft skills:

  • Ownership & autonomy: drives topics forward without hand-holding, including when they cross into someone else's perimeter

  • Written communication: Alan is written-first; decisions get argued in public documents and challenged by people outside your team

  • Pragmatic judgment: balances "perfect" vs. "good enough", decides with incomplete information

  • Documentation culture: reduces bus factor through clear documentation and knowledge sharing

Nice-to-have skills / Bonus points if you have:

  • Experience with an internal provisioning or IdP-driven automation platform

  • Kandji or another MDM at scale

  • Cloudflare Zero Trust / WARP, Datadog

  • Audit remediation experience (ISO 27001, HDS)

  • Multi-country rollouts, or IT integration after an acquisition

  • Having mentored, coached or led a (small) crew

title: IT Support Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Clay

AI is unleashing the biggest wave of company creation in history. Clay's mission is to be the engine those companies use to grow to their full potential.

Clay predicts the next best action for your business and then helps you take it. We started by aggregating the best data for B2B companies. Then, we built the infrastructure to run any personalized campaign on top of it, including emails, ads, landing pages, and workflows that make reps more productive. Now, we're building agents that can help grow your company for you. In 2026, we raised a $115M Series D at $7.1B Valuation led by Wellington — and are on track to cross $200M in revenue this quarter. We also launched a $1M Scholarship fund for GTME Education.

Some things to know about us:

  • Our community includes 17,000+ customers, 200+ integration partners, 125+ agencies, 50+ Clay clubs, and 30k members on Slack.

  • Our cultureis unique inside and outside of work. Our team members are also DJs, activists, writers, clowns, marathoners, skydivers, psychedelic therapists, social workers, and more.

  • All employees can work with world-class coaches who specialize in creativity, management, and more.

  • Our operating principles — including negative maintenance and non-attached action — guide our work. Read more about them here.

  • Read about us in the NYT, Forbes, First Round Review, and more.

Hear from our employees directly on our Glassdoor page!

 

About the Role

Clay is scaling fast and the IT function is new. The IT Support Team will be the first point of contact for requests, the team that keeps the queue moving, and a key partner to the Head of IT in building out how the helpdesk operates.

The core of the support engineer role is service delivery: triaging incoming requests, resolving issues quickly, and making sure employees get reliable, responsive support. Alongside that, you'll work closely with the Head of IT to configure workflows and build process in our AI-powered ITSM platform, so the function gets more efficient as Clay grows.

This is a good fit if you take pride in running a clean queue, communicate clearly with employees, and are genuinely interested in building better process, not just executing it.

What You’ll Do (Job Responsibilities)

  • Be the face of IT at Clay. Triage and resolve incoming requests across access, software provisioning, onboarding and offboarding, hardware support, and general helpdesk needs. Employees should feel like IT is fast, reliable, and easy to work with.

  • Own onboarding and offboarding execution. Provision and deprovision accounts, coordinate hardware, and make sure new hires are set up from day one and departing employees are fully off-boarded without gaps.

  • Help build the helpdesk function. Partner with the Head of IT to configure and improve our ITSM platform — define request categories, build intake workflows, and manage queues as the function takes shape and scales.

  • Keep the office running. Support conference room AV, networking equipment, peripherals, and general office tech so employees can do their best work without technology getting in the way.

  • Administer the SaaS stack. Manage day-to-day administration across Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom, Notion, and other core tools — provisioning users, managing settings, and keeping things clean.

  • Handle hardware logistics. Coordinate device provisioning, shipping, receiving, and basic asset tracking so employees have what they need when they need it.

  • Build process, not just runbooks. Document what you own, identify patterns in incoming requests, and flag opportunities to improve or automate recurring work. The goal is a helpdesk that gets smarter over time.

What You’ll Bring

  • 3 to 5 years in IT support, helpdesk, or a closely related role

  • Strong service delivery instincts; you prioritize well, keep queues clean, and close requests with clear communication

  • Hands-on experience with ITSM platforms; you understand how to configure and manage one, not just work inside it

  • Broad SaaS admin experience: Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom, Notion, and similar platforms; you've provisioned users, managed settings, and handled admin tasks across a modern SaaS stack

  • Familiarity with office technology: conference room AV setup and troubleshooting, Meraki or similar networking equipment, common peripherals

  • Experience supporting onboarding and offboarding workflows end to end

  • Technical fluency: comfortable in SaaS platforms, macOS, and basic identity and access management tasks (provisioning, deprovisioning, group management)

  • AI-forward mindset: you use AI tools to work faster, handle volume more intelligently, and improve the support experience

  • Process-oriented: you notice what's inefficient and want to fix it

  • Clear communicator: employees trust you and know their issues are being handled

Bonus Points If You

  • Experience with Serval ITSM, either launching it or working within it day to day

  • Experience at a fast-scaling startup where IT processes were being built out

  • Familiarity with Okta or similar identity platforms at a user/admin level

  • Experience building workflows or automations in an ITSM or similar platform

  • Exposure to broader automation tooling

Why This Role

You'll handle the most visible function in IT and have a real hand in shaping how it works. Clay is an AI-forward company and this role reflects that — we're building a helpdesk that runs well and gets smarter over time. If you want to do solid IT support work at a fast-moving company and help build the process that makes it scale, this is a good fit.

title: Junior Compute Architect
descriptionHtml:
About Fractile

Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts.

 

The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems.

About the Hardware organisation at Fractile
Processor Architecture sits within Fractile’s hardware organisation, which owns everything from compute engine definition and ISA design through memory hierarchies, on-chip interconnects, and the path from early architectural exploration through to tapeout and post-silicon validation. Architecture at Fractile isn’t a paper exercise — it’s built in constant collaboration with logical design, physical design, and verification teams, so that every architectural decision is grounded in what will actually perform in working silicon.

About the team and role
As an Early Career Processor Architect, you’ll join our architecture team to learn how to define the compute engines, ISA definitions and programming models that sit at the heart of our silicon. Working closely with senior architects and our logical design, physical design, and verification teams, you’ll get real exposure to performance modelling, specification writing, bottleneck analysis, and pre- and post-silicon validation — with experienced architects mentoring you as you build toward owning more of this yourself.

About you
We’re looking for someone with a strong foundational understanding of computer or processor architecture — built through coursework, personal projects, internships, placements, or research — who’s genuinely curious about performance and power trade-offs and eager to learn how to navigate them. You don’t need prior industry experience as a Processor Architect; what matters is real hands-on exposure to processor or accelerator design, through a final-year project, FPGA build, RISC-V implementation, internship, or research, plus a comfort working across disciplines and a track record of thriving in ambiguity and fast iteration.

Key Requirements

  • A degree (BEng, MEng, MSc or equivalent) in Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience.

  • A solid foundational understanding of computer/processor architecture, including matrix- and vector-centric floating-point arithmetic and memory hierarchies, gained through study, projects, internships, or research.

  • Some exposure to RTL design concepts and how physical design constraints feed back into architectural choices — academic or internship-level experience is fine.

  • Any hands-on exposure to architectural performance modelling tools (gem5, SystemC, or custom cycle-accurate simulators), compiler/toolchain interactions, or AI acceleration/vector-matrix compute, through study or projects, is highly valued.

  • A clear communicator, comfortable working across architecture, modelling, implementation, verification, and software teams, who thrives in ambiguity and fast iteration.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary: A competitive salary reflective of your experience and the specialist nature of the role.

  • Equity & Ownership: meaningful equity so everyone shares in the value creation

  • Benefits: Private Medical, Dental and Vision, Contributory Pension, 25 Days holiday plus bank holidays and Life/Critical Illness Insurance.

  • Diverse & fun office: we believe the hardest problems get solved by the broadest range of minds. We are committed to Equal Employment Opportunity through attracting and retaining a diverse team and building an inclusive environment.

Fractile is seeking to increase the clock speed of global progress, one chip at a time. We’ve recently raised $220M from investors including Founders Fund and Accel and our most important work lies ahead. Join us!

 

Export controls

Our work involves technologies subject to UK, US and other international export control regulations. Certain roles may require additional eligibility checks to ensure compliance with applicable law. We'll be transparent about this throughout the hiring process.

title: Junior Quantitative Trader | Crypto Options
descriptionHtml:
BlockTech is hiring a Junior Quantitative Trader to join its options trading team in Amsterdam. In this role, you'll help run and improve the systems that trade our capital.

We trade crypto derivatives and spot markets across global venues, 24/7. Our traders don't just watch the systems. They own them end-to-end.

About BlockTech

BlockTech is an algorithmic trading firm headquartered in Amsterdam, with a second office in Singapore. We specialize in market making and trade cryptocurrency derivatives and spot markets globally, using our own capital. We're growing fast and expanding into new markets.

Our traders work side by side with quantitative researchers and engineers. Research, engineering, and trading happen a few meters apart, so the path from a market read to live PnL is short.

What will you do?

You'll be responsible for our day-to-day trading operations, from running the automated systems to managing positions to shaping the strategies that come next.

You will:

  • Run the systems. Monitor and operate our automated trading systems and dashboards in live markets.

  • Tune the pricing. Adjust pricing and parameters as market behavior shifts.

  • Own the risk. Manage positions and the risk that comes with them.

  • Build new strategies. Develop and deploy new strategies together with quantitative researchers and engineers.

  • Spot what’s next. Research new business opportunities and stay on top of market news and changes.

What we're looking for

You'll need:

  • A strong academic background in a quantitative field such as mathematics, physics, statistics, or computer science.

  • Proficiency in Python.

  • Focus and composure behind the screen when markets get busy.

  • A strong sense of ownership and excellent collaboration skills.

Bonus points for:

  • Professional trading experience at a high-frequency trading firm

Pay, location, and relocation

  • Compensation: a competitive base salary plus a very attractive performance bonus based on individual and company results.

  • Trading fund: strong performers get the opportunity to buy into the trading fund.

  • Location: On-site on our trading floor in Amsterdam

  • Visa: BlockTech sponsors the Dutch highly skilled migrant visa.

  • Relocation: All-in relocation package and Dutch classes for international hires. Eligible hires may qualify for the 30% ruling.

What else is in it for you

  • Pension plan, company laptop, and home internet reimbursement

  • An extensive in-house training program and an annual learning and development budget

  • An environment that embraces AI, both to speed up your work and to advance our systems

  • Gym reimbursement and sports during working hours: kickboxing, CrossFit, fitness, and soccer

  • Weekly Friday drinks, monthly outings, quarterly sports competitions, and two trips abroad a year

  • Daily breakfast and warm lunch, plus snacks and drinks all day

How we work

We're a team of trading and tech enthusiasts with a flat hierarchy. Have an idea today, and it can ship tomorrow. The best idea wins, whoever it comes from.

This role comes with a high degree of autonomy. You'll own hard problems from concept to production and solve them your way. We promote reverse leadership, give everyone an equal playing field, and invest in personal and professional development.

Our culture

At our core, we are a team of passionate trading and tech enthusiasts committed to revolutionizing trading through automation. Our collaborative approach ensures that everyone contributes to achieving our ambitious goals.

In this role, you will be both challenged and stretched, with ample opportunities for growth and development, both within and beyond your main responsibilities.

We invest in our people by offering competitive compensation and benefits, fostering innovation, and celebrating success. Our commitment to personal development transcends traditional norms; we provide an equal playing field, promote reverse leadership, and offer boundless growth opportunities for all our employees.

Join us to unlock your potential and drive innovation in the exciting world of algorithmic trading.

title: Key Account Manager 🇫🇷
descriptionHtml:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

Our Account Management team’s purpose is to make our key accounts stay and grow with Alan. We created the team in 2020 and we are now 30+.

Being a Key Account Manager at Alan means joining a team of talented, committed and passionate experts, with different backgrounds.
We move fast, with a lot of ownership, and are proud to tackle big problems!

⭐ Is it you we’re looking for?


As a Key Account Manager, you will:

  • Handle a portfolio of strategic accounts and flagships companies

title: Kfz-Prüfingenieur mit Betrauung (m/w/d) – mit Perspektive zum Abteilungsleiter
descriptionHtml:
Beschreibung

Sie sind betrauter Kfz-Prüfingenieur und möchten nicht nur prüfen, sondern mittelfristig Verantwortung übernehmen? Dann bieten wir Ihnen einen Weg, auf dem Sie in Ruhe in eine Führungsrolle hineinwachsen.

Wir sind die von Hebel Fahrzeugtechnik GmbH. Wir betreiben eigene GTÜ-Prüfstellen in Lüneburg, Lauenburg/Elbe und Hamburg und führen als Partner der GTÜ Gesellschaft für Technische Überwachung mbH amtliche Fahrzeuguntersuchungen durch.

Gut zu wissen: Wir arbeiten eng mit dem von Hebel Ingenieurbüro zusammen – einem etablierten Kfz-Sachverständigenbüro, das professionelle Unfall- und Haftpflichtgutachten für Privat- und Geschäftskunden erstellt. Für Sie bedeutet das: ein breites fachliches Umfeld über die Prüftätigkeit hinaus.

Warum wir jetzt suchen: Wir planen langfristig. Die Leitung unserer Prüfstellen und des ca. zehnköpfigen Teams soll in einigen Jahren in neue Hände übergehen – und wir möchten die Person dafür frühzeitig an Bord holen. Sie steigen zunächst als Prüfingenieur ein, lernen unser Team, unsere Standorte und Abläufe kennen und übernehmen dann Schritt für Schritt mehr Verantwortung. Für die Einarbeitung nehmen wir uns bewusst Zeit.

Ihr Einsatzgebiet: Unsere Standorte Lüneburg, Lauenburg/Elbe und Hamburg.

Ihr Weg in die Führungsposition

Kein Sprung ins kalte Wasser, sondern ein geplanter Übergang in Ihrem Tempo:

  • Ankommen: Prüftätigkeit an unseren Standorten, Kennenlernen von Team, Kunden, Abläufen und der Zusammenarbeit mit der GTÜ
  • Verantwortung übernehmen: erste Aufgaben der fachlichen und organisatorischen Leitung, z. B. Qualitätssicherung, Einarbeitung neuer Kolleginnen und Kollegen, fachliche Ansprechperson im Team
  • Übergabe: Stellvertretung der jetzigen Führungskraft und anschließend vollständige Übernahme der Position

Zuständigkeiten / Hauptaufgaben

Von Beginn an:

  • Durchführung von Untersuchungen der periodischen Fahrzeugüberwachung (HU/SP)
  • Abgasuntersuchungen (AU)
  • Änderungsabnahmen nach §19(3) StVZO
  • Wenn bereits Qualifizierung vorliegt: Begutachtungen im Rahmen des Technischen Dienstes, z. B. für Sondereintragungen, Umbauten und Importfahrzeuge
  • Tätigkeit im Außen- und Innendienst

Schrittweise hinzukommen:

  • fachliche Qualitätssicherung und Einhaltung der amtlichen Vorgaben an allen Standorten
  • fachliche Anleitung, Einarbeitung und Schulung des Teams
  • Ansprechperson für die GTÜ, z. B. bei Audits und fachlichen Rückfragen
  • Ansprechperson für unsere Kunden: Großkunden, Fuhrparks, Werkstätten, Autohäuser oder Einzelkunden
  • Mitwirkung an Dienstplanung, Prüfausstattung und der Weiterentwicklung unserer Abläufe

Qualifikationen / Anforderungen

  • Betrauung zum Kfz-Prüfingenieur – gern auch von einer anderen Überwachungsorganisation, den Wechsel zur GTÜ begleiten wir
  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung
  • Interesse daran, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und ein Team fachlich zu führen
  • Sorgfalt, Zuverlässigkeit und ein hoher Qualitätsanspruch

title: Laboratory technician
descriptionHtml:
About Orakl Oncology

At Orakl Oncology, we are accelerating the development of oncology treatments. Today, fewer than 5% of new cancer drugs succeed in clinical trials. Clearly, new methods are needed. We combine cutting-edge biology and AI to build the next generation of insight platforms with the world’s largest cohort of patient tumor avatars. These avatars fuel our AI-powered predictive engine, helping to anticipate clinical trial outcomes, validate therapies, and uncover new drug candidates. By generating multimodal, real-world data, we deliver insights that consistently outperform existing solutions.

Our mission is simple yet ambitious: to bring more effective treatments to patients who need them - and to make drug development smarter, faster, and more personalized. We collaborate with top hospitals, research institutes, and pharmaceutical companies worldwide. Backed by leading investors, we are a fast-growing, mission-driven startup at the intersection of science and technology.

The company is growing fast, and we are now seeking the best talents to come and join our exciting and ambitious team in the fight against cancer - join us!

Position overview

Orakl Oncology works on a large cohort of patient-derived organoids (PDO) to predict clinical outcomes of patients and derisk clinical trials. We are looking for a dynamic and motivated Lab Technician to help us execute large-scale drug screening assays on our semi-automated platform, either for internal or external projects. In this position, you will:

  • Actively participate in our commercial contracts: you will take care of numerous PDOs of interest and perform drug screening assays to generate high-quality, robust datasets. These results will be leveraged by our data science and computational biology teams to deliver actionable insights and decision-support data to our partners.

  • Work on the expansion of the Orakl biobank: you will work on patient specimens and organoid cell lines to increase the amount of data collected, thus improving our understanding of cancer.

  • Contribute to the optimisation procedures at Orakl: you will bring new ideas and approaches to improve automation and accelerate workflows in both 3D cell culture and drug screening experiments.

  • Ensure smooth laboratory operations: you will play a key role in laboratory maintenance, documentation, and traceability of activities, while proactively anticipating the needs for consumables and reagents.

Required qualifications

  • BSc (or equivalent degree such as BTS, BUT, Licence) in cellular biology, biotechnology or any related discipline.

  • Hands-on experience in mammalian cell culture, 3D cell culture and preferably organoid culture.

  • Hands-on experience in drug screening assays or viability assessment assay.

  • Exceptional attention to detail and organisational rigour.

  • Flexibility, and a taste for overcoming operational challenges.

  • A genuine enthusiasm and passion for teamwork and learning.

  • As part of an international team, ability to communicate clearly in English

  • Genuine curiosity for cancer biology.

  • Strong collaboration and communication skills to interact in an interdisciplinary setting with biologists, ML engineers and researchers.

  • Previous experience working in cancer biology

  • Fluent in English

Recruitment process

  • HR Call (15 minutes call) – An initial discussion to better understand your background, experiences, and motivations.

  • Technical Interview (45 minutes call) – A deep dive into your technical skills and expertise relevant to the role.

  • Lab Case (Around 90 minutes) - You will be directly manipulating in our labs to demonstrate your ability to follow a specific protocol and to work under aseptic conditions.

  • Founder Interview: As final step of our recruitment process, you will meet the CTO of Orakl Oncology in person at our office. This meeting is an opportunity for the founders to assess cultural fit and ensure alignment with our company values.

title: Langfuse - Senior Cloud Infra Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Why Cloud Infrastructure at Langfuse

Your work will keep Langfuse running — everywhere.

Langfuse processes over a billion trace events per month. When a Fortune 50 company relies on Langfuse in production, they're relying on the infrastructure you operate. You'll own uptime, performance, and cost efficiency across our entire cloud footprint — and you'll make sure every self-hosted deployment runs just as smoothly.

You'll operate Langfuse Cloud on AWS ECS Fargate and ClickHouse Cloud, with Datadog as the observability backbone. You'll also own our public self-hosted infrastructure — including our Helm chart, Docker Compose setup, and everything in between — so that teams from startups to enterprises can run Langfuse on their own terms.

This isn't a "maintain what exists" role. We're scaling fast, and you'll be the person who makes sure the infrastructure grows ahead of demand — not behind it.

Langfuse is now part of ClickHouse, which means the team behind the database at the core of our stack is one channel away. Few infrastructure roles give you that kind of direct access to the people who build your most critical dependency.

 

You will grow at Langfuse by

Own Langfuse Cloud operations: You'll run our production environments on AWS ECS Fargate and ClickHouse Cloud. You'll manage deployments, autoscaling, capacity planning, and cost optimization — making sure we stay fast and affordable as traffic scales.

Build world-class observability: You'll own our Datadog setup end to end — dashboards, alerts, and SLOs. When something degrades, you'll ensure we know before our customers do. You'll build the monitoring culture that lets the whole team ship with confidence.

Make self-hosting effortless: Thousands of teams run Langfuse on their own infrastructure. You'll own and evolve our Helm chart, Docker Compose configuration, and deployment documentation. You'll turn "works on my machine" into "works on every machine" — from a single-node setup to a multi-region enterprise deployment.

Automate everything: CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, automated scaling, zero-downtime deployments. You'll replace manual processes with automation that makes the team faster and the platform more reliable.

Scale for what's next: We're growing fast and new product directions — like complex long-running agent observability and real-time evaluation — push the infrastructure in new ways. You'll be thinking ahead about what breaks at 10x scale and building the foundation before we get there. 10x is always just one quarter away here at Langfuse.

Harden security and compliance: As more enterprises adopt Langfuse, you'll help ensure our cloud and self-hosted deployments meet the security and compliance bar that large organizations require.

 

What we're looking for

  • Strong infrastructure or SRE engineer who gets excited about running systems at scale and making them better every day

  • Interest in open source software and genuine enjoyment helping users debug their self-hosted deployments

Bonus points:
