title: Propulsion Functional Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.


Description

We are seeking a talented Propulsion Functional Engineer to join the Storm engine project. As a key member of our System Team, you will play a central role in defining the functional architecture of the Storm engine, ensuring seamless integration and correct interaction between subsystems to meet overall mission requirements.


Key Responsibilities

As a Propulsion Functional Engineer, your responsibilities will include:

  • Functional Engineering

    • Contribute to architecture trade-off studies, sensitivity analyses, and risk assessments, as well as component selection and make-or-buy decisions

    • Contribute to the evaluation and optimization of the engine architecture and operating conditions

    • Develop and maintain functional performance models of the propulsion system using simulation frameworks such as EcosimPro and Python

  • Systems Engineering

    • Contribute to the definition and allocation of functional requirements for the engine and its subsystems

    • Contribute to FMEA (Failure Mode and Effects Analysis) to ensure that the system architecture meets reliability and safety targets

  • Testing & Model Validation

    • Contribute to the definition of demonstrator architectures and operating conditions

    • Analyse test data and use test results to validate and anchor system models


What we would love to see from you

  • Master's Degree or higher (or NZ and AUS "Bachelor with honors") in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related and applicable technical discipline. Alternatively, a bachelor's degree with substantial relevant experience

  • Minimum 2 years of proven experience working with cryogenic propulsion systems

  • Strong knowledge of fluid dynamics and thermodynamics

  • Fluency in English; proficiency in German or French are an asset

  • Basic knowledge of aerospace standards (e.g. ECSS, NASA guidelines)

  • Experience with modelling and simulation tools (e.g. EcosimPro) and/or experience writing scripts in Python

  • (Optional) Hands-on experience developing hardware from concept to working prototypes is an asset

Skills and Behaviors

  • Strong ability to work in close collaboration with others

  • Strong oral and written communication skills

  • Strong analysis and problem-solving skills

  • Strong research skills and ability to infer useful information from partial or even contradictory sources

  • Drive towards excellence coupled with ability to work within time constraints

  • Proficiency in organization and prioritization of tasks

  • Behavior consistent with The Exploration Company’s core values of Mission, Vision, Integrity, Excellence and Teamwork

  • Enthusiasm for space exploration: be ready to have an impact on the future global space industry.

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?  

We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly.

title: Public Funding Coordinator (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
About Focused Energy

Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial fusion. Backed by our $240M Series A — the largest fully secured Series A in the global fusion industry — we are scaling rapidly across multiple geographies.

Based in Germany and the US, we have brought together the top scientific and engineering minds using proven technologies to unlock fusion power at commercial scale. Focused Energy is working to realize game-changing scientific innovation that promises to deliver a clean, sustainable and abundant source of power globally.


Your Role
We are looking for a dedicated Public Funding Project Coordinator (f/m/d) to coordinate the full lifecycle of publicly funded projects in Germany and the EU, from opportunity assessment and application through financial administration, reporting, and close-out. Working closely with Technology & Engineering, Global Corporate Affairs, Finance, and project partners, you will translate funding requirements into clear plans and keep budgets, documentation, and deadlines on track. This is a hands-on, AI-first role for someone who combines financial rigor with practical project coordination, resolves issues early, and improves the tools and processes that make funding delivery reliable.


What You’ll Do
Funding Opportunities & Applications

  • Own the end-to-end coordination of assigned public funding projects, from opportunity assessment and application through financial administration, reporting and close-out.

  • Lead the consolidation of funding applications, translating requirements into clear workplans, responsibilities, and deadlines when the company decides to pursue an opportunity.

  • Enable informed funding decisions by maintaining a transparent opportunity pipeline with clear information on eligibility, deadlines, and required inputs.

Financial Administration & Compliance

  • Drive timely payment requests and financial reporting by bringing together accurate inputs from Accounting, technical project owners, and project partners.

  • Ensure eligible expenditure is tracked and reconciled, and that compliance risks or budget deviations are identified and escalated early.

  • Build and maintain complete, audit-ready project records, including funding conditions, supporting evidence, reporting obligations and correspondence.

Project Coordination & Process Improvement

  • Partner with Finance, Technology & Engineering, Global Corporate Affairs, project partners and funding bodies to resolve questions and keep milestones on track.

  • Improve workflows, templates and data quality, establishing well-organized project information and using data- and AI-enabled tools where appropriate.

What You Bring

  • Practical experience in public funding administration, including assessing new funding opportunities, preparing funding applications, payment requests, reporting, financial documentation, or related grant-management activities. Around five years of relevant experience would be helpful, but we value hands-on capability over a fixed number of years or a particular qualification.

  • Experience with German federal or state funding programmes, particularly those supporting research, innovation or industrial development.

  • An understanding of funding conditions, eligible-cost requirements and audit-ready documentation, with the ability to translate these into practical project plans.

  • A structured, hands-on working style: you manage multiple deadlines, maintain accurate records and follow through on missing information without needing to be chased.

  • Confidence working with spreadsheets and financial or project data, including consolidating inputs and checking information for accuracy and completeness.

  • Fluent German and English, with the ability to explain funding requirements clearly to colleagues, project partners and funding bodies.

  • Ownership and sound judgment: you resolve routine issues independently, communicate risks early, and collaborate effectively across teams without formal authority.


    Nice to have

  • Experience in a public-funding consultancy, research organization, public administration, or a startup or scale-up environment.

  • Familiarity with financial or ERP systems such as NetSuite and an interest in improving workflows through data and AI-enabled tools.


What We Offer

  • Innovative Technology & Mission: Be part of a cutting-edge company working on groundbreaking research in clean energy and scientific discovery.

  • Career Development: We invest in our people. This is an opportunity to join an early, growing company at the forefront of new technology, where you’ll have the opportunity to develop and grow your career.

  • Collaborative Culture: Work with great people in a dynamic, international environment with top-tier scientists, engineers and professionals passionate about solving global challenges.

  • Ownership: Take ownership from day 1 and drive impact by making decisions, solving challenges and shaping the future of our company.

  • Your Success is our Success: We offer a competitive salary and company ownership in the form of stock options, giving you a direct stake in our success and ownership in what we build together.

  • Vacation Days: We support your work-life-balance by granting you 30 days of vacation per year.

  • Snacks and Drinks: Our office fridges are never empty. Enjoy our healthy snacks and drinks. Our Darmstadt office even offers a canteen with delicious lunch options daily.

  • Retirement Plan: If you decide for a private pension plan, we will finance 20% on top of your monthly contributions, plus loyalty incentives.

  • Equipment: We offer state-of-the-art Windows or Apple Laptops. In addition, you will receive a keyboard, mouse and headset so you are fully equipped from day 1.

  • Events: We organize regular events to foster team bonding, encourage collaboration, and build a strong, supportive company culture. Connect with colleagues across departments, share ideas, and have fun together, both in and outside of the workplace.

  • Mobility with NAVIT: We partner with NAVIT to support your flexible commuting needs—whether it’s a public transportation ticket, taxi rides or car-sharing you choose what fits your lifestyle.

  • Fitness with Wellhub: We care about your health. Get access to a wide range of gyms, fitness studios and wellness services across Europe through our partnership with Wellhub.

title: Quantum Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Quandela is a global leader in quantum computing, designing, building, and delivering cutting-edge quantum solutions for research and industry. Its offerings include a very energy-efficient quantum computers for data centers, full-stack quantum computing solutions accessible via the cloud, and algorithm access services for academic and industrial customers. Following a pragmatic, step-by-step roadmap, Quandela has been deploying industrial-grade systems since 2023 while developing future generations of fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of scaling through the integration of thousands of photonic components. Quandela is committed to making quantum computing accessible to all in order to address the most complex industrial and societal challenges. Learn more at: Quandela | Leading Photonic Quantum Computing Solutions

Description of the Project

We are looking for a Quantum Software Engineer to develop the future software stack for controlling utility-scale quantum computers. At the interface of the theory and engineering teams, this ambitious project aims to develop internal tools to streamline the operation of logical quantum circuits on Quandela’s spin-photonic quantum computers.

This position requires a strong understanding of quantum computing protocols on real hardware, strong software engineering skills and proficiency with AI tools.

Your Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop a new compilation stack translating high-level quantum circuits into hardware-aware pulse schedules optimized for our photonic quantum computers.
  • Drive long-term architectural strategy, technical roadmap, and cross-organizational alignment.
  • Contribute to the development of a digital twin, receiving hardware instructions to simulate the behavior of our future QPUs.
  • Stay up to date with the latest developments in quantum software.

How You’ll Grow:

  • 3 months. By the end of the first quarter, you are expected to have a grasp over Quandela’s roadmap and specific approach to quantum computing. You understand how user operations are currently compiled to machine instructions and how that is expected to evolve
  • 6 months. By the end of the first semester, you have a firm understanding of Quandela’s technology and are already a key contributor to the compiler codebase for the near future
  • 12 months. You have a long-term vision over the quantum software’s activities, and are the owner of one or more work packages for strategic projects.

Requirements

What we're looking for:

  • Master’s, or PhD in Quantum related field.
  • 2/4+ years of relevant experience in quantum software, quantum hardware automation, or related topics.

Must-have:

  • A good understanding of photonic-based quantum computing.
  • Strong proficiency in python.
  • Experience working at the interface of software, experimental hardware, and theory teams in the industry or academia.
  • Collaborative mindset, able to serve as a bridge between various teams.

Important, but you can grow here:

  • Proficiency in at least one system language (C++ or Rust)
  • Exposure to the quantum computing frontends and related ecosystem (e.g. cirq, qiskit, openqasm, cuda-q).
  • Hands-on experience with quantum photonic systems.
  • Familiarity with compilation mechanisms such as LLVM or compilation to microcode.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary, flexible based on your experience
  • Profit-sharing & company savings plan
  • 100% health coverage (Alan)
  • 50% transport reimbursement or sustainable mobility bonus
  • Meal vouchers (Swile), Gymlib fitness support
  • Childcare assistance & referral bonuses (€1,000–€2,000)

What we offer:

  • A meaningful role with real ownership, from day one
  • A team eager to collaborate and grow with you
  • A hybrid work model (3-4 days/week onsite in Massy, 1 day in Paris or 1 to 2 days remotely)
  • Daily exposure to the entire quantum stack — from high-level APIs to low-level firmware, and everything in between.

Process

  • Hiring Managers Interview (45')
  • Use Case (a live use case or one to be prepared at home and presented afterward)
  • Meeting with the teams
  • 2 to 3 reference check
  • Offer

(This process is provided for guidance only and may evolve depending on the roles)

At Quandela, we believe that the strength of our team is the plurality of experiences, perspectives, and journeys. We are committed to building a respectful, inclusive, and welcoming work environment. All applications are welcome.

title: Head of Engineering, Sales Management Tools
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month. 

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

Why the UK

The UK is home to our headquarters where more than 70 team members are based, with team members joining us from companies like Tide, Klarna, Revolut, Capital One, Teya, Wise, Starling, Monzo, and many others! Our London office is located at Sea Containers, just by London Bridge - this is also where a significant number of our most senior leaders sit, which makes it a natural base for a Head of Engineering.

So, now we are looking for our Head of Engineering, Sales Management Tools, to join us in UK.

About The Role

Sales Management Tools owns MonieCRM, the operating system for Moniepoint's 50,000-strong sales network. This is not a CRM we bought — it is a workforce operations platform built entirely in-house for a multi-level field sales hierarchy, and it is how those teams run their day to day: the portfolio of businesses they manage, their own teams, their goals and performance, the physical and digital resources they need in the field, and an emerging AI-assisted support layer. Sixteen capabilities span onboarding and network management, pipeline and portfolio, performance and goals, compensation, and sales experience and support.

A significant part of the domain moves money. The platform owns wallets, commission calculation and attribution, cashout and welfare funds for a network that drives the overwhelming majority of company revenue — which makes financial correctness, not just availability, a core engineering requirement of the role.

Alongside that, the domain covers partner management, a rewards and retention platform serving tens of millions of users, and our marketing technology stack, including the engineering and customisation of Braze, the platform we use for customer engagement. The mandate is modernisation and reliability: re-architecting systems that have grown very quickly and making them dependable at a scale of more than 20 million users. This is a platform engineering and legacy modernisation challenge first and foremost, and prior CRM or SalesTech experience is genuinely not required.

Who You Are 

  • You have 10–15 years of overall software engineering experience, with at least 5 years leading engineering teams through growth phases.
  • 5+ years of hands-on, production-level experience writing and shipping Java code as a practising engineer. This means years spent writing Java yourself, not years spent overseeing teams who write it.
  • At least 5 years of experience managing managers — leading an engineering organisation through other engineering leaders, rather than running a single team.
  • You have proven platform engineering experience at scale — building and running complex distributed systems, not feature delivery alone.
  • You have navigated legacy migrations and re-architecture projects at 20M+ user scale.
  • You have strong backend engineering skills in high-throughput, data-intensive distributed systems, and are proficient in Java and Spring Boot.
  • You have managed and developed large engineering teams of 20 or more members.
  • Experience building systems where financial correctness matters — commissions, payouts, wallets, ledgers or equivalent — is a strong advantage.
  • A fintech or payments background is strongly preferred. CRM or SalesTech domain experience is nice to have and explicitly not required.
  • Exposure to customer engagement or marketing automation platforms such as Braze is a plus, but not a requirement.

Cultural Alignment

As well, we assess every candidate across eight dimensions that define how great leaders operate at Moniepoint. We look for evidence of all eight throughout the process, not just in a single conversation.

  • Customer Obsession: Build deep empathy for users. Solve problems intuitively, and fix root causes, not just tickets.
  • Craft: Master the fundamentals. Reason from first principles, make trade-offs explicit, and raise the bar on quality.
  • Systemisation: Turn repeating decisions into scalable mechanisms. Reduce cognitive load and raise engineering quality.
  • Urgency: Move with disciplined speed. Act autonomously within scope, remove friction, and escalate risks early.
  • Ownership: Treat the platform as your own. Take initiative across boundaries and follow through without reminders.
  • No Ego: Put the mission first. Share credit, welcome debate, and never protect status over team outcomes.
  • Candour: Surface uncomfortable truths and risks early. Intelligent failure is welcome; concealment is not.
  • Integrity: Stay truthful and ethically consistent. Refuse toxic behavior. Performance without integrity is unacceptable.

What Success Looks Like In The Role

  • Legacy systems modernised and re-architected, with measurable improvement in reliability and performance.
  • Commissions and earnings calculated, attributed and paid accurately and on time, at network scale.

descriptionHtml:

Upsun is the software factory for human-AI workflows. We give teams one unified platform to create, review, deploy, and run software, with AI agents and humans working in sync. Developers, DevOps engineers, and platform teams use Upsun to build and ship with confidence, without wrestling with infrastructure.

Upsun brings this together through two products: one that shapes the work, and one that runs it.

  • Upsun Dispatch™: the AI-first product accelerator. Dispatch governs and simplifies collaboration between AI agents and cross-functional human teams, so work gets shaped, reviewed, and moved to production faster. Ship better code, not just more code.
  • Upsun Cloud: the Cloud Application Platform for AI acceleration. Cloud is where that software runs. It helps organizations launch agentic software into production confidently and reliably, with:
    • Predictable performance, even at scale
    • Secure, compliant environments by default
    • Real-time observability and profiling built in
    • Cloning, configuration, and provisioning in seconds

The name says it all. "Up" means uptime, reliability, and acceleration. "Sun" reflects our follow-the-sun-support, a 24x7, globally distributed support team keeping the lights on while you rest. Our core belief is that software should power brighter solutions and greater innovation. 

What's our commonality, our cultural fabric? A curious spirit and a thirst for knowledge; an eagerness for innovative ideas and cultures. We believe we can build anything together in an environment that frees you to do your best work.

Our values: 

🌿 We make a positive impact.

As a Product Manager at Upsun, you own a significant area of Upsun Cloud, our cloud application platform, and the outcomes it delivers for the developers who build on it. The team you join owns the platform's foundations: the API, the runtime, environments, and the reliability every application running on Upsun depends on. And because Upsun is the cloud application platform humans and robots love, much of what you build will be used by AI agents as much as by people.

Throughout, you act as the key voice for the user, making sure everything we ship contributes meaningfully to an exceptional developer experience.

  • Problem definition: Synthesize inputs from customers, support, sales, and engineering into clear problem statements, constructively testing underlying assumptions.

  • Solution definition: Explore options with your team, weigh trade-offs, and land on the right scope.

  • Ship small, iterate fast: Release in increments and shorten the loop between shipping and learning.

  • Technical execution: Collaborate with engineering (especially infrastructure and systems teams) to deliver platform capabilities that are reliable, scalable, and developer-friendly.

  • Design for humans and agents: Build with two audiences in mind—ensuring features, APIs, documentation, and error messages serve both people and AI agents.

  • Customer and data authority: Connect with customers regularly, serve as an internal advocate for their needs, and define metrics that demonstrate value for users and the business.

  • Influence across teams: Build alignment across engineering, design, Product Marketing, support, and leadership.

  • Go-to-market: Partner with Product Marketing early so go-to-market strategy helps shape the product, not just the launch.

What you bring

  • Product management experience: Proven experience in product management owning a distinct product area, ideally focused on developer platforms, PaaS, or cloud infrastructure.

  • Technical depth: Understanding of building, deploying, and running applications in the cloud, with the ability to collaborate closely with infrastructure engineers on multi-tenant architectures or distributed systems.

  • Software development background: Familiarity with building software using languages such as Python, Ruby, JavaScript, PHP, Go, or Rust.

  • CI/CD, containers & APIs: Hands-on experience or close collaboration with CI/CD workflows, Docker/OCI container technologies, and a clear vision for intuitive API design.

  • AI fluency: Daily use of modern AI tools to research, draft, and prototype workflows, paired with a realistic understanding of where current tools and models fall short.

  • Agentic development: A strong perspective on autonomous agent architecture and how agentic workflows are transforming modern software engineering.

  • Navigating ambiguity: Comfort with turning unstructured problem spaces into clear strategies and taking thoughtful action even with incomplete information.

  • Collaborative communication: Clear written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of listening, building consensus, and uniting teams around a shared vision.

  • Data-informed decision making: Ability to seek out and evaluate data to guide decisions and track success.

Bonus points for

  • Experience using Kubernetes, or building self-service platforms on Kubernetes

Where we hire

At Upsun, remote work isn’t just a trend. It’s our foundation. Upsunners are a global workforce, and we thrive in a multicultural team. We’re committed to open source and an open, welcoming environment. Our team spans more than 30 countries and a wide range of experience levels, and we’re currently hiring for this role in Germany, Canada, Spain, France, and the UK. Our interview process is a chance for us to understand how you think, what you’ve built, and what you want to take on next, and for you to get to know us. Together, we’ll explore where your strengths and interests meet the challenges our teams are solving.

title: Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Location: UK. Fully remote, or from our London office next to East Croydon Station

Working pattern: Fully remote working is allowed, and the London office is available to you

Reports to: CTO

About Us

Hozah is a tech-led, award-winning company driving change in the parking industry and reimagining urban mobility. Our mission is simple but powerful: to transform parking into a seamless, automated experience, paving the way for smarter, more sustainable cities.

With recent recognition as PayTech Company of the Year, a place among Deloitte’s Top 50 Fastest Growing Tech Companies in the UK, and significant VC/PE investment, we’re one of the fastest scaling companies in the country.

Role Overview

You will build the products drivers and car park operators use every day: ANPR camera enforcement, pay-by-web, Autopay, permits, a client console and a motorist account app, across about 160 sites, and the new products we build next. We are a small engineering team, and we form teams around the work from the people we have.

We work in Kotlin on the backend (Spring Boot WebFlux, a domain-driven layering of domain, edge services and repository, Postgres, Axon event sourcing and Pub/Sub) and in TypeScript with Next.js and React on the front end, on GCP and Kubernetes. You do not need to know Kotlin to apply. Our engineers work with AI coding agents day to day, and we are looking for people who use them well and check what they produce.

Every engineer here is product-minded. You will talk to the people who use what you build, decide with product people what is worth building, and find out afterwards whether it worked.

You will report to the CTO and work with a team that reviews each other’s work.

The Mid-level

Mid-level Software Engineer. You own features end to end: you shape them with a product person, build them, test them, release them and look after them once they are live. You work inside an existing architecture with senior review. The work is mostly Kotlin backend plus Next.js and React front end.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the delivery of what you are given, from the first ticket to production, with tests, and be the person who fixes it if it breaks.

  • Talk to the people who use what you build, and use what you learn to shape and cut scope.

  • Write acceptance criteria, and check a feature after release to see whether it was used and whether it worked.

  • Work in our existing codebase and its layering, and keep it consistent for the next engineer.

  • Use AI coding agents as part of how you work, and be accountable for everything you ship, however it was written.

  • Take part in the on-call rota and look after what you ship.

  • Review other engineers’ pull requests, and welcome review of your own.

Who we’re looking for

  • You’re product-minded. In the last 12 months you’ve talked to real users or customers, and what you learned changed or cut the scope of what you built. You write acceptance criteria, you check a feature after release, and you can say whether something you shipped got used.

  • You’ve shipped production code end to end in the last 12 months, in any language. You can say what you personally built, and what happened after it went live.

  • You test as you build. You can describe a bug you shipped and the test that would have caught it.

  • You use AI coding agents in real work today, and you can describe how you check what they produce, including a time one was wrong.

  • You’re willing to be on call, and you take ownership of what you ship. You don’t need to have been on call before.

  • You work well in an existing codebase with a layered or domain-driven structure that you did not design, and you read before you write.

  • You’re comfortable across the stack. You’ve changed a React or Next.js front end, or worked properly against an API contract, even if you lean backend.

  • You review others’ pull requests, finding real problems and saying so well, and you change your own design when review shows you a better way.

You do not need a degree, a particular programming language, or Kotlin. Experience of Axon, Temporal, GCP, Kubernetes, Terraform, parking or payments is welcome, but none of it is required.

This advert is for the Mid-level. If you have more senior experience, see our Senior Software Engineer vacancy here.

What We Offer

  • Real ownership: mid-level engineers own whole features, and senior engineers own a product area.

  • A team that works with AI coding agents every day and measures what they do for us.

  • A strong, high performing culture, with genuine influence over how that culture develops as Hozah grows.

  • Fully remote working in the UK, with access to a fully refurbished, modern office, right next to East Croydon Station (with a fully stocked kitchen, offering free breakfast, lunch and drinks!).

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

Role Overview

As a Member of Technical Staff, Modeling in Harvey Research, you’ll own how we adapt and improve leading open-weight models for legal work.

We recently post-trained our first model built for legal work, and we’re now building the team to scale up our post-training efforts. You’ll own the post-training recipe across SFT and RL, including reward design and verification for challenging, semi-verifiable legal tasks. You’ll help set the research direction and carry ideas from experiments through training runs to models used by customers. You’ll join a small, high-bar team of hands-on engineers and researchers, where each person owns a large part of the work.

We’re looking for research engineers and scientists who have gotten training runs working at scale, are immersed in RL for language models, and want their work to reach users quickly.

Learn more about our work at harvey.ai/research.

What You'll Do

  • Own and pursue a research agenda to improve model capability on long-horizon legal reasoning and agentic workflows.

  • Design and run post-training experiments across SFT and RL, building on leading open-weight models.

  • Develop reward functions and verifiers for semi-verifiable tasks, including rubrics, learned preference models, and expert preference data, and study where they break.

  • Run and debug training at scale, addressing divergence, reward hacking, and instability.

  • Build and use rigorous evals to track improvements and decide what ships.

  • Design, implement, test, and debug code across our research stack.

title: Revenue Operations Engineer | AI & Automation (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
At Superchat, we're rebuilding how businesses talk to their customers. The phone call, the contact form, the support ticket: all of it is being replaced by messaging and AI. We're building the platform that runs underneath.

Founded in 2020, Superchat has become the platform of choice for 10,000+ businesses worldwide, from globally recognized brands like Allianz, Auto1, Enpal, Danone, and GASAG to the small businesses, dental practices, and one-person startups that need to look bigger than they are. Today, millions of messages flow through Superchat every single day.

We started as a unified inbox: one place for every channel a customer might pick, WhatsApp, email, SMS, Instagram. Then ChatGPT happened, and the second chapter began: AI agents that respond across chat, email, and voice at the quality of the best human teams.

We're 100 people, profitable, and have raised €18M in funding (last round 4.5 years ago, we've been growing on our own money since). Headquartered in Berlin.

As a Revenue Operations Engineeer you anchor the build end of Revenue Operations - our internal product team whose customers are the GTM functions: Sales, CS, Marketing, and Finance. You build the AI, automation, and data foundations that make these teams faster, smarter, and more scalable, owning the end-to-end delivery of internal tools, integrations, and AI-powered workflows - from problem framing and architecture through launch, adoption, and measurable business impact.

Who We Want

Proven GTM Systems Builder.
You bring 3+ years of hands-on experience in RevOps, GTM Engineering, SalesOps, Business Systems, or a comparable B2B SaaS role, and can show production systems you personally built.

AI-Native Builder.
You've integrated LLMs into real workflows or tools through APIs and understand how to move beyond prompting into reliable, production-ready use cases.

Product-Minded Systems Thinker.
You start with the user and business problem, map the relevant process and data dependencies, and choose the simplest scalable solution rather than defaulting to a particular tool.

Integration & Data Fluent.
You're comfortable working with APIs, webhooks, JSON, authentication, data models, and the movement of data between multiple systems.

End-to-End Owner.
You can take a project from discovery and architecture through building, testing, rollout, documentation, monitoring, and ongoing improvement.

Pragmatic Production Engineer.
You ship quickly without treating reliability as optional, including appropriate testing, error handling, security, observability, and documentation.

Business-Impact Oriented.
You connect technical work to measurable outcomes such as pipeline, productivity, data quality, speed, cost, or customer experience.

Clear Cross-Functional Communicator.
You can explain technical decisions simply, manage trade-offs, work through ambiguity, and collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
You are fluent in written and spoken English; German is a plus.

Curious & Self-Directed.
You actively experiment with new technologies, learn through building, and share useful findings without chasing novelty for its own sake.

Who We Don’t Want

Uses tools without hands-on depth.
You've used CRM and AI tools but lack hands-on experience building automations, configuring systems, or solving operational problems end-to-end.

Struggles with cross-functional GTM processes.
You find it hard to understand how operational decisions ripple across the wider GTM motion and the business as a whole.

Weak on the technical fundamentals.
You struggle with APIs, JSON, data models, authentication, debugging, or moving data reliably between systems.

Can't connect the build to the business.
You can't explain technical choices clearly, manage trade-offs, influence stakeholders, or connect a build to its wider business impact.

Uses AI without shipping anything real.
You use ChatGPT or Claude but can't point to an LLM-powered workflow, integration, or tool you've personally built and shipped.

Builds without thinking about what comes after.
You've built isolated automations without considering maintainability, documentation, ownership, failure handling, or how the solution fits into the wider architecture.

Your Day To Day

Building: AI, Automation & Systems (~ 65%)

  • You identify and productionize high-leverage AI use cases across Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, and Finance, including LLM integrations, workflow design, evaluation, guardrails, and monitoring
  • You design and build lightweight internal applications and interfaces that remove recurring manual work, improve decision-making, and are simple for teams to adopt
  • You build end-to-end workflows using Make, n8n, and custom logic, including business rules, system handoffs, error handling, alerts, and ongoing monitoring
  • You create clean, maintainable data flows between HubSpot, the data warehouse, billing, support, and other GTM tools using APIs, webhooks, enrichment pipelines, and data activation
  • You work deeply within HubSpot's objects, properties, workflows, and integration layer to support complex use cases without creating fragile or unnecessarily complicated architecture

Discovery & Solution Design (~ 15%)

  • You translate scoped or ambiguous business problems into clear technical solutions, define success metrics, and choose the simplest approach that can deliver meaningful impact

Deployment, Adoption & Documentation (~ 20%)

  • You test, document, deploy, and iterate on solutions with end users so they remain secure, maintainable, reliable, and useful after launch

Stakeholders

RevOps: Your peers and manager to collaborate on projects and daily initiatives
Engineering team: Coordinate with engineers for projects that may require product know how and integration across the engineering tool stack GTM teams as and when required

Why People Choose Us

  • We believe in the power of in-person collaboration: We genuinely love being together in the Berlin office. That's where the best ideas happen, decisions move faster, and we learn from and grow with each other every day. We do offer some flexibility for remote work, but our default and our energy is being in the room together.
  • We're an international team with diverse cultural backgrounds and languages. Openness, mutual respect, and the exchange of different perspectives shape the way we work together.
  • We value ambition and drive. We're looking for people who take ownership, show initiative, and are excited to grow quickly.
  • We work with a high degree of ownership and a strong learning mindset. Asking questions, staying curious, and continuously improving are part of our everyday culture.
  • We care deeply about humility and teamwork. No egos, open feedback, and a willingness to learn from one another matter more to us than titles.

Benefits & Culture

title: Revenue Operations Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Morpho

Morpho is a leading Decentralized Finance (DeFi) lending protocol backed by a16z crypto, Paradigm, Ribbit Capital, Apollo, Vaneck, Coinbase Ventures, Variant and 50 others to build an open credit network giving anyone, anywhere, access to the best possible terms. Morpho is experiencing exponential adoption, with over billion in deposits on the network and used by institutional clients including Bitwise, Galaxy, and Anchorage Digital and the largest crypto exchanges, such as Coinbase, Binance, and Kraken. Now, Morpho is scaling its team of contributors to establish itself as the open credit network, not just of DeFi, but of the world.

 

Why Morpho Exists

Everyone has the potential to build something great for the world. But fulfilling that ambition almost always requires more: people willing to trust you with their capital. Yet access to capital still depends on where you live, who you know, and which institutions are willing to trust you. Even when capital is available, it sits fragmented across disconnected networks and hidden behind intermediaries. The result is a system that fails most of the people it should serve. Borrowers overpay. Lenders earn less than they should. Many are shut out entirely, not because they are unworthy of credit, but because today's infrastructure was never built to connect them. Morpho exists to solve this. Full article here.

Morpho's GTM motion has grown faster than the operations behind it. Must Have Skills & Experience

title: Robot Learning Engineer, Human Motion Data (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
About EASE

EASE builds active, AI-powered exoskeletons for logistics and manufacturing. As a TUM spin-off, we have just started series production, and paid pilots with well-known logistics companies have led to first purchase orders. Our goal: move every parcel better, manually with an exoskeleton or autonomously with a robot.

The role

Our exoskeletons are deployed in real warehouses and production plants and capture what video-only datasets miss: body pose, joint kinematics, interaction torques, vision, and hand forces from real human work. Your job is to turn that data into skills our humanoid can actually perform, so that human workers and robots can work side by side on the same tasks.

What you'll do

  • Map human motion onto humanoid kinematics and close the embodiment gap

  • Train manipulation and whole-body policies with imitation and reinforcement learning

  • Evaluate in Isaac Lab or MuJoCo and on our in-house humanoid, and measure the value of our data

  • Define what data training needs and help build our training setup, including GPU compute

  • Turn new research on robot foundation models and VLAs into prototypes

What you bring

  • Master's or PhD in robotics, CS, ML or similar, with hands-on experience from industry or research

  • Imitation or reinforcement learning on real robots (e.g. Diffusion Policy, ACT, PPO)

  • Strong Python and PyTorch; C++ is a plus

  • Physics simulation and sim-to-real transfer

  • Solid kinematics, dynamics and control

Nice to have

  • Learning from human data (egocentric video, motion capture, retargeting)

  • Humanoids, legged robots or exoskeletons; publications at CoRL, RSS, ICRA or NeurIPS

Don't tick every box? Apply anyway. What you have built matters more than a perfect match.

What we offer

  • Data almost nobody else has, from a product in series deployment

  • Our own humanoid and the chance to build Physical AI at EASE from the ground up

  • Competitive salary plus virtual stock options (VSOP)

  • Flexible hours, hybrid in Munich, mobility benefit

  • Budget for conferences and further training

How to apply

Send your CV with links to GitHub, papers or robot videos.

Martin Fleischer, CEO & Co-Founder

title: Sales / Account Executive - Research Participants - United Kingdom
descriptionHtml:
Sales / Account Executive - Research Participants - United Kingdom

 

 

Location: Remote (UK)
Type of contract: Freelance
Hourly Rate: £19 (pay based on actual study time)

About Prolific

Prolific is not just another player in the AI space – we are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world.

Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organizations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills.

The RoleDo you have a device with a microphone? Get paid to take part in voice interviews. We’re inviting sales and account executives based in the UK to take part in a research study run by an institution focused on global policy change. This is a paid research participation opportunity, not a job as a sales or account executive. Quick signup, flexible schedule, real payouts. 

Your voice can help build a picture of how people across the UK think and talk about important issues, and that evidence is designed to inform real policy decisions. Every participant counts, and together we’re working toward a shared research goal.

The project launches in about one week, and places are allocated on a first come, first served basis, so please sign up as soon as you can.

What you’ll be doing

  • Taking part in a short voice conversation with another participant
  • Completing a short online survey sharing your views and experiences
  • Giving honest, considered responses based on your own perspective
  • Watching the community research goal progress as more participants take part

What you’ll bring

  • Residence in the UK
  • Fluent English
  • A device with a working microphone
  • No research experience or specialist research qualifications required. We want a genuine cross-section of the UK population.

Why join this project?This is a chance to be part of something meaningful and have a say in research aimed at shaping policy. Once the findings are published, we’ll share them with participants so you can see the impact of your contribution.

Please note that you must be new to Prolific to sign up successfully. If you already have a Prolific account, there is no need to register again. Simply ensure your profile is up to date to be eligible for this and future opportunities.

Why Prolific is a great platform to join as a Participant

Joining our platform as a Prolific participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future using your professional expertise. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes, and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home.

We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioural data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.

We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviours into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity.

Prolific's Candidate Privacy Notice explains what personal information Prolific may process, where Prolific may process your personal information, its purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over Prolific use of your personal personal information.

title: Sales Director
descriptionHtml:
Why Faculty?


We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

About the role

As a Sales Director at Faculty, you will lead the sale of large-scale strategic AI engagements, building trusted C-suite relationships and establishing Faculty as the essential partner for the world's largest companies pursuing transformative AI initiatives.

You will drive high-impact growth by navigating complex sales cycles, collaborating closely with key strategic partners like Accenture, and shaping bold, differentiated commercial solutions that empower Fortune 500 and FTSE 100 organisations to harness the full power of artificial intelligence.

What you'll be doing

  • Building and managing a qualified pipeline of high-value strategic opportunities directly across target enterprises and joint Accenture partnership channels.

  • Leading end-to-end sales processes from initial executive engagement through to contract signature, orchestrating technical scoping, solution design, commercial negotiations, procurement, and legal reviews.

  • Developing enduring executive relationships with C-suite sponsors at global enterprise accounts, positioning Faculty as their premier partner for transformative AI initiatives.

  • Collaborating with Accenture leadership to identify joint pursuit opportunities, align go-to-market strategies, and coordinate enterprise deal execution.

  • Achieving quarterly and annual revenue targets while maintaining rigorous forecasting discipline and providing leadership with clear visibility into pipeline health.

  • Partnering with cross-functional technical and delivery teams to shape compelling, credible propositions that solve complex organisational challenges.

Who we're looking for

  • You bring a proven track record of enterprise sales leadership, successfully closing complex, multi-quarter strategic engagements with Fortune 500 or FTSE 100 companies.

  • You excel at C-suite engagement, building trusted relationships with senior executives such as CTOs, CSOs, and CISOs who sponsor enterprise-wide AI and safety initiatives.

  • You possess strong technical sales acumen, comfortably translating complex AI concepts into clear business value while engaging fluently with both technical teams and commercial decision-makers.

  • You bring valuable partnership sales experience, adept at collaborating with consulting firms, systems integrators, and hyper-scalers to co-sell and win major accounts.

  • You master deal orchestration and commercial structuring, with expertise in guiding multi-stakeholder work streams and negotiating sophisticated agreements like MSAs and outcome-based pricing models.

  • You demonstrate exceptional executive presence and resilience, presenting confidently to boards and C-suites while maintaining energy and momentum through complex, high-stakes sales cycles.

The Interview Process

  1. Talent Team Screen (30 mins)

  2. Introduction call with the Hiring Manager (30 mins)

  3. On site Panel Interview (60mins)

  4. Final interview with one of our Managing Directors (30mins)

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours.

A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI.

title: Sales Engineering Manager Core - Mainland Europe
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara is seeking an experienced and results-driven Sales Engineering Manager to focus on our Enterprise Core business in Mainland Europe (DACH & France). You should have experience managing and ideally growing a dispersed sales engineering team in a high-performance environment. Our Sales Engineering team is full of problem solvers and tinkerers who are not afraid to get their hands dirty (literally) and play a critical role in demonstrating and communicating the value of Samsara's platform with our largest customers.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support to make a larger impact.
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven't been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and inspired to go farther than you have before.
  • You are a team player: At Samsara, sales is a team sport. We help each other out by sharing best practices and focusing on winning as a team.

In this role, you will:

  • Manage individual and team performance ensuring our partnership with sales, product, support, and customer success teams are productive and efficient
  • Work with Account Executives and Regional Sales Directors on account planning, strategy, and sales call activity
  • Manage escalations (product issues, feature requests, etc.) in a pre-sales environment
  • Participate in customer/prospect calls as a trusted advisor
  • Partner with other Sales Engineering leaders to improve the overall Sales Engineering organization at Samsara

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • B.S. degree in Computer Science or similar
  • 5+ years of sales engineering management experience
  • Experience with Software Product sales: Infrastructure, SaaS
  • Knowledge in one or more of these areas of expertise: IoT, Networking / Security, SaaS, Cloud Technologies, or Physical Security
  • Strong technical and business acumen
  • Excellent communication, customer service, and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to partner with a broad coalition of stakeholders, ranging from sales, product, marketing, support, and customer success, and from individual contributors to executive team members across the organization
  • Demonstrated leadership, creativity, and problem-solving abilities
  • Excellent presentation and organizational skills
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced dynamic environment
  • Ability to travel as needed
  • Location: Remote, Germany or Remote, France
  • Language requirement: Fluent German or Fluent French

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. title: Sales Engineering Manager Core - UK&I
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

Samsara is seeking an experienced and results-driven Sales Engineering Manager to focus on our Enterprise Core business in the UKI. You should have experience managing and ideally growing a dispersed sales engineering team in a high-performance environment. Our Sales Engineering team is full of problem solvers and tinkerers who are not afraid to get their hands dirty (literally) and play a critical role in demonstrating and communicating the value of Samsara’s platform with our largest customers.

You should apply if: 

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support to make a larger impact. 
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value trust and human relationships built over time.

  • You are a team player: At Samsara, sales is a team sport. We help each other out by sharing best practices and focusing on winning as a team.

In this role, you will: 

  • Manage individual and team performance ensuring our partnership with sales, product, support, and customer success teams are productive and efficient

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. title: Senior Associate - Talent & Venture Development (gn) @ Atlantic Core Team, Berlin
descriptionHtml:
Early-Stage Venture Capital & Talent


At Atlantic, we back founders in AI, compute, spacetech, and deep tech, often when it's still just a few people and a big idea. What happens next depends less on the idea and more on who joins them: the first engineer who can actually build it, the CTO who scales it, the commercial lead who gets it into the world.

That's why talent sits at the heart of our Venture Development work. We go out and find those people ourselves, and we help our companies build the organizations around them: how teams are structured, how people are paid, and how they grow.

Why we are looking for you now

The breakthroughs we're most excited about will come from people who aren't on anyone's radar yet. We want to find them first and put them where they can have the biggest impact. Talent is scarcer than money in today's VC climate. Promising startup ideas are often replicable. People are not. Together with you, we will:

  • Find and win top talent for our portfolio companies, with a focus on senior and leadership hires

  • Run searches end to end, from mapping the market to closing the candidate

  • Advise our companies on comp, equity, org design, and hiring, and turn what works into playbooks

  • Translate business plans into hiring plans, and step in on urgent people topics when needed

  • Use AI and automation to make all of this faster and better

Your role

Headhunting is the core of the job. You'll spend your days finding people others miss and convincing them that this is the company worth joining. But you won't just fill roles. You'll sit with our investment team and portfolio CEOs to work out what team a company actually needs, what to pay, and how to structure it, then go and build it. You own your projects and make your own calls. This isn't a standard recruiting gig.

Who you will work with

  • Our Investment team

  • CEOs and leadership teams across our portfolio, from pre-seed to exit

  • External partners, from recruiters to employment lawyers

What you must have done before

  • Placed the top %: You've found and closed exceptional people, the ones everyone wanted, in fast-growing startups or scale-ups.

  • Set the bar high: Your standards for excellence are very, very high, for the people you hire and for your own work.

  • Ready to do more than search: You want to shape how companies are built, not just fill roles, and you're interested in org design, comp, and equity.

title: Senior Automation Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Roboyo AI is a category shaper in Applied AI and Agentic Automation. We help leading enterprises move from automation projects and AI experiments into governed, production-grade systems that execute real work across workflows, processes, products and services. 

Our heritage is in scaled enterprise automation; our future is Applied AI and Agentic Automation: autonomous agents, AI engineering squads, process orchestration, data and knowledge foundations, and human-in-the-loop governance embedded deeply into how our clients operate. 

We are not here to sell AI theatre. We are here to turn AI into working systems, measurable outcomes and repeatable transformation programs. 

ABOUT THE ROLE 

We are looking for a Senior Automation Engineer to design, develop and deliver enterprise-scale automation solutions using UiPath, Automation Anywhere and Python. This is a genuinely hands-on, multi-platform role: you will actively build solutions in all three technologies, not simply oversee delivery. 

You will own technical delivery from design and development through testing, deployment and optimisation, working with clients and distributed delivery teams. This is a UK-based remote position with occasional travel for client engagements, project workshops and team activities. 

As an L3 engineer, you will tackle complex technical problems independently, contribute to code quality and engineering standards, and support less experienced colleagues without being expected to act as a dedicated people manager. 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 

  • Design, develop, test and deploy robust automation solutions using UiPath, Automation Anywhere A360 and Python. 
  • Own technical delivery across the automation lifecycle, including solution design, documentation, release and post-deployment optimisation. 
  • Build integrations with REST APIs, databases and enterprise applications; create maintainable Python applications and components beyond basic scripting. 
  • Develop reusable components and frameworks, applying secure coding, exception handling, logging and operational monitoring practices. 
  • Diagnose and resolve complex automation failures, integration issues and performance bottlenecks in development and production. 
  • Apply engineering standards across Git, peer review, automated testing and CI/CD; contribute to reliable deployments. 
  • Collaborate with architects, technical leads, analysts and clients to translate business needs into practical technical solutions. 
  • Support effort estimation, technical documentation, knowledge sharing and mentoring for junior and mid-level engineers. 
  • Keep current with automation technologies and identify practical opportunities to improve delivery and client outcomes. 

MUST-HAVE QUALIFICATIONS & COMPETENCIES 

  • 4+ years of hands-on experience designing, developing and delivering RPA or intelligent automation solutions; this does not mean four years in each individual technology. 
  • Strong hands-on UiPath development experience, including Studio, Orchestrator and REFramework. 
  • Strong hands-on Automation Anywhere development experience, particularly Automation 360 (A360) and Control Room. 
  • Strong practical Python development capability beyond basic scripting, including maintainable code, applications, integrations or reusable components. 
  • Demonstrable experience actively developing solutions across UiPath, Automation Anywhere and Python. 
  • Experience owning solutions from technical design and development through testing, deployment and support. 
  • Solid software engineering foundations, including debugging, exception handling, reusable code and testing. 
  • Experience with REST APIs, SQL/databases, JSON, Git and enterprise-system integration. 
  • Ability to investigate complex problems, communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders, and work independently in distributed teams. 
  • Based in the UK and willing to travel occasionally for client engagements, project workshops and internal collaboration. 

NICE-TO-HAVE QUALIFICATIONS & COMPETENCIES 

  • UiPath Advanced RPA Developer or equivalent certification; Automation Anywhere Advanced or Master RPA Professional certification. 
  • Experience with Power Automate, Power Platform or other automation technologies. 
  • Experience integrating with SAP, Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics or similar enterprise applications. 
  • Familiarity with Azure, AWS or Google Cloud and CI/CD tooling such as Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions. 
  • Experience with intelligent document processing, such as UiPath Document Understanding or Azure Document Intelligence. 
  • Exposure to generative AI, Agentic AI or AI-enabled automation use cases. 
  • Experience in consultancy, client-facing delivery or Agile teams. 

IDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE 

You are a pragmatic, hands-on engineer who enjoys building reliable solutions and solving difficult problems. You can move confidently between UiPath, Automation Anywhere and Python, take ownership with limited supervision, work directly with clients, write clear and maintainable code, and share knowledge with colleagues. You value delivery quality and practical outcomes over technology for its own sake. 

WHAT WE OFFER 

  • A UK-based remote role, with opportunities to collaborate with international delivery teams and clients. 
  • The opportunity to work across multiple leading automation platforms rather than being restricted to one technology. 
  • Exposure to emerging AI and Agentic Automation capabilities as our offering evolves. 
  • A collaborative specialist consultancy environment that values initiative, technical expertise and practical problem-solving. 
  • Opportunities to broaden your technical skills and contribute to the development of our automation practice. 

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

descriptionHtml:
Join our expanding engineering team!

We're hiring a permanent Senior Backend Engineer to join our Asset Sales group as we scale one of the most important parts of M-KOPA's FinTech platform. Build distributed, event-driven microservices and help shape what AI-native engineering looks like at M-KOPA.

🚀 Scale challenges: Build backend systems serving millions across multiple African markets

🌍 Fully distributed: Work remotely with diverse teams across UK, Europe, and Africa

What You'll Do

At M-KOPA, you'll build and operate distributed C# and .NET microservices on Azure, working within an event-driven architecture at significant scale. This is an outcomes-driven role: we care far more about the value you create than where you sit or how many hours you're online. You'll own what you build end-to-end — from idea, through implementation and deployment, into production and iteration.

Technical Environment 💻

  • Modern C# stack: Distributed C# and .NET microservices

  • Cloud & orchestration: Hosted on Azure using Kubernetes

  • Architecture: Event-driven, supporting products used at significant scale

  • Observability: Grafana, Azure Application Insights, logs, traces, and metrics

  • AI tooling: Claude and other AI tools used throughout the engineering workflow — design exploration, code generation and review, test writing, incident investigation, and technical communication

Our Engineering Approach 🚀

  • AI-native engineering: We want engineers who tinker — experimenting with new tools, agents, and workflows, and sharing what works

  • Guardrails as we accelerate: Automated tests, SLOs, alerting, observability, and deployment safeguards around everything we ship

  • Own it beyond the pull request: Design for idempotency, retries, out-of-order events, and failure modes, and know how your services behave in production

  • The Campfire Rule: Leave the systems you touch a little better than you found them

  • On-call as feedback, not heroics: Engineers who build our systems also help operate them, using incidents to make the platform more resilient

What You Need

We're looking for a senior engineer who's curious, autonomous, and highly trusted. You're comfortable owning the entire software stack — including supporting infrastructure — throughout its lifecycle, and you see production data, not just deployment, as the real measure of "done."

Required Experience:

  • Strong grasp of C# and .NET development

  • Experience with event-driven systems - We use Azure Service Bus, but would love to hear from you if you have experience with similar messaging technology (Kafka, RabbitMQ, etc.)

  • Microservices architecture experience, ideally on Azure and Kubernetes

  • Experience using observability tooling (e.g. Grafana, Application Insights) to understand production behaviour

  • Comfort using AI tools as part of a daily engineering workflow (design, code review, testing, incident investigation)

  • DevOps culture mindset, including on-call/production ownership

  • Proven ability to collaborate effectively in distributed teams across time zones

  • Continuous learning mindset and openness to feedback

Location & Benefits

  • Fully remote role, collaborating during core GMT working hours

  • Benefits package, which includes Bonus, Growth Shares & On-Call Allowance

  • Work with diverse teams distributed across UK, Europe, and Africa

  • Personalised training budget to support your development

  • Home office setup budget

  • Professional development programs and coaching partnerships

  • Family-friendly policies and flexible working arrangements

  • Well-being support and career growth opportunities

Our Mission 🌍

We create financial inclusion for the traditionally excluded through a fair, flexible, customer-centric financing model. We strive to drive greater inclusion of women, youth, and low-income communities.

Our Impact 💚

Our technology has created measurable change:

  • Connected 📱: 2.5 million first-time smartphone users connected

  • Prosperous 💰: 70% of customers use M-KOPA products for income generation, with 35,000 livelihoods created for agents

  • Green 🌱: 2.155 million tonnes of CO₂ avoided since 2010 through clean energy, refurbished devices, and e-mobility

Ready to build C#/.NET systems — with AI as part of your craft — that create real-world financial inclusion? Apply Now!

Why M-KOPA?

At M-KOPA, we empower our people to own their careers through diverse development programs, coaching partnerships, and on-the-job training. We support individual journeys with family-friendly policies, prioritize well-being, and embrace flexibility.

Join us in shaping the future of M-KOPA as we grow together. Explore more at m-kopa.com.

Recognized four times by the Financial Times as one Africa's fastest growing companies (2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026), named on CNBC's World’s Top Fintech Companies 2025 & 2026 and by TIME100 Most influential companies in the world 2023 and 2024 , we've served over 10 million customers, unlocking $2 billion in cumulative credit for the everyday earners across Africa, in addition to over 10,000 e-bikes financed in Kenya.

M-KOPA is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer committed to assembling a diverse, broadly trained staff. Women, minorities, and people with disabilities are strongly encouraged to apply.

M-KOPA explicitly prohibits the use of Forced or Child Labour and respects the rights of its employees to agree to terms and conditions of employment voluntarily, without coercion, and freely terminate their employment on appropriate notice. M-KOPA shall ensure that its Employees are of legal working age and shall comply with local laws for youth employment or student work, such as internships or apprenticeships. 

M-KOPA does not collect/charge any money as a pre-employment or post-employment requirement. This means that we never ask for ‘recruitment fees’, ‘processing fees’, ‘interview fees’, or any other kind of money in exchange for offer letters or interviews at any time during the hiring process.
