title: Strategic Account Director
descriptionHtml:
About Payoneer

Founded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world’s underserved businesses to a rising global economy. We’re a community with over 2,500 colleagues all over the world, working to serve customers, and partners in over 190 countries and territories.

By taking the complexity out of the financial workflows–including everything from global payments and compliance to multi-currency and workforce management, to providing working capital and business intelligence–we give businesses the tools they need to work efficiently worldwide and grow with confidence.

Role Summary

Location: London

Hybrid

Full-Time

The Strategic Account Director is a new-business, quota-carrying hunter responsible for landing the largest, most complex enterprise logos in the market. You own the full pursuit — from target identification and outbound generation through multi-threaded, committee-driven sales cycles to signed, revenue-producing contracts. Your prospects run cross-border volume at scale, they are today served by incumbent banks or specialist fintechs, and displacing that incumbent is the job.

This is a role for someone who is energized by the chase: building conviction where none exists, getting into the CFO's and Treasurer's office cold, orchestrating a pursuit team through a long and technical evaluation, and closing seven-figure relationships. You set the bar for how strategic new business gets won at Payoneer.

This is a strategic role. It is deliberately seated centrally under Global Sales so the strategic-accounts motion can be built, proven, and standardized before ownership is distributed to the regions. You will work hand in hand with regional heads of sales for in-market coordination and, over time, help shape how this function scales across the field.

What You'll Do 

  • Hunt and land net-new strategic accounts. Own a new-business quota. Identify, prioritize, and pursue the highest-value target accounts in your territory (typically $500K+/month cross-border volume, up to $10M+/month strategic targets) and convert them into signed, funded customers.
  • Generate your own pipeline. Build top-of-funnel through disciplined, research-led outbound — direct executive outreach, referrals, partner and ecosystem channels, and events. Do not wait for leads; create them.
  • Break into the buying committee cold. Get in front of and build conviction with CFOs, Treasurers, Finance Operations, and Compliance/Risk leaders at target accounts. Multi-thread deliberately so a deal never rests on a single contact.
  • Displace the incumbent. Position Payoneer's speed, global coverage, economics, and platform breadth to unseat incumbent banks and specialist competitors. Run competitive displacement plays and build the business case that moves an entrenched buyer.
  • Own complex, long-cycle deals end to end. Drive multi-stakeholder, technical, compliance-sensitive evaluations from first meeting to close. Own the mutual close plan, procurement, legal, and commercial negotiation.
  • Sell the platform. Lead with value, not features. Land the entry wedge and architect the deal to open cross-border payments plus high-value services (Capital, Treasury/FX, Embedded/Platform Payments, Workforce/EOR, and emerging rails) — maximizing initial contract value and expansion potential.
  • Qualify with discipline. Apply Payoneer's Sandler-based methodology — Up-Front Contracts, Pain Funnel, budget and decision qualification — to every pursuit so you invest team resources only in winnable, real deals.
  • Orchestrate the pursuit team. Direct Solutions/Pre-Sales, Product Specialists, Compliance, and RevOps as a coordinated deal team through the sales cycle, and quarterback executive sponsorship where needed.
  • Forecast honestly and close on time. Own a credible, hygienic pipeline and forecast in CRM. Drive deals to close dates and call your number straight.
  • Set up the win for the long term. Land with a clean handoff to Customer Success and a clear expansion thesis, so every logo you close becomes a growth account.

Who You Are 

  • 8+ years in enterprise B2B sales with a strong bias toward new business / new logo acquisition — not primarily account management or renewals.
  • Consistent, demonstrable record of hitting or exceeding a new-business quota on complex, high-value deals.
  • Proven ability to self-generate pipeline through outbound and to break into cold enterprise accounts at the executive level.
  • Experience closing long-cycle, multi-stakeholder deals with meaningful (six- to seven-figure) contract value.
  • Demonstrated success selling into and navigating executive buying committees — CFO, Treasury, Finance, Compliance/Risk.
  • Strong commercial and negotiation skills, including running procurement, legal, and margin-protective deal structuring to close.
  • Fluency operating in a matrix environment and orchestrating a cross-functional pursuit team.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred

  • Background in payments, fintech, banking, treasury, FX, or cross-border commerce.
  • Track record of competitive displacement against incumbent banks or specialist fintechs.
  • Experience selling a multi-product platform and structuring land-and-expand entry deals.
  • Familiarity with a structured sales methodology (Payoneer uses Sandler).
  • Exposure to compliance-sensitive, regulated sales environments (KYC/AML-aware selling).
  • Strong CRM discipline and data-driven pipeline management (e.g., Salesforce).

#LI-FD1

The Payoneer Ways of Working 

Act as our customer’s partner on the inside
Learning what they need and creating what will help them go further. 

Do it. Own it.
Being fearlessly accountable in everything we do. 

Continuously improve
Always striving for a higher standard than our last. 

Build each other up 
Helping each other grow, as professionals and people. 

If this sounds like a business, a community, and a mission you want to be part of, apply today.

We are committed to providing a diverse and inclusive workplace. Payoneer is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment no matter your race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any stage of the hiring process, please speak to the recruiter managing the role for any adjustments. Decisions about requests for reasonable accommodation are made on a case-by-case basis.

Come live the Lightspeed experience...

title: Strategic Accounts Product Representative
descriptionHtml:
Diabolocom is the leading European sovereign cloud contact center (CCaaS) and customer experience management (CX) platform. It helps organizations transform customer experience by augmenting agents' capabilities through AI-human collaboration, automating routine customer interactions, and delivering personalized experiences at scale. Built on proprietary AI, private cloud, and native telecom infrastructure, the platform automates workflows, improves data quality, and empowers customer service and sales teams across every channel.

Backed by more than two decades of experience and twice recognized by Frost & Sullivan for AI technology innovation and customer experience technology leadership, Diabolocom is trusted by more than 400 organizations—including BPCE, Carrefour, Nikon, and Mitsubishi—to power mission-critical customer operations in over 60 countries, helping organizations strengthen customer loyalty and accelerate growth.



About the role

We are looking for a Strategic Accounts Product Representative to strengthen the relationship between our Product organisation and our largest enterprise customers, as well as support major commercial opportunities across our products.

In this role, you will act as the primary Product interface for selected strategic accounts, helping customers understand our Product capabilities, direction and commitments while ensuring their needs are clearly understood and effectively translated into actionable Product insights.

You will work closely with Account Managers, Sales, Product Owners, Engineering and Delivery teams to connect customer expectations with our Product strategy, identify opportunities shared across multiple customers, and provide clear visibility on Product scope, dependencies and roadmap maturity.

This is a highly transversal, customer-facing role at the intersection of Product, business and technology. You will engage with stakeholders ranging from operational teams to senior executives, build a deep understanding of their business challenges, and help our Product organisation make better-informed decisions.

Your main responsibilities will include:

  • Building trusted Product relationships with strategic customers: Act as their main Product point of contact, in close coordination with Account and Project managers, clearly communicate product capabilities, strategic direction, constraints and trade-offs to stakeholders at every level.

  • Turning customer needs into Product insights: Qualify requests based on customer impact, business value, urgency, recurrence and strategic relevance. Identify common challenges across accounts and work with Product Owners and the Head of Product to surface broader Product opportunities.

  • Ensuring clear and reliable Product commitments: Maintain a consolidated view of Product commitments for strategic accounts, including scope, ownership, dependencies, status and confidence level. Ensure that customer-facing communications reflect internally validated product and delivery plans.

  • Bridging customers and internal teams: Coordinate Product Owners and relevant internal stakeholders to answer complex customer questions, clarify functional scope and address cross-product dependencies. Ensure changes to scope, timing or assumptions are communicated proactively.

  • Leading customer discovery and understanding business needs: Participate in or lead Product discovery workshops with strategic customers to understand their workflows, business challenges and expected outcomes. Challenge solution-driven requests where necessary to identify the underlying business problem.

  • Contributing to major commercial opportunities: Coordinate the Product contribution to strategic tenders, RFPs and major sales opportunities, ensuring that Product information, capabilities, limitations and proposed commitments are accurate and aligned internally.

  • Sharing customer and market intelligence: Develop an understanding of customers' industries, business models and relevant regulatory constraints. Bring these insights back to Product and help Sales, Customer Operations and other teams communicate Product decisions consistently.

    • What we're looking for

    We are looking for someone who combines strong customer-facing skills with a solid understanding of Product and technology. You can navigate complex enterprise environments, understand business challenges, communicate with technical and non-technical stakeholders, and bring structure to discussions involving multiple teams and competing priorities.

    Your experience and skills:

  • Significant experience in a customer-facing B2B technology environment, ideally within a SaaS company, enterprise software vendor or fast-growing technology business.

  • Experience working at the intersection of Product, customers and business, for example in Product Management, Enterprise Product Management, Solutions Consulting, Technical Account Management or a similar role.

  • The ability to understand complex customer environments, engage with senior stakeholders and build trusted relationships across operational, technical and executive levels.

  • A strong understanding of Product development processes, including discovery, requirements qualification, roadmap management, prioritisation and delivery dependencies.

  • The ability to translate customer requests and use cases into structured business needs, identify recurring patterns and distinguish customer-specific requirements from scalable Product opportunities.

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain technical capabilities, Product direction and trade-offs clearly to different audiences.

  • Strong organisational skills and a structured approach to managing multiple strategic accounts, requests, stakeholders and commitments simultaneously.

  • The ability to influence and coordinate cross-functional teams without direct hierarchical authority.

  • A pragmatic, analytical and customer-oriented mindset, combined with the confidence to manage expectations and communicate when a requested feature, scope or timeline cannot be guaranteed.

  • Excellent written and spoken French and English.

    • Experience with Contact Center solutions, customer experience technology, conversational AI, CRM integrations or enterprise telecommunications would be a strong advantage.

    What you'll enjoy at Diabolocom

  • Strategic impact: Help shape the Product experience for our largest customers.

  • Product and customer exposure: Work closely with enterprise clients across our Engage and AI portfolio.

  • Cross-functional collaboration: Partner with Product, Sales, Engineering and Customer Operations.

  • International growth: Contribute to the development of an ambitious European technology company.

  • International environment: Collaborate with colleagues and customers across markets.

  • Hybrid working: Enjoy a central Paris office and flexible working arrangements.


    • Recruitment process

    Our recruitment process is designed to help us understand your experience, approach to customer challenges and ability to work across Product and business teams.

    1. Initial call with a Talent Acquisition Manager to discuss your background, motivations and expectations.

    2. Visio with a Product Owner

    3. Visio with a Project manager and a Sales Executive

    4. On-site final interview with the Product team, a Project Manager, a Sales Executive, divided into three parts:

      1. An "In-situation Case Study"

      2. A discussion that will question your choices for the case study

      3. A short discussion with Svetlana, our Head of Delivery Operations

All qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment without regard to color, language, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national or social origin, opinion disability, age. About The Role

Taktile empowers financial institutions to transform into truly AI-native organizations. We’re growing rapidly with enterprise customers across banks and insurance companies, and we’re looking for a Strategic GTM Lead for Insurance in DACH: someone who has led client engagements at a top-tier strategy consultancy and now wants to build a market rather than advise on one. You will decide which insurers we go after and why, develop those relationships from first contact to signed partnership, and be the person senior insurance executives trust to think through how AI changes underwriting, claims and operations in their business.

This is not a classic sales role. You will open new strategic insurance accounts and grow them into long-term partnerships, from the first executive conversation to large, account-level commitments. Our Account Executives close individual deals and use cases; you set the direction for the account as a whole. Most of your impact comes from account strategy, executive dialogue, ecosystem work with consultancies and partners, and shaping how Taktile shows up in the German-speaking insurance market. You will work closely with our Head of Insurance, Account Executives, Solution Engineering, Product and Engineering.

What You'll Do

  • Identify and prioritize target accounts across DACH insurers (primary insurers, reinsurers, MGAs, insurance groups) based on a clear thesis: where the business case for AI-driven decisioning is strongest and where we can win

  • Build account strategies for your portfolio: map the organization, its strategic agenda and transformation programs, the buying committee and the path to an executive sponsor, and spot expansion opportunities from day one

  • Grow and retain accounts once they are live: steer the overall relationship, open new business lines and country organizations, and make sure clients see lasting value

  • Lead relationships at every level, from claims and underwriting heads to CIOs, COOs and board members, and move them from first conversation to a defined business case and a strategic commitment to Taktile

  • Design and moderate executive workshops and steering meetings with insurance leadership teams, turning open-ended ambitions ("we need to become AI-native") into concrete, prioritized use cases

  • Shape and land account-level commitments (business case, commercial framework, executive sign-off), working hand in hand with the Account Executives who close individual deals, Solution Engineering and our Head of Insurance

  • Build and work our ecosystem in DACH: strategy and technology consultancies, system integrators and core system vendors who shape insurers' technology decisions

  • Bring market insight back into Taktile: what insurers need, how competitors and incumbents position, and what that means for our product, messaging and pricing

  • Help build the playbook for Taktile's insurance business in DACH as we scale the team

About You

  • 6+ years of total work experience, including 4–6 years at McKinsey, BCG, Bain or a comparable strategy or operations consultancy, ideally leading client teams as Engagement Manager, Project Leader or equivalent

  • Project experience with insurance clients; you don't need to be an insurance specialist, and adjacent work in operations, technical advisory or digital/AI transformation counts

  • A commercial track record: ideally you have sold or expanded projects as an Engagement Manager. Software sales experience is not required

  • Outgoing and client-facing: you enjoy being in front of clients and leading the conversation, rather than working in the background

  • Strong problem-structuring and business case skills; you can quantify the value of a use case and explain it to a CFO

  • Technical understanding: you can discuss how our platform works with engineers and translate it for business leaders

  • You take ownership of outcomes, not just recommendations, and you are motivated by building revenue and long-term client relationships. High ownership, but a team player, not a lone wolf

  • Fluent in German and English, written and spoken

  • Based in Munich or Berlin (Frankfurt or London possible) and happy to travel frequently across Germany, Austria and Switzerland. This is not a remote role: you will regularly work on-site with clients, for example in workshops

Ideal Qualifications (but not required)

  • Existing network among senior decision-makers at DACH insurers, insurance consultancies or core system vendors

  • Experience in an enterprise software, insurtech or AI company, for example in a commercial, strategy or business development role

  • Hands-on familiarity with how insurers run claims, underwriting or pricing, and with the regulatory context (BaFin, Solvency II, EU AI Act)

  • Experience speaking at industry events or publishing on insurance and AI topics

What We Offer

  • Work with colleagues that lift you up, challenge you, celebrate you and help you grow. We come from many different backgrounds, but what we have in common is the desire to operate at the very top of our fields. If you are similarly capable, caring, and driven, you'll find yourself at home here.

  • Learn from experienced mentors and achieve tremendous personal and professional growth. Get to know and leverage our network of leading tech investors and advisors around the globe.

  • Receive a top-of-market equity and cash compensation package, with a predominantly fixed salary and a performance-based bonus.

Our Stance

  • We seek to actively recognize and combat racism, sexism, ableism and ageism. We embrace and support all gender identities and expressions, and celebrate love in its many forms. We won't inquire about how you identify or if you've experienced discrimination, but if you want to tell your story, we are all ears.

About Us

Taktile enables financial institutions to transform into AI-native organizations that are increasingly powered by autonomous agents. With our modular Agentic Decision Platform, customers combine AI agents, rules, relevant context, and human oversight to safely automate and optimize their decisions—approving more customers, reimbursing claims instantly, stopping fraud before it spreads, and financing every business worth funding. Founded in 2020, Taktile powers millions of decisions daily for institutions including Mercury, Monzo, Faire, and Pleo. With offices in New York, Berlin, London, São Paulo, and Iași, the company has raised $184M from Growth Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives, Index Ventures, Tiger Global, Balderton Capital, and Y Combinator. title: Support Operations Analyst
descriptionHtml:
Job title: Support Operations Analyst

Reporting to: Support Lead

Location: Remote (UK based)

Are you curious, analytical, and eager to grow in the world of SaaS and AI?

Aveni is an award-winning technology company. We use advanced AI to enable scalable efficiency for financial services companies, combining world-leading Natural Language Processing (NLP) and Large Language Model (LLM) expertise with deep financial services domain experience to drive enterprise-wide productivity. Aveni harnesses the power of voice to drive unprecedented efficiency and oversight. We’re using the latest in AI to automate and innovate, empowering businesses to achieve exceptional productivity and compliance outcomes.

We’re looking for a Support Operations Analyst to help us scale how customer support works through AI, automation, knowledge and strong operational processes. A core part of the role will be owning and improving our AI support experience: increasing the proportion of customer requests resolved through AI and self-service, continuously improving the content and workflows that power it, and using conversation data to identify new opportunities for automation. You’ll stay close to customers by providing second-line support when needed, while also improving our knowledge, incident and problem management practices.

About the Role

As a Support Operations Analyst, your primary focus will be making Support more scalable, proactive and effective. You’ll take day-to-day ownership of optimising our AI support agent, Intercom Fin, using performance data and conversation reviews to improve involvement, resolution and deflection. You’ll author and test AI content, tune workflows and routing, identify knowledge and automation gaps, and implement improvements that allow more customers to get the right answer without needing a human response. Alongside this, you’ll own key parts of our customer-facing knowledge and Support operations, help ensure we’re ready for product launches, coordinate customer-impacting incidents and recurring product issues, and provide second-line customer support where human investigation is required.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Second-line Customer Support – Provide hands-on support for customer requests that require human investigation or cannot be resolved through AI or self-service. Troubleshoot issues, communicate clearly with customers and use these conversations to identify opportunities to improve Fin, documentation or product experience.

  • Incident & Problem Management – Act as a Support point of contact during customer-impacting incidents: triage and escalate high-priority issues, coordinate with Engineering, maintain clear stakeholder and customer communications, and contribute recommendations that improve the process. For lower-impact bugs and recurring problems, work with Product and Engineering to maintain visibility and help ensure a healthy level of customer-impacting issues is picked up through sprint planning.

  • Technical Investigation – Diagnose and troubleshoot technical issues, gather the right evidence and work confidently with Product and Engineering when deeper investigation is required.

  • Product Knowledge – Develop a strong understanding of Aveni’s products to support users effectively and confidently.

  • Launch & Cross-functional Collaboration – Work with Product, Marketing, Training & Enablement and Engineering to ensure Help Centre and Intercom content is accurate, and that customer documentation and Support readiness are in place for new features and product launches.

  • AI Support Optimisation – Take day-to-day ownership of optimising our AI customer support experience. At Aveni we use Intercom Fin, but experience with Zendesk AI or similar platforms is equally relevant. Author, test and continuously improve the content and instructions that power Fin; tune workflows, routing and hand-off paths; review customer conversations to identify new deflection and automation opportunities; and implement improvements that allow more requests to be resolved before reaching the Support team. Own regular reporting on AI involvement, resolution and deflection rates, using the data to identify trends, prioritise experiments and demonstrate the impact of changes.

  • Knowledge Management – Maintain and improve Help Centre content, FAQs and internal Support guidance, ensuring AI and human agents have accurate, useful knowledge to work from. Identify documentation gaps through conversation reviews, support trends and AI performance, and work with Product, Marketing and Training & Enablement to close them.

What We’re Looking For

  • A strong interest in technology, SaaS, and AI.

  • Solid problem-solving skills with a proactive, solutions-focused mindset.

  • Clear and confident communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts in simple terms.

  • Experience in a customer-facing or technical support role, ideally within B2B SaaS, with confidence owning customer issues from first contact through to resolution or escalation.

  • Hands-on experience optimising AI customer support platforms such as Intercom Fin, Zendesk AI or similar. We’re looking for evidence that you have actively improved how an AI agent performs — for example by authoring and testing content, tuning workflows or routing, reviewing conversations for deflection opportunities, and using involvement, resolution or deflection reporting to drive measurable improvements. Direct Fin experience isn't essential; the track record matters more than the platform.

  • Experience maintaining customer-facing knowledge bases or Help Centres and turning support trends into clear, useful documentation.

  • A collaborative team player who is comfortable working both remotely and independently.

Nice to Have

  • Previous experience in a B2B SaaS or fintech environment, particularly supporting complex or regulated customers.

  • Experience designing or running experiments to improve AI agents, automation or self-service journeys in a customer support environment.

  • Experience using support and AI metrics such as SLA, CSAT, involvement, resolution and escalation trends to identify and prioritise improvements.

  • Experience with incident and problem management practices, including escalation, stakeholder communication, root cause analysis and continuous improvement.

  • Experience working with Product and Engineering during high-priority incidents and managing lower-impact bugs through a backlog or sprint-based development process.

Benefits

What We Offer

  • A collaborative and innovative work environment with career growth opportunities

  • 34 days holiday plus your birthday off (inclusive of bank holidays)

  • Share options – we believe in shared success

  • Skills development – continuous learning is at our core, expect the development to be front and centre of everything you do

  • Remote and flexible working – remote, co-working spaces, or a mix of both

  • Life insurance, income protection and private health care

  • Freebies and discounts at a range of retailers

  • Emotional wellbeing (Employee assistance programme provides access to 24/7 employee counselling and emotional support)

  • Cycle to work scheme

  • Pension scheme (employer contribution matched up to 5%)

Join Us in Making a Difference

At Aveni, we believe that diversity drives innovation. We're committed to building a team that reflects the diverse communities we serve and creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best work. If you're passionate about leveraging technology to drive positive change and want to be part of a team that's shaping the future of financial services, we'd love to hear from you. We know that some people are likely to only apply where they meet 100% of requirements, but we’d like to hear from you anyway.

Apply now to join us on our mission to transform the financial services industry through AI.

title: Teamleider Electromagnetic Warfare (m/v/x)
descriptionHtml:
Ben jij die ambitieuze Teamleider / R&D engineer die graag helpt om civiele en militaire vliegtuigen veilig, duurzaam en competitief te laten vliegen? Wil jij jezelf verder ontwikkelen en word je enthousiast van techniek, innovatie en duurzaamheid? Wij zijn op zoek naar een teamleider voor de afdeling.

Wat ga je doen?

In een wereld waarin lucht- en ruimtevaartsystemen steeds complexer worden, is het belangrijk om innovatieve oplossingen te ontwikkelen om de veiligheid en efficiëntie te garanderen. Binnen NLR werken we aan de ontwikkeling van geavanceerde aerospace systemen. We maken hierbij gebruik van software modelering en simulatie om het gedrag van complexe systemen te begrijpen en te optimaliseren.

Onze expertise in hardware testen en operationele ondersteuning (OPS) zorgt ervoor dat onze oplossingen niet alleen theoretisch solide zijn, maar ook praktisch toepasbaar en robuust.

De belangstelling voor Electromagnetic Warfare (EW) neemt toe, met de noodzaak om onze lucht- en ruimtevaartsystemen te beschermen tegen elektromagnetische bedreigingen. We zoeken hierom een teamleider binnen onze nieuwe afdeling Aerospace Systems Electronic Warfare (ASEW)

Als teamleider EW zal je leiding geven aan een team van professionals met expertise in het ontwerp, de ontwikkeling en het testen van aerospace systemen met focus op Electronic Warfare.

Binnen onze nieuwe afdeling Aerospace Systems Electromagnetic Warfare zoeken wij een ervaren en gedreven Teamleider om ons team te leiden en te inspireren. De afdeling is gericht op het ontwikkelen van innovatieve oplossingen voor Electromagnetic Warfare (EW) en heeft als doel om de Nederlandse en internationale lucht- en ruimtevaartindustrie te ondersteunen.

Als Teamleider binnen onze afdeling ASEW ben je verantwoordelijk voor het leiden en ontwikkelen van een team van specialisten op het gebied van EW. Je werkt nauw samen met de Afdelingsmanager en andere teams binnen NLR om onze doelen te bereiken.

In afstemming met de Afdelingsmanager ASEW zal je één van de twee Electromagnetic Warfare kennisgebied overzien, namelijk Electronic Warfare Modelling and Simulation of Electronic Warfare Analyses.

In de rol van teamleider blijf je actief en inhoudelijk betrokken bij het uitvoeren van projecten en krijg je de coördinatie over een team van technische collega’s en het verder ontwikkelen en uitbouwen van de faciliteiten waarvoor ASEW verantwoordelijk is. Je bent dus zowel een teamleider als een R&D Engineer.

Als teamleider …

Als teamleider bied jij het team alles wat nodig is om de werkzaamheden van jouw team succesvol te laten verlopen. Je bent de directe leidinggevende van betreffende collega’s en draagt ook de HR-verantwoordelijkheid. Je coacht, stuurt, geeft én vraagt feedback en je pakt de leiding wanneer nodig.

Je stelt hen op deze wijze in staat om optimaal aan de projecten te werken en faciliteer jij hen waar nodig. Je zorgt voor het versterken van de kennispositie van het werkgebied en de realisatie van de werkzaamheden/opdrachten voor interne en externe stakeholders.

Je hebt een open en enthousiasmerende stijl van leidinggeven. Je collega’s voelen zich vrij en gesteund en kunnen zichzelf goed ontwikkelen. Er wordt een goede teamspirit ervaren. Je zorgt voor een goede aansluiting van het werkgebied bij de rest van ASEW en voor het zoeken van synergie met andere afdelingen binnen flight test en certificatie. Je versterkt de samenwerkingsrelaties gericht op het verder volwassen laten worden van het team.

Als R&D Engineer…

Als R&D engineer EW werk je mee aan het veiliger, duurzamer en competitiever maken van de militaire en civiele luchtvaart. Je werkt aan vliegtuigen, helikopters en onbemande vliegende systemen.

Je ondersteunt onze binnen- en buitenlandse opdrachtgevers bij het bereiken van hun doelen. Je voert testen uit, genereerd modellen en analyseert resultaten.

In de rol van R&D engineer, trek of draag je inhoudelijk bij aan projectvoorstellen voor bijvoorbeeld betaalde projecten in opdracht van een (externe) stakeholder. Dit kunnen ook onderzoeksvoorstellen zijn voor bijvoorbeeld defensie onderzoeks-calls.

Verantwoordelijkheden

  • Leiden en ontwikkelen van een team van specialisten op het gebied van EW;

  • Samenwerken met de Afdelingsmanager ASEW en andere teams binnen NLR om onze doelen te bereiken;

  • Overzien van een kennisgebied (Electronic Warfare Modelling and Simulation of Electronic Warfare Analyses) waarmee je samen met de Afdelingsmanager tot strategische doelen van het team komt;

  • Inspireren en motiveren van teamleden om hun beste werk te leveren;

  • Coördineren van projecten en activiteiten om de doelen van de afdeling te bereiken.

Wat breng je mee?

  • Een afgeronde WO master in een relevante discipline (bijv. lucht- en ruimtevaarttechniek, elektrotechniek, informatica);

  • Tenminste 3 jaar ervaring in een leidinggevende functie, bij voorkeur in de lucht- en ruimtevaartindustrie;

  • Aantoonbare kennis en ervaring op het gebied van EW;

  • Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden in zowel het Nederlands als het Engels (tenminste op C1 niveau);

  • Sterke leiderschaps- en coachingsvaardigheden;

  • In staat om een team te inspireren en te motiveren om hun beste werk te leveren.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Werken bij NLR, betekent werken in een nationale en internationale hightech omgeving. Samenwerken en betrokkenheid staan bij ons hoog in vaandel. Door jou vrijheid en eigen verantwoordelijkheid te geven, ben jij het best in staat om tot baanbrekende innovaties te komen. Wil jij jezelf vakinhoudelijk én op persoonlijk vlak ontwikkelen? Ook dat kan bij NLR als lerende organisatie, met daarnaast een opleidingsbudget, een mentor, interne coaches en goede contacten met mbo’s, hbo’s en universiteiten.

Naast dit alles bieden wij jou:

  • De kans om bij te dragen aan complexe en maatschappelijk relevante vraagstukken;

  • Voldoende vakantie- en ATV-dagen (in totaal 45 bij fulltime dienstverband) voor een goede werk-privébalans;

  • Een eindejaarsuitkering van 8%;

  • Een tegemoetkoming in jouw zorgkosten;

  • Extra betaald ouderschapsverlof;

  • De mogelijkheid om jezelf te ontwikkelen met opleidingen en cursussen die passen bij jouw ambities.

Jouw nieuwe werkomgeving

Electromagnetic Warfare is een nieuwe afdeling binnen Aerospace systems en is voort gekomen uit de afdeling Defence Operations. Je zult de leidinggevende zijn van een team enthousiaste en gedreven professionals. Hierbij zul je nauw samenwerken met andere NLR afdelingen, in het bijzonder de afdeling waaruit ASEW voortgekomen is. De werkzaamheden zijn direct gerelateerd aan Defensie, weerbaarheid en de verdediging van Nederland en de Nederlandse krijgsmacht.

Je werkt vanuit onze locatie in Amsterdam en zult veel contact met collega's en partners binnen en buiten NLR.

Wat betekent werken bij NLR?

Koninklijke NLR is al ruim 100 jaar een kennisorganisatie met de wil en ambitie om te vernieuwen. Vanuit die drijfveer maken wij de wereld van lucht- en ruimtevaart veiliger, duurzamer, efficiënter en effectiever en staan wij voor baanbrekende innovaties.

Bij ons werken meer dan 1000 gedreven professionals, van vliegtuigbouwkundigen tot psychologen en van wiskundigen tot applicatiedeskundigen. NLR staat voor een inclusieve en diverse organisatie waar iedereen zich welkom, veilig, gewaardeerd en gerespecteerd voelt.

Wil jij meer weten?


Bel of mail dan met Frank Bax (recruiter) via 0615676915 of .

Onze collega’s vertellen jou graag hoe het is om bij NLR te werken. Vergeet trouwens ook niet eens een kijkje op onze socials te nemen zoals ons YouTube kanaal.

Solliciteren?

Mooi, we zijn benieuwd naar jou! Stuur je motivatiebrief en CV via de ‘Solliciteren’ button.

De teamleider is een parttime functie.

Een assessment maakt deel uit van de procedure.

Een positieve uitkomst van een veiligheidsonderzoek (VGB) is een voorwaarde voor indiensttreding. Meer informatie daarover lees je op de website van de MIVD.

Acquisitie wordt niet op prijs gesteld!

descriptionHtml:
Our Mission
Human time and effort is the rarest thing in the universe. The fact that so many people hate what they do for work is a disaster on so many levels. How many people live quiet lives of misery? How many generational talents do we miss due to circumstance?

Dex’s mission is to close the gap between Talent & Opportunity, we believe that work, and being productive, is part of the human condition, that regardless of AI, human passion, ingenuity and a desire to do things means that work will always exist.

We are building Dex to create a future where technology helps every individual to understand their strengths, interests and unique abilities, and to connect with opportunities where they can thrive, because more people doing things they love leads to a better, happier and more productive world.

We are starting by connecting the world's most ambitious software engineers with the companies that deserve them.

Why this role is different

The AI startups and scaleups we work with have roles they can’t fill. Not because they haven’t tried, but because they have world-class hiring bars, and it’s genuinely tough.

As a Talent Partner, you own those client relationships end to end. You take a role brief properly, you push back when it doesn’t add up, and you become the person a founder, internal talent partner or hiring manager calls before they’ve even decided to hire. You also own delivery, making sure every client has an amazing experience using Dex, from brief through to signed offer.

We’re an AI-first company, and our talent team is pushing the boundaries of what AI can do in recruitment. You won’t just be using AI tools, you’ll be part of the team working out what great hiring looks like when AI is built into every step.

You’ll also shape the product. You’ll work directly with our product and engineering teams, who are building tools specifically for you. When something isn’t working, whether it’s a match that shouldn’t have reached you or a workflow that slows you down, you raise it with the people who can fix it, and you see it change. Talent Partners are brought in early on anything that touches their workflow, so you help decide what gets built, not just use it.

What you’ll do

  • Own a portfolio of client relationships end to end: brief, delivery, feedback, and everything after

  • Take role briefs and kick-offs that actually hold up. Scope the role, interrogate the requirements, and tell a client when the role is really two roles, or shouldn’t be hired at all

  • Run the process on the client side: keep feedback fast, keep interviews moving, and keep momentum from breaking

  • Use funnel data to diagnose stalling roles and walk clients through where they’re losing people and why

  • Negotiate and close offers so that neither side feels managed

  • Grow accounts from one search into the whole hiring plan

You’ll probably have

  • 2+ years in tech or engineering recruitment, either in-house at a startup or scaleup or at a specialist tech agency

  • Hired for roles like backend, infra, ML/AI engineers, researchers or founding engineers, and the ability to hold a credible conversation with a CTO about what a role really needs

  • Strong command of funnel metrics: you know what good conversion looks like at each stage and what to do when it isn’t happening

  • Commercial sharpness and the confidence to push back on senior people early, rather than having the expensive conversation late

  • Curiosity about AI tooling. You’ll be a daily power user of a product that’s being built around you

Why join now

You’ll be building relationships with some of the best AI startups and scaleups on the planet, helping them hire the roles they care most about. You’ll have experienced talent leaders around you day to day, and a product team building tools for you specifically. This is a team that deeply understands how difficult and how important hiring is.

We’re open on backgrounds. If you have the raw ingredients and have excelled where you are now, we want to hear from you, even if you don’t tick every box.

What we offer

  • Above market base salary plus uncapped commission; we're building a world class team and believe pay should match that ambition

  • Significant equity - we want this to be the last job you 'have' to take

  • Full private healthcare & dental - because life happens and we want to support you

  • Fertility benefits & enhanced parental support

  • Gym membership & wellness benefits

  • Claude tokens - lots and lots of Claude tokens

  • Regular socials, offsites and an annual trip

  • MacBook Pro + team kit

  • "Whatever you need" approach to tools and support

The process

Our hiring process is designed to be transparent and respectful of your time. Here's what you can expect:

  • Talent Screen: Becca (Head of Talent) 30m

  • Hiring Manager Interview: Richard, who heads up Talent Operations at Dex (30-45m)

  • Short Take Home Exercise

  • Task Review (60m)

  • In person interview

    • Culture Fit & Values (45m)

    • Final Interview with Paddy, CEO and Founder at Dex (30m)

title: Technical Program Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Us

QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. We do this with our unique VIO™ technology, the only QPU architecture that breaks the hardware barriers that have held quantum computing back, unlocking the path to MegaQubit quantum processors.

With VIO, we are paving the way for the hyper-scale quantum computers that will change the world. And delivering on that vision demands people who don’t shy away from tackling the hardest challenges of our time. That’s where you come in!

Join us as a Technical Program Manager in our new Project Management Office (PMO), reporting to the PMO Lead. You will own day-to-day program management for one to two development programs, keeping schedules, responsibilities and risks visible across development and production departments. Working in a highly technical, fast-moving environment, you will build the habits and practice of program discipline that the whole company will adopt as the PMO scales.

What you'll be doing

  • Ownership and responsibility

    • Own top level execution and delivery of assigned programs.

    • Partner with project and discipline leads on cross-department programs to ensure execution on schedule and within budget.

    • Manage the day-to-day execution of the assigned programs including handoffs across departments.

    • Lead the program-management activities for your assigned programs: schedule build, baselining, gate reviews, etc.

  • Manage uncertainty and risk

    • Identify risks and bottlenecks early

    • Plan for potential failure modes and contingencies

    • Escalate risks and blockers to the relevant stakeholders promptly.

  • Support growth and development of the team

    • Mentor junior program managers in program execution and collaborative leadership.

    • Support the PMO Lead in rolling out common language, product lifecycle, team rhythms for programs.

    • Support general program management training across the organization.

Your Profile

  • Leadership experience

    • Over 6 years of experience, including more than 4 years managing the delivery of complex, research-intensive chip hardware projects in a program management role.

    • Lead programs coordinating across functions and departments.

    • Proven ability to work with highly specialised technical experts.

    • Experience working in a fast-moving start-up or scale-up environment balancing hands-on technical leadership with growing a team, as a strong plus.

  • Approach

    • Learn quickly in a highly technical, low-maturity field, without needing a deep technical background in quantum computing on day one.

    • Translate a long-term strategy into an execution plan for your program teams.

    • Strong analytical skills with the ability to make pragmatic, informed decisions under uncertainty.

    • Bring together world-class technical experts and project leads to execute on highly complex programs.

  • Technical Background

    • MSc, PhD, or equivalent experience in physics, electrical engineering, microwave/RF engineering, semiconductor technology, or a related field.

    • Understanding of the development lifecycle for chip-level technologies; experience with superconducting qubits or cryogenic systems is a strong plus.

  • Communication

    • Excellent communicator who can motivate teams, facilitate alignment, adept at communicating program management ideas to highly technical people.

    • Collaborate with stakeholders and colleagues across the organization - Product, Research and Development, Operations, Management team, etc.

    • Communicate fluently in English.

Don't tick every box? Apply anyway! Research shows women often self-select out if they don't meet every requirement. Here's our take: nobody ticks every box. This is a description of our ideal candidate, not a filter. If most resonates and you're keen to learn the gaps, apply. We hire for trajectory, not perfection.

What We Offer:

At QuantWare, you’ll be part of a high-performing team of world-class experts in an ambitious, fast-moving environment. From day one, you’ll have the trust, tools, and support to do your best work. Here’s what you can expect:

Competitive salary - A salary that reflects the impact and importance of the role (and of course 8% holiday allowance)

Pension that’s built to last - A generous and future-proof pension plan that includes partner and dependent coverage.

Flexibility built on trust - We focus on outcomes. Work flexibly, in a hybrid setup, with an open vacation policy that lets you manage your time

Personal growth - We invest in your L&D, with a budget available to each team member, dependent on their individual ambitions, development needs, and performance

A connected team - We make space to celebrate wins together, with team events, offsites, and spontaneous moments that bring us closer

Diversity & Inclusion at QuantWare

We’re an ambitious company, not only for our goals but also to become an even more diverse and inclusive team. We know great candidates don't always follow a straight path, and we value diverse experience, perspectives, and ways of thinking. We know this helps us make better decisions, drives more innovation, and strengthens our culture.

As part of our recruitment process, candidates may be required to undergo pre-employment screening.

title: Test Engineer (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
About us

thinkcell provides graphics software that performs most of the painstaking work of creating data-driven slides for professional Excel and PowerPoint users. The testing department makes sure that new features are technically sound and work reliably for all user groups, from new users to seasoned financial professionals. 

What you will do 

As a Test Engineer at thinkcell, you'll help improve a product that over 1,000,000 professionals around the world rely on every day.

Testing and verifying new features is an important part of the job, as our product continues to evolve. Since thinkcell is seamlessly integrated into Microsoft PowerPoint and Excel, we must pay close attention to its compatibility with supported Microsoft Office versions, operating systems, and their respective updates.

There is a certain level of complexity to our product and consequently to the testing process. Problem-solving skills are important as well as keeping an overview between verifying fixes, creating test cases, and ensuring our users receive only top quality. 

 Key Responsibilities 

  • Feature Testing: Ensure new thinkcell features work properly and verify their logical consistency and usability. 
  • Release Testing: Conduct final quality checks before each think-cell version release. 
  • Error Reproduction and Reporting: Create detailed error reproductions and document them clearly. Provide precise information to help resolve issues and record all error-related details in the internal system. 
  • Verification: Verify that developer fixes successfully resolve reported issues. 
  • Knowledge Base Management: Maintain and expand the internal Knowledge Base with documentation of new product functionality. 

 
 You will be great for this position if you have 

  • High level of self-motivation and independent work structuring. 
  • Curiosity and critical thinking. 
  • Willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies. 
  • Fluency in written and spoken English. 
  • (Plus) Experience with Microsoft Office, particularly PowerPoint and Excel. 

 
 Our Values 

As part of our team, you will embody and help shape the following principles that define us: 

  • Forward Thinking: We embrace change and challenge the status quo. 
  • Ownership: We take pride in our work and learn from our mistakes. 
  • Customer First: We prioritize delivering lasting value. 
  • Unified Team: We foster collaboration, respect, and integrity. 
  • Strive for Excellence: We set ambitious goals and pursue quality. 

 
 Why is thinkcell the right place for you? 

We empower over 1.3 million users across 35,000 companies, including top consulting firms and major global enterprises. With offices in Berlin, Munich, Denver, Boston, London, Tokyo, and Dubai, we’re a diverse team of over 220 people, committed to innovation and excellence. 

thinkcell is more than a job – it's a chance to be part of an innovative, inclusive team that values collaboration and growth. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds to apply. Together, we can shape the future of productivity software. 

We can’t wait to see what you’ll bring to the team!

descriptionHtml:
Afgestudeerd? What’s next? Stap in bij het HSO Young Professional Program! Kickstart je IT-carrière ! Klaar voor de reis? Join the journey to explore!

Start jouw carrière als Functioneel Consultant bij HSO en geef je toekomst een vliegende start op 1 maart 2027. In ons Young Professional Program ontwikkel je jezelf razendsnel tot een specialist in Microsoft Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement (CE), met AI als jouw versnellingsmotor. 

Jouw start bij HSO 
Je begint met een vijfweekse Masterclass waarin je alles leert over Dynamics 365 CE, Microsoft-technologie en de nieuwste ontwikkelingen op het gebied van AI en automatisering. Je traint op zowel technische vaardigheden als soft skills, zoals klantgericht adviseren, samenwerken en communiceren. Na afronding behaal je je officiële Microsoft-certificering. 

Snel aan de slag bij topklanten 
Na de Masterclass ga je direct aan de slag binnen een ervaren projectteam. Je werkt mee aan digitale transformaties bij klanten als Rituals, Royal BAM en Heineken. Als Functioneel Consultant analyseer je bedrijfsprocessen, vertaal je klantbehoeften naar slimme oplossingen, implementeer je Dynamics 365 CE en begeleid je klanten bij adoptie en optimalisatie van AI-tools zoals Copilot. Jij bent de verbindende schakel tussen business en technologie. 

Groei in je eigen tempo 
Je staat er nooit alleen voor. Je krijgt begeleiding van een senior consultant, ondersteuning van je manager en een leertraject via de HSO Academy. Je groeit van Trainee naar Junior Consultant en kunt daarna doorgroeien naar Medior of zelfs Lead Consultant – afhankelijk van jouw ambitie, bijvoorbeeld richting AI-integratie, procesoptimalisatie of klantstrategie. 

Wat breng jij mee?

  • Goede beheersing van zowel Nederlands als Engels;

Wat krijg je van ons?

  • Hybride werken: thuis, op kantoor of zelfs tijdens een workation;

  • Pensioenregeling bij BeFrank;

Waarom HSO? 
Bij HSO werk je in een internationale en innovatieve omgeving waar initiatief wordt gewaardeerd. Je leert verschillende sectoren kennen, werkt met collega’s van diverse nationaliteiten en bouwt aan échte impact. title: UI/UX Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Join SE3 Labs as a UI/UX Software Engineer

Design and build intuitive, high-performance interfaces for autonomous systems, turning complex operational capabilities into software that people can use confidently in the real world.

About SE3

SE3 Labs builds spatial intelligence and autonomy software for unmanned systems. We combine 3D computer vision, state estimation and AI to help autonomous platforms perceive their surroundings, know where they are and operate when GPS and other sensors become unreliable. Defence is a core application of our work today.

We are growing to a team of 100+ people. Join at a stage where you can shape our future, help us build the team and grow your responsibilities as the company expands.

Our founding team’s research has received more than 90,000 citations. You will work closely with technical founders and engineers with deep experience in computer vision and autonomous systems, turning that research depth into systems that work in the field

About the Role

As a UI/UX Software Engineer at SE3 Labs, you’ll take ownership of how our software looks, feels and performs. Your core challenge is to build one coherent interface system that works across many contexts: different devices, screen sizes, plugins and product features, from large command displays to small field devices with limited computing power. You’ll combine UX/UI design with hands-on front-end development, working closely with our software team. From integrating 3D visualisations to building interfaces for military personnel in the field, you’ll help shape a product from the ground up and see the direct impact of your work.

What You’ll Work On

  • Coherent UI System & Front-End Architecture: Design and build a modular, well-structured front-end and a consistent design language that spans our whole product range. Make it easy to add new plugins and features, and to run on different systems and devices, without losing consistency or maintainability.

  • UX/UI Design & Implementation: Work with the team to understand user needs, design and wireframe interfaces, and turn them into working software. Own both the user experience and the code that brings it to life.

  • Multi-Device & Performance: Build interfaces that adapt across small screens, tablets and large displays, and stay responsive on resource-constrained hardware. Identify bottlenecks, optimise rendering and deliver a smooth experience without relying on high-end devices.

  • 3D Visualisation Integration: Integrate 3D visualisations into the user interface so that they work smoothly alongside other features, including on devices with limited computing resources.

  • Plugin & Feature Interfaces: Build reusable UI components for different plugins and product features, so that third parties and internal teams can extend the platform in a consistent way.

  • Usability for Operational Environments: Help design interfaces for military personnel working in demanding conditions. Consider intuitive workflows, clear information hierarchy and established conventions such as NATO symbology. Learn from real user feedback and improve continuously.

  • Collaboration & Product Evolution: Work closely with the software team to understand customer needs and translate them into design and engineering decisions. Help shape how the interface evolves as the product grows, and look for ways to simplify workflows and make new capabilities easier to understand.

Your Profile

  • You enjoy building a coherent system rather than a single screen: one design language and one component structure that works across many plugins, systems and devices.

  • You bring hands-on experience designing and implementing user interfaces for software products, with a focus on intuitive, usable experiences across different devices and screen sizes.

  • You have built structured, responsive and maintainable front-end applications, not just static designs or isolated prototypes, and you know how to organise code into reusable components and modular structures.

  • You can move between UX/UI design and software development, turning wireframes and requirements into working interfaces and making informed decisions about both usability and implementation.

  • You care about performance as well as appearance, and you work methodically to improve the experience across different hardware.

  • You work well with engineers and other stakeholders, explore different approaches and turn ideas into practical solutions.

  • You take initiative, enjoy open-ended problems and want to help build and shape a product rather than maintain an established interface.

  • You’re interested in software for real-world use, where clarity, reliability and ease of use matter as much as visual design.

  • You’re happy to work on-site with the team in Munich.

Especially Valued Bonus Skills

  • 3D Visualisation: Experience integrating interactive 3D visualisations into software interfaces, particularly using Unreal Engine or similar technologies.

  • Performance on Constrained Hardware: Experience optimising front-end applications for low-compute devices, limited resources or demanding real-time requirements.

  • Complex Operational Interfaces: Experience designing interfaces for complex systems where users need to interpret spatial information, symbols or multiple sources of information quickly.

  • Gaming or Real-Time Visualisation: Experience in 3D gaming, motorsport, simulation or other fields where responsive interfaces and real-time visual feedback are important.

  • Building from Scratch: Experience establishing a front-end architecture, reusable component system or coherent design language for a new product or platform.

Perks & Benefits

  • Real Ownership: Participate in SE3’s growth through our employee participation programme

  • Work Environment to Excel at: Find a high-quality and modern toolset, flat hierarchy and a skilled, driven team which will push the limits together with you

  • AI-boosted workplace: We empower every employee with best-in-class AI tools and agents, giving you unlimited access to the latest advancements and a true productivity edge

  • 31 Paid Days Off: 30 vacation days plus your birthday off

  • Well-being Access: Free membership to gyms, yoga, and wellness through EGYM Wellpass

  • Team Offsites: We go on 2 company retreats per year, our last ones were in Italy and Greece

  • Mentorship: Work closely with experienced engineers and get paired with a professional mentor to support your growth

Our Process

  1. Intro Call (30 minutes): An initial conversation to discuss your experience, motivation and interest in SE3 Labs, alongside an introduction to the role and our working environment.

  2. Hiring Manager Interview (45 minutes): Discuss your experience, approach to software development and UX/UI design, and how you would contribute to the team.

  3. Technical Deep Dive (90 minutes): Explore your technical capabilities in more detail, including front-end architecture, interface design and implementation, responsive development and problem-solving.

  4. Team Lunch or Dinner: Meet members of the team, get a feel for how we work together and learn more about life at SE3 Labs.

title: UX Product Designer
descriptionHtml:
We are hiring a UX Designer who loves turning real user problems into clear, safe and well-tested designs, and who wants to shape how healthcare professionals work with AI every day.

Our Mission
Attendi has already built a strong user base through speech-to-text integrations with electronic health record (EHR) vendors, used by over 300 care organisations in elderly and disability care. With the Attendi App (web and mobile), we are building a one-stop solution for AI-driven administration in healthcare: structured documentation, conversation summaries, voice-driven workflows and AI assistance, anytime, anywhere.

Design is central to this vision. Our users are care professionals working with clients, not behind a desk. Every flow we build needs to be simple, fast and safe to use. And because the Attendi App is being certified as a medical device (MDR), we don’t just design what feels intuitive, we prove that users understand and use it as intended.

This isn’t about making it as easy as possible to order a pizza. It’s about how a care professional can receive AI-generated advice safely, and make sure they check what matters before they rely on it.

Your Role
As a UX Designer at Attendi, you will:

  • Translate user research into user flows, wireframes and high-fidelity designs for the Attendi App.

  • Work closely with our UX researcher, who uncovers user needs in the field, and turn those insights into the right solution.

  • Visit care organisations to test your designs with healthcare professionals: does this solution fit the problem we observed?

  • Design for safety in an AI product: identify where users could misuse or over-trust AI output, and design features that mitigate that risk.

  • Run usability studies as part of our MDR certification, through simulations, observation or A/B tests, and document what you tested and learned.

  • Work in two lanes: fast shipping of new features, and careful, well-documented work on our medical device track.

  • Work closely with the product owner, developers and our compliance team to get designs into production.

  • Help mature our design system in Figma.


You might be a good fit if you hit most or all of the following:

  • 2-4 years of experience as a UX or product designer in a product team, working in sprints.

  • Experience with B2B SaaS products.

  • You start with questions, not solutions: who is the user, what is their context, what problem are we really solving?

  • You balance a startup pace with taking a step back to research and test before going to production.

  • Strong Figma skills.

  • Native Dutch speaker. You’ll talk with healthcare professionals a lot, in their own language.

  • A portfolio that shows your thinking: the user, the problem, how you approached it and how you measured whether it worked.

Strong candidates may also

  • Have worked on AI products.

  • Have experience in healthcare, or another regulated environment such as legaltech, regtech or govtech.

  • Have worked on a CE-certified or medical device product, and know what that means for usability testing.

  • Have experience running usability studies or user interviews.

  • Enjoy working with a team for the long run and growing together with a scale-up.

What we offer

  • Salary between €4,000 and €4,500 per month, plus holiday allowance.

  • Ideally 40 hours per week.

  • Travel and lunch allowance.

  • Home office budget.

  • Lease bike.

  • Training budget of €1,500 per year.

  • Company MacBook.

  • ClassPass membership.

  • Pension contribution of 10% and roughly 7% paid by Attendi.

Our culture: People-oriented, curious, and proactive
At Attendi, you’ll work in a small, ambitious team that learns and builds together. We are empathetic, take initiative, dare to experiment, and stand by our work. Making mistakes is okay as long as you learn from them.

Application Process

  • Please include your portfolio with your application

  • Intro call with Roundr, our recruitment partner

  • Interview with a colleague from our design team

  • Case study: a short take-home assignment you present at our office

  • Offer and onboarding

Pairs is a global network of family offices, institutional investors, VCs and angels. We screen deal flow very tightly, and the opportunities that clear our diligence go out to the network. We invest alongside them too.

THE ROLE
This role works across both sides of Pairs. You bring in companies worth our diligence, and you grow the network of investors who back them directly.

This role is for people who bring in deals on their own. You already have an active network of founders who are raising, and investors who write direct cheques. Here you open new relationships on both sides every month, using the same approach that built your existing ones.

Our platform handles the pipeline, research and follow-up. Your time goes to founder and investor conversations, and to judging which opportunities deserve the network's attention.

Procurement touches every pound a business spends, yet requests still stall for weeks and approvals get lost in inboxes. Our AI-first platform changes that: our agents capture requests, route approvals, onboard suppliers, flag risk and track every renewal, while anyone in the business can ask a question and get an answer grounded in their own company’s data. Talent density matters more to us than almost anything else. We keep the bar high in every team, so everyone here has real ownership and real impact. Our team is full of former founders and operators who’ve scaled unicorns, and we’re looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers alongside them.

Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here.

About the role

We're looking for a Visual Designer to own how Omnea shows up in the physical world and across marketing campaigns. You'll lead design for events, print and traditional media, and presentations, and support Marketing with graphic design for campaigns, content and paid ads.

Omnea now runs roughly one event every three days, across London, New York and beyond. You'll bring it in-house, raise the quality bar and build the foundations (templates, asset libraries, print specs) so every event doesn't start from scratch.

You'll work alongside our Founding Visual Designer, who owns digital (website, animations, product assets), building on a brand direction that's already set. Together you'll keep the brand consistent everywhere, from a product launch page to a booth at an industry summit, and help it evolve as we grow, pushing it into new formats, spaces and campaigns.

This is a hands-on role with a lot of ownership. You'll take briefs from Marketing and Events, shape them, push back where needed, and see them through to production.

What you'll do

Events

  • Design event assets end to end: booths, roll-ups, signage, badges, invites, menus, stage visuals and merchandise.

  • Partner with the Events team on our own events (like our Annual Summit in New York), industry conferences and customer dinners.

  • Build and maintain an event asset library and templates, including a self-serve starter kit so colleagues running smaller events stay on brand without a designer.

Print and traditional media

  • Design print collateral and out-of-home or traditional media placements.

  • Prepare print-ready files and work with printers and suppliers on production, quality and deadlines.

Marketing and campaign design

  • Create graphic design for campaigns, paid ads, social and content, working closely with Marketing and Product Marketing.

  • Support product launches with campaign assets, in partnership with the digital Visual Designer.

  • Help Marketing self-serve by growing our brand asset bank and templates.

Presentations

  • Design high-impact decks for events, keynotes, webinars, sales and leadership.

  • Maintain and evolve our slide templates so teams can build on-brand decks themselves.

  • Turn rough content into clear, well-structured presentations.

Brand

  • Apply and extend our new brand system across print and physical formats.

  • Raise the quality bar on customer-facing content, including guidelines for photography and filming at events.

What success looks like

  • First 30 days: you know the brand system inside out, you've shipped your first event assets, and you've mapped what currently goes to contractors.

  • First 90 days: events and print run through you, not contractors. There's a working event template library and a print spec/supplier list the team trusts.

  • First 6 months: colleagues self-serve the basics (starter kit, slide templates), and you spend your time on the moments that matter most.

Who you'll work with

  • Events: our Events team in London and New York.

  • Marketing and Product Marketing: a growing PMM team plus content, customer advocacy and growth.

  • Design: our Founding Visual Designer and the Design Director.

  • Leadership: occasional high-visibility requests (keynotes, board and leadership decks).

What we're looking for

  • Around 5 years in graphic or visual design, ideally in a B2B or in-house brand team. If you're close to that and your work speaks for itself, apply anyway.

  • A portfolio with real, produced events, print and campaign work, not only screens.

  • Strong typography, layout and colour, and confidence working within a brand system while pushing it forward.

  • Experience preparing print-ready files and working with printers and suppliers.

  • Comfortable juggling several briefs at once, pushing back on scope and keeping stakeholders in the loop.

  • Confident in Figma and Adobe Creative Cloud (InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop).

  • Strong presentation design in Google Slides and Figma Slides.

Nice to have

  • Basic motion design for event screens and social.

  • Experience art directing photography or video.

How we hire

  1. Portfolio review by our design team.

  2. Intro call with Talent Team (about 30 mins).

  3. Design deep-dive: walk us through 2 to 3 produced projects.

  4. Meet the team: Marketing and Events stakeholders.

We keep it quick and tell you where you stand at each stage.

At Omnea, we embrace diversity. To build a product that's loved by everyone, we're best served by a team with all sorts of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't quite match the full job spec! And regardless of your race, religion, colour, gender, or anything else! If you think you could be a good fit for Omnea, please reach out.

A few things to note:

  • We offer competitive geo-localised benefits, and you can check out our UK Benefits Package here and our US Benefits Package here.

  • We work Tuesdays, Wednesdays & Thursdays in-person at our offices. At this early stage of our company life-cycle it's important to us that we get this together-time, and you can read more about why we believe this is a winning move here

  • We're commercial, ambitious and we don't pretend otherwise! We're actively seeking folks looking to make the most of a career-defining opportunity, with the hunger to be part of building something really impressive. You can see our values here and our Omnea Future Founder's fund here!

If you'd like to opt out of us using automatic transcribers, please note this in the free text field in your application, otherwise we'll take your application as confirmation that you're happy for us to use notetakers (whether added to video calls or in the background).

We are proud to be recognised for both our culture and product, and we are just getting started. Join us as we grow!

title: Working Student - LLM Inference Performance
descriptionHtml:
About Tensordyne

AI is transforming our world. It can perform cognitive functions that previously only humans could do, such as perceiving interactions across different modalities and environments - with the ability to quickly learn and then solve complex problems. Tensordyne is an AI system solution company that builds very high-performance, low-power generative AI inference systems. Our mission, through the creation of custom silicon, hardware and software, is to enable multimodal Generative AI inference acceleration at scale, with safe, sustainable, high-performance systems for our hyperscaler and neocloud data center customers. We are at the leading edge of advancing the latest research and product improvements for generative Al inference solutions that will make Al even more advantageous for compelling new generative AI applications.Tensordyne is a well funded, fast-paced startup company with headquarters in both Sunnyvale, CA, and Munich, Germany. We also have many talented team members working remotely across North America and Europe. We take care of our people and their families with comprehensive benefits, competitive compensation, flexible spending options, and recognition programs, because building category-defining technology starts with a healthy, supported team. Come join us as we shape the future of multimodal generative artificial intelligence!

About the Role

How fast should an LLM building block run on our hardware? How fast does it actually run, and what would make it faster?

As a Working Student, LLM Inference Performance, you'll help answer these questions by working directly with our hardware and software engineering teams.

You'll write and optimize low-level kernels, benchmark performance on real silicon, and develop profiling tools that help engineers understand and improve LLM inference performance.

You'll gain hands-on experience with our Rust programming stack and Python SDK, use AI coding agents as part of your development workflow, and collaborate closely with engineers working on compilers, runtimes, and kernel optimization.

This is an opportunity to apply your academic knowledge to real-world AI hardware challenges while taking ownership of meaningful technical projects.

What You'll Do

  • Understand our hardware: Learn how Tensordyne silicon processes data, manages memory, and synchronizes operations, and how key LLM components such as attention, MLP, and Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) routing map onto the architecture..

  • Develop and optimize kernels: Implement, test, and tune low-level kernels to improve the performance of LLM inference workloads..

  • Analyze performance: Build analytical and roofline performance models, compare predictions against simulator and real-silicon measurements, and investigate performance bottlenecks..

  • Build benchmarking and profiling tools: Develop benchmark harnesses, profiling scripts, and trace visualizations that make performance easier to measure, understand, and improve..

  • Work with AI coding agents: Explore workflows where AI agents assist with kernel development, optimization, and benchmarking, and identify the tools and context they need to work effectively..

  • Collaborate across engineering teams: Work closely with compiler, runtime, and kernel engineers to translate performance insights into practical improvements..

Example project: Develop a benchmarking and profiling harness for an LLM building block, such as decode attention, at two abstraction levels. Compare measured performance against theoretical estimates and make the tooling accessible to AI coding agents.

What We're Looking For

  • Currently enrolled in a Master's degree program in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mathematics, or a related technical field..

  • Strong programming skills in Python and at least one of C, C++, or Rust..

  • Understanding of computer architecture, memory systems, bandwidth, and parallel computing through academic coursework or personal projects..

  • Interest in low-level programming, hardware performance, and optimization..

  • Practical experience using AI coding agents in development workflows, with the ability to evaluate and improve their output..

  • An experimental mindset, with the ability to form hypotheses, analyze measurements, and communicate technical findings clearly..

  • Curiosity, initiative, and enthusiasm for learning new technologies..

Nice to Have

Experience in one or more of the following areas would be a plus:

  • GPU or AI accelerator programming..

  • Embedded systems or bare-metal programming..

  • Performance profiling, benchmarking, or optimization..

  • LLM inference fundamentals and architectures..

Why Join Tensordyne?

  • Work on cutting-edge AI technology: Contribute to the development of next-generation AI inference hardware and software..

  • Gain hands-on experience: Apply your university knowledge to real silicon and challenging engineering problems..

  • Own meaningful projects: Build tools and solutions that directly support our engineering teams..

  • Learn from experienced engineers: Work alongside specialists in hardware architecture, compilers, runtimes, and performance optimization..

  • Explore AI-assisted development: Gain practical experience building with AI coding agents and shaping how they interact with advanced hardware systems..

  • Make a lasting impact: Help develop performance tools and workflows that will support both current and future generations of Tensordyne technology..

Tensordyne's culture was built on the following values

  • Put people first. We only succeed when our people succeed.
  • Ethics and integrity always. Be open, honest, and respectful of everyone.
  • Think Big. Be ambitious and have audacious goals.
  • Aim for excellence. Quality and excellence count in everything we do.
  • Own it and get it done. Results matter!
  • Make each person better together than they would be as an individual.
  • Embrace each other's differences, and embrace that there will be differences.

Tensordyne is an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse teams are better equipped to solve complex problems and build exceptional technology. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, race, religion, pregnancy, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.
